me drod bskyed pa bsten/ /dang po'i ro gsum yang dro snum bcas bzas//skam sa'i chang btung khang steng bsil spang gnas/ /zhes pa ste/ bod zla drug pa chu stod zla ba dang / bod zla bdun pa gro bzhin zla ba gnyis ni dbyar kha'i dus yin pas/ skabs der phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi mkha' dbyings su sprin gyi tshogs rab tu 'dus shing / char pa ha cang mang po babs pa'i rkyen gyis sa gzhi thams cad 'byung ba chu yi khams kyi brlan gsher dang ldan la/ da dung char pa babs pa tsam ma yin par 'byung ba rlung gi khams kyang shas che bar gyur pas na/ bser bu'i rlung dang grang ba gnyis lhan cig tu bsdongs pa'i mthu las sa rlangs dang chu rnyog ma can du gyur pa na/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi khams la lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs la lhag par gnod par byed cing nyams ca dmas su 'gro ba yin pas/ spyir me drod skyed par byed pa'i zas dang /spyod lam rigs shas cher bsten par bya dgos la/ bye brag tu dang po'i ro gsum ste mngar skyur lan tsha gsum dang / nus pa yang zhing dro la snum pa'i rigs rnams bza' ba dang / de bzhin du/ dper ma/ sa cha skam sa shas che ba'i sa khul du skyes pa'i 'bru rigs kyi chang dang / sha khu/ zhun mar sogs 'thung ba dang / dus de'i ring du sdod sa'i khang pa yang steng rlan gsher chung ba'i gnas khang gi nang du 'dug par bya ba dang / dbyar kha nam yin gyi skabs su rgyun du lus la dro spyod byed pa gal che zhing / char 51

rlung gi reg bya bsil ba dang ldan pas lus la ma phog par gnas par bya dgos/ mdor na nam zla dbyar kha'i dus der char zhod ha cang che ba'i skabs 'khel bas sa rlon pa dang / sa rlangs/ chu rnyog de bzhin reg bya grang ngad can gyis lus kyi me drod kyi nus stobs yongs su nyams dmas su btang nas/ zas skom gang zos shing btung ba rnams pho long rgyu ma'i gnas su 'ju mi nus par khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur ba ma zhu ba'i nad sogs kyi nyes pa ma lus pa skyes nas/ mthar mi 'dod bzhin du tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du 'gro dgos pa sogs 'byung bas na/ lus can rnams kyi tshe ni mi rtag cing mi brtan par rags pa'i 'gyur ldog rang bzhin kho na las mi rtag pa'i tshul yid la bsam par bya'o/ /brgyad pa/ nam zla ston ga'i dus kyi 'pho 'gyur la bltas te mi rtag par bsam pa /bshad rgyud dus spyod las/ dbyar bsil phral du lus la nyi zer gdungs/ /char dus bsags pa'i mkhris pa ston na ldang / /de bsal phyir na mngar kha bska ba bsten/ /ga bur tsan dan u shir dri ldan pa'i/ /gos bgo khang pa chag chag btab par 'dug /ces pa ste/ dbyar kha'i dus su 52 —

char rgyun dang rlung bser bu'i grang ba gnyis lha na cib tu bsdongs pa'i mthus mkhris pa rang gi mtshan nyid snum zhing rno la tsha ba'i mgo maman nas dus der nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tsha bas rab tu gdungs pas lkog gyur du gsog par byed cing ldang bar mi nus kyang / dbyar dus su bsags zin —pa'i mkhris pa de ston kha zhes bod zla brgyad pa khrum/sa stod zla ba dang / dgu pa dbyug zla gnyis kyi 'go tshugs zin pas char pa'i rgyun rim bzhin chad nas rlung dang grang ba yang rang bzhin gyis zhi nas 'phral du nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tsha bas ston tshad rgyas shing / mkhris pa rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i phyi'i 'byung ba'i nus pas rkyen byas te/ mkhris pa'i nad mngon gyur du ldang bar byed pa yin zhing / ston dus de lta bu'i mkhris pa'i nad kyi stobs 'phel zhing rgyas pa de 'joms pa 'am bsal ba'i phyir du mngar kha bska ba'i ro gsum shas che ba'i kha zas bsten par bya la/ nus pa bsil ba'i sman ma chog dper na/ ga bur dang / can dan/ u shir te sngo pu shel rtse gsum chu la spang pa 'i nus pa bsil grang dang ldan pa gos la gtor nas bgo ba dang / de bzhin du dri zhim la nus pa rab tu bsil ba'i sman mchog gang yin pa rnams kyi chus khang pa'i nang du chag chag btab nas bsil ba'i gnas khang nang du 'dug par bya'o/ / 53

dgu pa/ skyes pa'i nad kyi rnam grangs la bsam ste mi rtag pa bstan pa/bshad rgyud nad kyi rnam grangs le'u la sa/ skyes pa'i nad la khu ba zad rlugs gnyis/ /rlig rlugs pho mtshan nad dgu bcu bdun bshad/ /ces pa ste/ spyir skye sa pa pho kho na la dmigs bsal du byung ba'i nad kyi rnam grangs la bsams kyang / tshe mi rtag cing mi brtan pa nyid gsal por shes rtogs thub pa ste/ skye ba pho lus len pa'i lus rten zhig gi dbang du byas na/ lus zungs bdun gyi dngas ma'am nying bcud khu ba nyung drags nas zad pa dang / ha cang mang du 'phel nas rlugs pa/ gnyis/ de bzhin du rlig rlugs kyi nad la rlung las gyur pa dang / ma/bris pa/ las gyur nga / bad po/na las gyur pa/ tshil las gyur pa/ gcin las gyur pa/ rgyu ma/ las gyur ba bcas drug dang / shugs bstan khrag las gyur pa gcig de bzhin du pho mtshan gyi nang dgu yod pa ste/ 'brum pa can dang / cha/dud pa 'dra ba/sbubs 'byar/ gra ma can/ rlung gyur/ mkhris gyur/ khrag gyur/ 'dus/ gyur bcas khyon bsdoms pas nad rigs mi 'dra khag bcu bdun dang / shugs bstan gcig brtsis na bco brgyad byung zhing / de dag gang yang rung ba rnam par gyur tshe/ mthar mi 'dod bzhin du nad kyis dbang gis tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs par gyur ba bcas so/ /54

bcu pa/ bud med kyi nad kyi rnam grangs la bsam ste mi rtag pa bstan pa/bshad rgyud le'u bcu gnyis las/ bud med nad la mngal lnga mngal skran dgu/ /mngal gyi srin 'bu langs khros rnam pa gnyis/ /rtsa nad bcu drug sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes dang / yang / mkhas dbang khro ru'i 'grel pa drang srong zhal lung las/ bud med nad la skran dgu mngal nad lnga/ /rtsa nad bcu drug srin 'bu'i nad rigs gnyis/ /phal pa'i nad brgyad bzhi bcu tham par bshad/ /ces pa ste/ rgyud nang bud med kyi nad sum cu rtsa gnyis su bstan pa dang / 'dir drang srong zhal lung ltar bkral bar bya ste/ skye ba mo lus blangs pa'i bud med cig gi lus rten la mtshon na/nad kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba khag dper na/ chu bur can dang / hrem po/ bem po/ rmen skran/ pho skran/ skran ro nag po/ rtsa skran/ sa bon gyi skran/ za khu ste mngal skran bcas dgu yod cing / de bzhin du mngal gyi nad la lnga yod pa ste/ rlung gyur dang / mkhris gyur/ khrag gyur/ bad gyur/ 'dus gyur bcas dang / de bzhin rtsa nad bcu drug ni/ gro ba dang / snying / mchin pa/ snod mkhris/ mcher pa/ mkhal ma/ rgyu ma/ 'o ma/ nu ma/ gor ba ste te khrag tshabs bcu dang / de'i steng du mgo dang / rus pa/ snying / mkhal ma/ rgyu ma/ pho ba ste rlung tshabs drug bsnan pas bsdoms rtsa nad bcu drug 55

bcu pa/ bud med kyi nad kyi rnam grangs la bsam ste mi rtag pa bstan pa/bshad rgyud le'u bcu gnyis las/ bud med nad la mngal lnga mngal skran dgu/ /mngal gyi srin 'bu langs khros rnam pa gnyis/ /rtsa nad bcu drug sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes dang / yang / mkhas dbang khro ru'i 'grel pa drang srong zhal lung las/ bud med nad la skran dgu mngal nad lnga/ /rtsa nad bcu drug srin 'bu'i nad rigs gnyis/ /phal pa'i nad brgyad bzhi bcu tham par bshad/ /ces pa ste/ rgyud nang bud med kyi nad sum cu rtsa gnyis su bstan pa dang / 'dir drang srong zhal lung ltar bkral bar bya ste/ skye ba mo lus blangs pa'i bud med cig gi lus rten la mtshon na/nad kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba khag dper na/ chu bur can dang / hrem po/ bem po/ rmen skran/ pho skran/ skran ro nag po/ rtsa skran/ sa bon gyi skran/ za khu ste mngal skran bcas dgu yod cing / de bzhin du mngal gyi nad la lnga yod pa ste/ rlung gyur dang / mkhris gyur/ khrag gyur/ bad gyur/ 'dus gyur bcas dang / de bzhin rtsa nad bcu drug ni/ gro ba dang / snying / mchin pa/ snod mkhris/ mcher pa/ mkhal ma/ rgyu ma/ 'o ma/ nu ma/ gor ba ste te khrag tshabs bcu dang / de'i steng du mgo dang / rus pa/ snying / mkhal ma/ rgyu ma/ pho ba ste rlung tshabs drug bsnan pas bsdoms rtsa nad bcu drug 55

dang / de bzhin du mngal gyi srin 'bu langs khros gnyis te/ srin 'bu a so dang / 4ma ru tse gnyis/ de bzhin du man rgyud mo nad pha/la pa'i le'u ra/ mo nad rmel pa mtshan ma'i nad dang ni/ /bu ma phyin dang chomago 'jug log pa dang / /rog ma phyin dang snod lug khrag mi chod/ /nad gzhug las dang dug thabs gyur pa brgyad/ /ces bstan pa ltar mtshan ma'i nad dang / bu ma phyin/ mgo 'jug log pa/ rog ma phyind/ snod lugakhrag ma chod pa/ nad gzhug las pa/ dug thabs gyur pa dang bcas brgyadakamador bsdus na/ bud med kho na la byung ba'i dmigs bsal gyi nad rigs mi 'dra khag bzhi bcu tham pa byung ba'i tshul 'di la leg sa par bsam na/ rtag pa dzadang brtan po gang yang med pa'i mdze sa sdug gi langari tsho rab tu dar ba'i za ma bud med kyi lus rten de nyid la glo bur du /rkyen ngan sna tshogs kyi gzhan dbang las 4nam zhig nges par 'jig thobar 'gyur ba ni chu yi lbu ba dang gnyis sa med cing kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir ro // ri ri — tsho bcu gcig pa/ byis brte nad kyi rnam grang sa la bsam ste — mi /ka par bstan lda/— — — bshad rgyud nad kyi rna grangs le'u la / byes pa'i nad la phra ragabye zhib tshegs brgyad/ /ces pa ste/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ byis paXkho r+ha 56

dang / de bzhin du mngal gyi srin 'bu langs khros gnyis te/ srin 'bu a so dang / 4ma ru tse gnyis/ de bzhin du man rgyud mo nad pha/la pa'i le'u ra/ mo nad rmel pa mtshan ma'i nad dang ni/ /bu ma phyin dang chomago 'jug log pa dang / /rog ma phyin dang snod lug khrag mi chod/ /nad gzhug las dang dug thabs gyur pa brgyad/ /ces bstan pa ltar mtshan ma'i nad dang / bu ma phyin/ mgo 'jug log pa/ rog ma phyind/ snod lugakhrag ma chod pa/ nad gzhug las pa/ dug thabs gyur pa dang bcas brgyadakamador bsdus na/ bud med kho na la byung ba'i dmigs bsal gyi nad rigs mi 'dra khag bzhi bcu tham pa byung ba'i tshul 'di la leg sa par bsam na/ rtag pa dzadang brtan po gang yang med pa'i mdze sa sdug gi langari tsho rab tu dar ba'i za ma bud med kyi lus rten de nyid la glo bur du /rkyen ngan sna tshogs kyi gzhan dbang las 4nam zhig nges par 'jig thobar 'gyur ba ni chu yi lbu ba dang gnyis sa med cing kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir ro // ri ri — tsho bcu gcig pa/ byis brte nad kyi rnam grang sa la bsam ste — mi /ka par bstan lda/— — — bshad rgyud nad kyi rna grangs le'u la / byes pa'i nad la phra ragabye zhib tshegs brgyad/ /ces pa ste/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ byis paXkho r+ha 56

la byung ba'i nad rigs phra ba brgyad dang / rags pa brgyad/ zhib tshegs brgyad bcas mdor na/ brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nad yod pa ste/ man rgyud byis pa'i nad kyi le'u las/ phra ba mgo skrangs gre pa 'gag pa dang / /mcher mkhris pho long sa zos zho ras brgyad/ /ces lo chung byis pa yin —pa'i skabs su mgo skrangs pa dang / gre ba 'gags pa/ mcher pa'i nad/mkhris pa'i nad/ pho ba'i nad/ long gi nad/ zas zos kyi nad/ zho ras kyi nad bcas phra ba brgyad po 'di yod cing de bzhin du yang de nyid las/ rags pa brang dang glo mchin 'khru skyugs dang / /rims dang lte ba de'i nad dang brgyad/ /ces rags pa'i nad brgyad ni/ brang gi nad dang / glo ba'i nad dang / mchin pa'i nad dang / 'khru ba'i nad dang / skyug pa'i nad dang / rims kyi nad dang / lte ba'i nad dang / rde'u'i nad bcas brgyad yod/ de bzhin du yang zhib tshegs mig dang rna ba kha nad dang / /rmen bu srog rtsa srin phol sha nad brgyad/ /ces mig gi nad dang / rna ba'i nad dang / kha yi nad dang / men bu'i nad dang / srog rtsa'i nad dang / srin gyi nad dang / phol nad dang / sha nad bcas zhib tshegs kyi nad brgyad bcas khyon bsdoms nad rigs mi 'dra ba khag nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod cing shin tu nyam chung ba'i lo chung byis pa zhig la mtshon na/ skabs der lus po'i stobs yongs su ma rdzogs shing ma smin pa'i khar/ da dung na tshod ha cang phra ba'i rkyen gyis bzang ngan dang lebs nyes dbye 'byed gang yang gsal 57

la byung ba'i nad rigs phra ba brgyad dang / rags pa brgyad/ zhib tshegs brgyad bcas mdor na/ brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nad yod pa ste/ man rgyud byis pa'i nad kyi le'u las/ phra ba mgo skrangs gre pa 'gag pa dang / /mcher mkhris pho long sa zos zho ras brgyad/ /ces lo chung byis pa yin —pa'i skabs su mgo skrangs pa dang / gre ba 'gags pa/ mcher pa'i nad/mkhris pa'i nad/ pho ba'i nad/ long gi nad/ zas zos kyi nad/ zho ras kyi nad bcas phra ba brgyad po 'di yod cing de bzhin du yang de nyid las/ rags pa brang dang glo mchin 'khru skyugs dang / /rims dang lte ba de'i nad dang brgyad/ /ces rags pa'i nad brgyad ni/ brang gi nad dang / glo ba'i nad dang / mchin pa'i nad dang / 'khru ba'i nad dang / skyug pa'i nad dang / rims kyi nad dang / lte ba'i nad dang / rde'u'i nad bcas brgyad yod/ de bzhin du yang zhib tshegs mig dang rna ba kha nad dang / /rmen bu srog rtsa srin phol sha nad brgyad/ /ces mig gi nad dang / rna ba'i nad dang / kha yi nad dang / men bu'i nad dang / srog rtsa'i nad dang / srin gyi nad dang / phol nad dang / sha nad bcas zhib tshegs kyi nad brgyad bcas khyon bsdoms nad rigs mi 'dra ba khag nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod cing shin tu nyam chung ba'i lo chung byis pa zhig la mtshon na/ skabs der lus po'i stobs yongs su ma rdzogs shing ma smin pa'i khar/ da dung na tshod ha cang phra ba'i rkyen gyis bzang ngan dang lebs nyes dbye 'byed gang yang gsal 57

po mi shes pa'i skabs su glo bur glo bur 'chi rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad pa'i dbang gis tshe yi 'phen pa 'dus byas pa du ma mthong chos su gyur bas na chung byis pa'i dus su pha ma bdag skyong yag po gnang dgos pa ma zad/'tsho byed sman pa rnams kyis kyang slob ston gang gzab gnang gal che ba yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na ni 'tsho ba'i rkyen las 'chi ba'i rkyen ngan dang bad chad mang bas lus can rnams kyi tshe ni mi rtag cing mi brtan pas nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra ba yin/ / bcu gnyis pa/ rgas pa'i nad kyi rnam grangs la bsam ste mi rtag par bstan pa/ yang de nyid las// rgas nad 'byung ba'i lus stobs 'gribs pa yin//zhes pa ste/ lo na bdun cu nas na rgos shing lus 'khogs par gyur pa'i mi rgan po ni/ nang lus khams kyi 'byung ba'i stobs 'bri zhing / phyi sha pags la mnyer ma thon pa dang / nang snying dang / glo ba/ mcher pa/ mchin pa/ mkhal ma dang bcas don lnga dang / de bzhin pho ba dang / mkhris pa/rgyu ma/ long ga lgang pa/ bsam bse'u sogs kyi byed las rim pas nyams pa ma zad/ bar rtsa rus kyi nus pa yongs su shor ba bcas kyis dbang las mig gis gzugs gsal por mi mthong ba dang / rna bas sgra ma thos pa 58

dang / snag dri mi tshor ḍi/ lceg ro mi tshoX ba/ lug kyi reg bya nyams shing / da seskre yicad la bsum pasde bya ba dzi/—da —yirno pa dag gi rjes su 'jug mi nus rnga /re tre na shes nyarnyes bsgyur 'ugyur ba bcas / mudor na/ sngo yi 'dzin pa sdogs par 'gyur ba la gshin 2tu thag nye ba'i rgan sho la phyi nang zhabyung —sde'i sdig stobs 'gribag shong nyam sa mapa da gyur ṅge na/gelug ca na rnags tshe ldo brgya thub par 'gyur ba sdin yang skye ba'i mtha' mu 'chi bha dang / 'du ba'i mtha' ma bral ba ni phyi nang gi 'byeng khams thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel kho na la bltos pa'i phyir ro/ / bzlo gsum pa/ dus chokyi skye rno —la rnyes skre 0mi rtag par /rten pa/bshad rgyud le'u dgu pā nad kyi rkyen bstan —pa'i le'u lus/tsho dus ni tsha dus grang dus chur dus gsum/ /delhan gas tsha grang char pa chung ba ste// lhags pa rde drugs log sta med pa'o/ri/zheg pa ste/gasnir dus tshod la dbye bha gi ༷dra byā yig du ma mchis kyud / skams 'dir lo gcig lda chadus gsum du dbye ba yin te/ bode zla dang po/ — gzhag pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi p+ta ni dpyid ga'i du kyi zlu ba bzhi dang /jiXde nag bod zlu lnga pa / drug pa/ bdun —pa/ brgyad ṅge rnams ni dbyar khasdo dug kyi zla ba bzhi dang / de bzhin bod zla dgu —pa/ bcu pa/ri/ bcu thugacig gcu gagis stobacas bzhi ni dgun kha'i 59

dus kyi zla ba bzhi yin zheng / ——— de sgyusno tsha ba'i bye rmerme tshoske darngo /ci grang ba'i dus dgun khe/ charno gyi dus dbyar rte thegasde cidu tshode snyeX 'dra ba gsum po 'di la/ dbe+er na/ ts+tsha dus tsha tshade med pa / grange durge grad dzade med pa/ char du/sa chor pa mede pa ste/ seṅge dermen par 'a gyu ra ba rdeng /ci yaX tsha dus tsha drargos pre dnge / grange sgrodu sgrong spre /so dzi/ char dus gachar mang drags pa ste/ dus snyen pa ra 'odz+nyākār pre de dro ci nge mtsha ba'i dus sos rke dnge ston ga'i dus gse smyer —3 du'abyurngo rbe'i rang /zhen lorme rje ba nge/ tshur 'ebyung/ dargos pa yirne rjiyaX / de tshomes rgo ldorge sti tsha dug ts+tsha ba d+mad pare/ grang zere 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du gange ༷rme duso da dun rnyed dad de/de/ smad gnyis su phyi rang byung khams kyi 'ebyung 7ba ngesas tshopareri ṅge nga rungar ༄ na dgos nges kyang / de las ldog ste grad dus grang ngar med par tsha ba byung ba dang / yang de bsnyen rdu charanyi 〈be cadabyer gyi/ dus sta nges ware cher pa babs dgos nges yin yang / de las sbu(ga ste char 〉dzurme char pa ma babs par than pa btang ba sogs byung ba ni dus 31da ma1ga pa zhe sa bya ba yin gshis/ de lta dzu'i dus rtsod dmazhe snyego mgo me'i skyes sgye ṅge 'a sgo bo mi rme —rigs dang / ri dgas gcan gzan rigs/ 'dab chags bya'i byisa'i rigs /— 'ege srin tsug chogs kyi rlurges/ be ṅgādza rte dril la sogs pa'i 〈de 'a gro 'i rigs/ sngo 'eng ljorno shinge me 5glegs —pa'i rnogs cholo sgyeri rigs/0 rtsi sgonge ldum ra la glegos pa'i d+ma tog gi rigaso/ rmejes 'irgyu 〉srerge rmi la tshosarge sa pa'i 60da

raslo tog gi rigs/ star kham ku shu la sogs pa'i shing 'bras kyi rigs sogs kun la dus dman lhag log pa'i rkyen gyis ha cang gnod par 'gyur ba kun gyi mthong chos su gyur pa na/ rang cag mi'i rigs su 'dra zhig yin rung phyi 'byung bzhi'i khams ma snyoms pa'i dus tshod dman lhag log gsum nam yin byung mtshams su nang skyes bu'i 'du ba rlung mkhris bad kun gsum 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur nas/ lus sems gnyis skar rang bzhin gyi dka' ngal 'phrad de nad kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba gang yang rung ba'i stobs skye zhing / lus po'i bde thang gi go skabs 'phrog — par byas te/ mthar lus sems gnyis po rang rang so sor kha bral te 'chi ba'i dus kyi rkyen du 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /bcu bzhi/ gdon gyi 'chi rkyen la bsam ste mi rtag par bstan pa/ man rgyud 'byung gdon gso ba las/ rgyu rkyen sdig pa mi dge'i las mang spyad/ /grogs med ya nga gcig pur bsdad pa dang / /ya ga can la 'bags gtses brnyas pa dang / /mchod 'os chag dang mya ngan gdung la sogs/ /mi 'tshams lus ngag 'gal las 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da bar du lus ngag yid gsum 61

gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba zhes 'gro ba gzhan la 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs mang du brtsams pa'i sngon bsags las ngan gyi rgyu dang / dus da lta blo sems mthun pa'i dga' ba'i grogs sogs med par rang nyid gcig pur ha cang ya nga ba'i gnas 'jigs skrag can gyi sar bsdad pa dang / ya ga can zhes drag shul dang gdug rtsub shin tu che ba'i mi ma yin lha srin gyi rigs la 'bag bcog shor ba dang / gnod pa bskyal ba/ rgyun du rang gi 'dod don bsgrub par byed pa'i ched du skye bo so so'i blos mchod par byed 'os pa dag la dus dus su mchod gnas dang bsnyen bkur byed pa sogs chag pa dang / de bzhin sems kyi snying stobs zhum nas tshor ba sdug bsngal bas gzir nas mya ngan byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi thun mong gi spyod tshul las ring du 9 gal nas ha cang mi 'tshams pa'i lus ngag gi bya ba thal drags pa sogs kyis 'a byung po'i gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / brjed byed kyi gdon dang / gza'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha'i gdon dang / lha min gyi gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / tshangs pa'i gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / sha za'i gdon dang / yi dgas kyi gdon dang / grul bum gyi gdon dang / byad stems kyi gdon dang /g.yeng byed kyi gdon dang / ro langs kyi gdon dang / mtshun gyi gdon dang / bla ma'i gdon dang / drang srong gi gdon dang / rgan po'i gdon 62

dang / grub pa'i gedon dang btsas ga don chen bco rbergyad rdeng / yang de bzhin du tshode ba zhi na gshogs meci'i gtsugo gtor rnos byung ba'i gshegs dkar po las kya ngang / rku smen de'i ga don dang / cusrul po'i gdone dang /lus srul po'i gdo na dang / skem bye cad kyi gdon da nga / grib gnone gyi gedon —dang / gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang —/ nam gru'i gedon dang / gshin rje'i —gdon dang / bya'i chogadon dang / rme yo dga' bar rgyud pa'i ga don denge / rkun tu —'gro rbezhi gdon dnge / —ri lde 'don pa'i gdon dang / tsher ma 'don bo'i gdon la sogs me rnams kyis go skabs nges can sked rnga bsnyun na35 sdig pa'i sems dang / gdug pa/ 'i sems dang / sdong ba'i sermes deng / drag 〈le gdug rtsub kyi sems dang ldan ba'i jing nas gonod per byed cing 'jug par 'gyur ba'i skabs su sman rbacos ji tsamacho 6me kyang 7drag bskyed ci yab mede me'i duse nges par rim 'gro sorganas byed daskrangs te/ yongaso getede las/ brgya deng rtsa gci ga kun ba rtagos gdon yin patsho sa/ /de mebartsome pare 4sman dpyad ༄len mi 'dod//gdonabacos smane mde rgyur ri kyange 'a tsho g.yod/ /ce sa pa ltar godon gyi nad mdza po le rim 'gro —byed dgos pa ba stan pa bces —so 'a ca 63

bco lnga / ze so ste|me gyi 'a chi rkyen bsam ste milte — mo rtag —kar bsnyen pa/ chiji ca — ri ji skad du bshasdo rgyu zarme kyi tshu la ṅges par bya ba zlos/—tsho za~X tshurmye legs spyad lus datre srog 'tsho zheng / /tshordoman lhag glog sder nad rbaskyed 'phral srog 'joms / /rde phyir zas skom sbyorngor —ba mkhaṅge par gciste/ —/zhes pa ste/ 'gro ba mi rnoms thams cad —bde ba 'dod cinge snag bsnga smre tsho'adod pa gcig mtshungs yin pas na/ lurme sems —gnyis lhan gcirge tu gnas pa'i skarbes su de gnyis phan —tshun gcig la skegachog garte na pa'i 'brel ba dam zab yod cidza / 'brel ḍi dem came rtsed pa de yang phyi rol tu yod pa'i reng byeng khams kyi nang skye dngos deng / —tshu shing / srog chagaṅge sogs zulas byung ba'i 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i dngos rdzas ṅge dzug dang ldan pa'i bze'itsho nerigs dang / btung ba'i rirges zog shi nga 'thung ba cadag las byung ba'i khrag la sogatsu pa'i lus rizung skye yon tan nag bye da lag kyi nus pa rgyun ched me da par rnanang 'egro ṅge mi'i rulus khamathe2skye ཿrtsa phran brgyud lus kun tu 'khor zugase byed —pa dag las byung ba rkyen / de lta bu'i zas skom gyi rigs rgyude gtan ci'atsho ba'i nange 4du glegs —par tshug bzhin ladu tshad dong ldan pa longs zlu 4spyod na/ lus 'tshe zhinge mi rno ba ra bde thang tho/ gonas thub ciji /— gal te zarme skom bsten stangs kyi 6le lam̐ demat+na pa sgos 64

kha zas nyung drags na/ lus po'i srog bzung ba'i dngas ma/ khrag sha/tshil/ rus/ rkang / khu ba/ mdangs dang bcas pa'i ldang tshad kyi rang bzhin nyung du phyin nas lus kyi stobs nyams shing / rlung nad ji snyed cig 'byung bar gyur ba dang / de bzhin du/ lhag pa zhes zas skom mang drags nas rgyun gtan gyi bza' btung byed pa'i tshad gzhi las brgal nas ha cang tshad las thal bar gyur na ni/ khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba ma zhu ba be snabs sogs bskyed par byed cing / bad kun skya bo'i nad ji snyed cig 'byung bar gyur pa dang / de bzhin du yang / log pa zhes zas skom gnyis gsum bzhi lnga mnyam 'dres byas nas bza' ba dang / ya/nga na sbyar dug dang / dngos dug gyur dug sogs mi 'phrod pa'i dug ldan gyi zas skom bsten pas lus kyi 'du ba spyi snyoms su gnas ma thub par glo bur du mkhris pa'i nad ji snyed cig skyed par gyur nas lus zungs tsha bas sreg pa ste/ rul tu bcug nas mi 'dod pa'i nad kyi zug rngu mngon du gyur te/ mthar srog 'phrog par byed pa na/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir zas skom la longs su spyod pa'i tshul gyi sbyor ba la ma nor bar ci nas kyang nges par shes pa'am mkhas par byas nas gces dgos pa yin te/ kha zas bsdam pa'i le'u las/ zas skom bsdam bya dug ldan mi 'phrod zas/ /'phral du srog 'dor nyes pa 'khrugs phyir bsrung / /zhes dug dang ldan pa'i kha zas lta ci kha zas phan tshun so so'i ro dang / zhu rjes nus pa sogs mi mthun 65

kha zas nyung drags na/ lus po'i srog bzung ba'i dngas ma/ khrag sha/tshil/ rus/ rkang / khu ba/ mdangs dang bcas pa'i ldang tshad kyi rang bzhin nyung du phyin nas lus kyi stobs nyams shing / rlung nad ji snyed cig 'byung bar gyur ba dang / de bzhin du/ lhag pa zhes zas skom mang drags nas rgyun gtan gyi bza' btung byed pa'i tshad gzhi las brgal nas ha cang tshad las thal bar gyur na ni/ khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba ma zhu ba be snabs sogs bskyed par byed cing / bad kun skya bo'i nad ji snyed cig 'byung bar gyur pa dang / de bzhin du yang / log pa zhes zas skom gnyis gsum bzhi lnga mnyam 'dres byas nas bza' ba dang / ya/nga na sbyar dug dang / dngos dug gyur dug sogs mi 'phrod pa'i dug ldan gyi zas skom bsten pas lus kyi 'du ba spyi snyoms su gnas ma thub par glo bur du mkhris pa'i nad ji snyed cig skyed par gyur nas lus zungs tsha bas sreg pa ste/ rul tu bcug nas mi 'dod pa'i nad kyi zug rngu mngon du gyur te/ mthar srog 'phrog par byed pa na/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir zas skom la longs su spyod pa'i tshul gyi sbyor ba la ma nor bar ci nas kyang nges par shes pa'am mkhas par byas nas gces dgos pa yin te/ kha zas bsdam pa'i le'u las/ zas skom bsdam bya dug ldan mi 'phrod zas/ /'phral du srog 'dor nyes pa 'khrugs phyir bsrung / /zhes dug dang ldan pa'i kha zas lta ci kha zas phan tshun so so'i ro dang / zhu rjes nus pa sogs mi mthun 65

pa'am mi 'phrod pa'i rigs gang dag zos na dug dngos ma yin yang /khog pa'i nang du sbyar dug lta bur mtshungs par 'gyur ba yin/ de yang ji skad du/ zho ma langs dang chang gsar mi 'phrod de/ /nya yi sha dang 'o ma 'phrod pa min/ /de bzhin 'o ma shing tog gnyis mi 'phrod/ /bya yi sgo nga nya yi sha mi 'phrod/ /sran ma'i tshod ma bu ram zho mi 'phrod/ /sha mo yu ngas dkar mar la brngos pa dang / /khyim bya'i sha dang zho bsres za ba dang //sbrang rtsi mar nag cha mnyam 'phrod mi 'gyur/ /mar gsar 'khar ba'i snod du zhag bcu las/ /skyer pa'i me las ha ri tra sha bsregs/ /cong zhi zos rjes sha mo khur ba za/ /zhun mar zos rjes l+lī tshorwa 'thung ba dang / /sha la godakar skyur rtsam dris phog pa dang / /bcos pa'i rlangs bsrubs zhag bdun lon pa dang / /skyur dang 'o ma lhan cig za ba dang / /snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa yis/ /kha zas mi 'phros zos pas 'thab dang / /ma goms dus min zos pas dug tu 'gyur/ / zhes pa ste/ 'o ma las bzos pa'i zho ma langs pa nus pa snum la bsil ba yin zhing / de dang chang gsar pa snyi zhing rno la dro ba'i nus po phan tshun mi mthun par 'thab pa dang / de bzhin nya sha ni rlan gnas la gnas pa'i sha yin stabs nus pa snum zhing snyi la lhag par dro ba de dang / 'o ma'i nus pa bsil la snyi ba gnyis mi 'phrod cing 'thab pa dang / 'o ma snyi bsil gyi nus pa dang / shing thog —gsar thog ser can rigs kyi nus pa'i stobs mtshungs shing / lus po'i 66

nang du med ko na sa/ chu'i nus pa cher skye da nas rme rmephrod pa deng / bya 4zhe sgo nga snum zhing snyi le rmesil ba di de nga nya3 sha snyi btsul gagis mi 'byed pa — —dang / sran ma'i tshod me ni nus pa snyi zhing bsiṅge la yang snyob de —deng ṭ+wāṃ ram nus pa dro la tsha rno dang ldan pa zhese sgyure btsul snum bcas mi rmermed cing / she mo ni debyer kha spange rme skyes pa'o gzer sha yin zhing ro mngar la nus pa 'jam la btsul ba de rgyadange 9yungs dkar skesgro ma re —nurme pa snye la snum rme ga nyis bsten na mi 'asgrod la/ khyime sdo'i sgo ni nus ṅge snyi la barmecho zhing tsom pa de dang /ga zho skyur —la bsil zheng snyem pa gnyis snyen jig rte mi 'phrod pa dang / sbra/nga rtsi'i dume me dro la rno zheX rtsub —pa dang / mar nane gom 'bru mar rnams kyi nang men tirla mare sgye nurme pa'o —tsha bla rno zhing snyem pa cig nyis mi 'phrod pa dang / mar shesar pa bsil la snum me da caldan pa —— dang / 'khar ba wī zang sa kyi snod nang zhan —bcu las mnge ba rbezhag pa de dang / shing skyeme rme'i me la ha ri tre sha ste bye rnyeng khu ne tso dang rtses mtshungs —pa zhig gi sha'i nus pa dro ba dang rtsub pa de gnyes mer bsreg nas za bar 'egyur na mi 'phrod pa dang / —cong zhi ni rnorme rigese kyi snyen zhig yirne la de'i thalasman ngo bo drod ldan pa de dang she rme dang gro lasdo bzos pa'i bag phyi'i khu ba snyi la bsil ba'i nus pa dge mi mthurne po na mi 'phrod cig/ zhude mar drod la snum bcud ts+tsha ba zos shing ca'athung ma thag hūṃ rmye grong zhing bosil ba dang ldan pa gnyis mi 'azode pa dang /te sha rlon pa —de 'thodz+ra dka' 67

zhing snum lī snyi ba'i nu ga pa da da / sdo mtsho snyi bsil gyi nus pa/ ri zho skyur zhing snum la bsil ba dad rkyen chibazhi nus pa/ 5 rtsam pa grange mo snyi ba'i dri nus phog nas zhag tu lus pa dag zos na mi 'phrod pa dang / rlangs pa phyir ma thon par sbug bkag btad nas btsog pa'i shwa dang / de bzhin sha mog sogs kyi rigs zhag bdun lug lhag pa/ zos na mi 'phrod pa dang / star bu sogs ro sgyure ba'i rinetshos kyis gad kun lu phan yung khrag mukhris snyed par byed pa de dang / zho sa snyi bsdol lda na pa'i rikha zas phan tshun so so'i nus pa khong du mi mjun par 'thab pa dang / de bzhin du/ dper na/ nyizuṭa gung gi kha zas zos ga'i rjes su dus yun ring po ma song bar slar yang kha zas zos na snga ma zos pa dag myi 'ju ba'i steng du phyi ma yar bskyar zog pas lus la cimi 'phrod pa dang / de bzhin du snang rgyun gtan kha la ma goms ripa'i zags rigs mang ge bzad ba dang phyogs mtshungs kha zas bza' ba'i dus rjod spyire myi —rnams k+ṣi zhin gasdig la snga dro zhin gung dgong dro bcas thengs gsum bza'ul ba gin skeyadami / tshodug dzod nge sa me da mtshan gyi dkyil nam phyed lta cabur dug ma yin bzhi kha chazas bza' btung byas pa bcas kyis —kha zas ma zhu bas rgyumi'i lug po la ldi 'amaphrod par kha zas phan tshun 'thab rngo rin khog ciga'i nang du —rang bzhin gyi dug lta bu chags nas gnod pasdo 'gyur bas —nad 'dru min sna tshogs bslangs pa dang / des rkyen lus po'i bde thang 'phrog par byas te mthur srog 'phrog par 'gyur ba yin/ /ji 68

bcu drug pa/ spyod lam gyi 'chi rkyen la bsam ste mi rtag par bstan pa/bshad rgyud gnas skabs kyi spyod lam bstan pa las/ rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam rnams/ /nyams ldan bsten par byed na nad mi 'byung / /nad kun mi skye skyes pa'ang zhi bya'i phyir/ /gnas skabs spyod pa'i cho ga 'di nyid bsngags/ / zhes pa ste/ rang re'i 'gro ba rnams 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i 'dzam speng go la hril po 'di'i nang du mi gang zhig yin rung / dus rtag tu rang gi lus khams la phan pa'i bza' btung tshul bzhin du ma nor bar byed pa ni ha cang gi gal 'gangs che zhing /phyogs mtshungs/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs kyi bya ba spyod lam yang de bzhin gang gzab kyis 'gal 'dzol chen po med par ci nas kyang gal che ba yin te/ nam rgyun du zas dang spyod lam la do snang chen pos rang gi kha zas 'di dang 'di zos na lus la gnod par 'gyur ba dang / bya spyod 'di dang 'di byas na rang gi gzugs po'i 'phrod bsnyen la gnod skyon 'byung ba sogs shes par bya dgos shing / gal te bza' btung gi rigs sna tshogs dang / spyod tshul gang zhig byed phyogs thad la bzang ngan dang legs nyes ji 'byung gsal po ma rtogs tshe/ nges par du zas spyod slob ston gyi thog la mkhas pa chen po'i nyams bzang dang ldan pa'i sman 69

pa'am em rje mkhas pa dag la/ bsten te/ zas spyod kyi skor la slob ston dang bka' 'dri zhus na/ nad mi 'byung zhing lus kyi 'phrod bsten la srung skyob byed thub nga/ dang / gal te lus la nad skyes nas gzugs gzhi bde po med na/ de bas kyang sman pa bsten par byas nas nad rigs chung phra —ci 'dra zhig yin kyang lam seng drag thub pa 'i thabs shes byed pa'i tshul nyams su len pa'am lag len bstar ba 'di nyid la mchog tu bsngags par 'gyur ba yin pas na/ zas dang spyod lam gnyis la nges par gzab gzab byed dgos pa yin/ /de nyid las/ bkres bkag lus zhig nyam chung yi ga 'chus/ /mgo 'khor de zas yang snum dro chung sbyar/ /skom bkag kha skam mgo skor snying nad 'byung / /myos 'gyur de bsil cho ga thams cad phan/ /skyugs bkag —dang ga 'gags dang dbugs mi bde/ /skya rbab me dbal g.yan pa 'bras dang mdze/ /mig nad lud pa rims nad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /smyung gnas dud rnon kha bkang dbo bar bya/ /zhes pa ste/ su zhig yin rung grod khog ha cang ltogs pa'i skabs su da dung zas skom ma bsten na/ lus khams zhig ste stobs la gnod cing nyam chung bar gyur la/ de rjes yi ga 'chus pa ma zad rlung 'phel nas mgo 'khor ba byung / de la phan pa'i kha zas ni 'bras thug sogs thug pa sla po'i rigs dang / zhun mar/ sha khu/ 'o ma dron mo sogs nus po yang zhing snum la dro ba'i zas smom ha cang mang 70

po ma yin pa bsten dgos/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ shin tu bkres par gyur nas dug yun ring por lto ma rag pa'i skabs su rjes sngon la bza' btung tshode —mad zos shing gtung na/ pho bapa rgyu long du 'ju ma nus par gnod pa yin/de bzhin du kha ha cang skom par gyur kyang / ja dang chu sogs rlan gsher rigs la ma bsten na/lazhog pa'i nang du drod tshad rgyas nas chu khams rlan pa'i cha shas sogs skam nas kha skam pa dang / mgo 'khor ba ma za da lhag don snying gas khar 'gyur zhing / de blta bu'i nad byung na/ de dzil btung ba chu rigs sogs bsil ba'i cho ga dag gis phan pa dang / yang deng dus snum 'khor mo ṭa sogs kyi nang 'gro ba'i skabs skyugs pa byung yang mar ma skyugs par u tshugs kyis bkag par gyur na/ khog pa'i nang du rlung gi rgyu ba 'khrugs shing des lus po'i rtsa lam gzhan du tshul min gyis gtor nas kha zas za mi 'dod pa dang / dbugs gtong mi bde ba/ rjes su skya rbab dang / me dbal/ g.yan pa/ 'bras nad/ mdze nad/ mig nad/lud pa 'phel ba'i nad/ rims nad sogag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ bshad rgyud nad 'ju ga tshul las/ khyab byed rlung gis bu ga rnams su gtor/ /de tshe dngas ma gang du chags gyur pa/ /dz+wa ga'i skyon dang de dus spyod lam gyi/ /mkha' lus sprin 'dus charwa pa babs pa bzhin/ ci/rang rang gnas chi 'phel zhing gsog par byed/ /bsags pa rkyen 'phrad nges pa kho nar ldang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la de la phan pa'i thabs shes ni gnas 71

skabs ring zas mi bza' bar smyung bar gnas shing / tsan dan dang a ga ru'i dud pa rnon po'i sna sman btang ba dang / de'i chus kha bshal nas phyir dbo bar byas na phan thogs 'byung nges yin/ /sbrid bkag dbang po mi gsal mgo bo na/ /gnya' ba rengs dang kha yo 'gram chag 'gyur/ /dud rnon sna sman gi ma blta bas gsal/ /g.yal bkag de 'dra cho ga rlung 'joms phan/ /ngal dub dbugs bkag skran dang snying nad 'byung / /myos gyur der bsil ngal gso rlung sel phan//gnyid bkag g.ya' mang lus snyom mgo bo snyi/ /mig grib kha zas mi 'ju sha khu dang / /chang 'thung bsku mnye bya zhing gnyid log phan/ /zhes pa ste/mi gang zhig rang bzhin du byung ba'i ha sbrid dam sbrid pa bkag pa na/ rlung 'khrugs nas byed la/sa log par byas nas dbang po mig dang rna ba sogs mi gsal ba dang mgo na zhing / gnya' rengs nas phar tshur gcus mi shes pa dang / 'gram pa'i bya pa nyam chag tu song nas bza' mi thub par de la tsan dan dang a ga ru'i du ba rnon po bdug pa dang / dza ti dang shing kun gyi sna sman btang la/ mig gis gi ma la bltas na/ gi ma'i 'od zer gyi nus pas mig nang chus rab rib byed pa dag phyir thon nas dngas shing gsal bar gyur pa yin/ a stong rgyag pa'am g.yal bkag par gyur na gong gi sgrid pa bkag pa dang 'dra ba'i nad byung zhing / de la yang gtso bo thor bu'i rlung 'khrugs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rlung la phan pa'i sman bcos kyi cho 72
