gas phan par 'gyur ba 'o/ /rgyugs shar glod pa dang / lus rtsal rtsed pa/ las ka shugs las che cher byas nas ngal dub bam dka' las ha cang kha ba'i dus glo bur du dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'byin rngub byed pa bkag na/ 'u sa po'i nang du rlung gi byed las 'khrugs nas rlung gis bsgril ba'i lhen skran nam rlung gis bsgongs pa'i rdo skran gyi nad skyed par byed la/ don snying ni rlung gi gnas gzhi yin par brten snying nad 'byung zhing des rlung sems rgyu ba'i rtsa phran gyi bu ga'i lam la/ gnod nas shes pa myos par 'gyur ba yi na/ de la phan pa'i thabs ni lus dal zhing ngal gso dgos la rlung sel ba'i zas spyod sman dpyad kyis phan pa yin/ yang mi gang zhig la sa ka dang / slob sbyong / rtsed mo rtsed pa sogs kyis mtshon mtshan mo'i gnyid kyi dus gnyid slebs kyang ma nyal bar gnyid bkag pa yin na/ g.yal stong yang nas yang du mang po byung zhing / lus khams sgom pa ste spob to chags pa dang /mgo bo snyi zhing mig sprin dmar po chags pa dang / mig mi gas/la bar 'grib pa dang / me drod kyi nus pa zhan du phyin nas kha zas mi 'ju ba'i nad sogs skyed par byed cing / des na nyin mo lus sems gnyis la ngal dub byung ba de mtshan mo gnyid kyi dus sel bar byed pa'i cha nas rgyun du gnyid nyal ba'i tshad gzhi ran po byed pa ni gal che ba yin/ gal te gnyid bkag nas de lta bu'i nad byung na/ de la phan pa'i thabs ni 'di ltar 73

bsten dgos te/ chang gsar 'jam dang / sha khu bzang po/ 'o ma dron mo btung ba dang / da dung snum dang mar sogs kyis lus la bsku mnye bya la gnyid bde bar log pa bcas kyis phan pa yin/ /lud pa bkag pas lud 'phel dbugs mi bde/ /tha/ skem skyigs bu snying nad yi ga 'chus/ /der ni lud pa bsal ba'i cho ga bya/ /mchi ma bkag pas snying dang mgo bo na/ /sna chu 'dzag cing maso 'khor yi ga 'chus/ /de la chang btung gnyid log gtam snyan phan/ /'phyin bkag rtug skams 'a'aphyen dang bshang ba 'gag /skran ser mig rtul drod chung snying nad 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ mi sang zhig rang bzhin nyid du lud pa lu ba yin na/ phyir dbo bar bya ba las lud pa bkag pa dang / khog pa'i nang du slar mar mid pa sogs byas na des lud pa nyung du mi 'gro bar da dung mang du 'phel ba'i rgyu byas nas bad kun shas che ba las grub pa'i slo ba'i rtsa sbub nang du dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa'i bya ba la gnod pa sa dbugs mi bde ba dang / nang gi 'byung khams gtsang bzo ma/ thub par brten des rkyen byas te sha rem pas skem zhing / skyigs bu'i nad dang /snying gi nad/ de bzhin du kha zas yi ga 'chus pa 'gyur ba sogs byung ba na/ de la phan pa'i thabs shes/ ni gro ba dang gre ba'i nang gi lud pa 'phel ba de sel ba'i stsa na nus pa rno la yang rtsub ldan pa'i star bu'i thangadang / bca' sga/ pi ling sogs bu ram dang sbyar ba'i lde gu gtong dgos/74

yang mi 'ga' zhig gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba sogs sems nang 'tshor ba ha cang gi sdug bsngal ba byung ba'i tshe rang bzhin nyid du sdug bsngal ba'i mig chu phyir shor ba dag slo bur du nan gyis bkag pa yin na/ rlung sems rgyu ba'i snying gi rtsa phran la gnod nas sdug bsngal ba'i mig chu dang tshor ba gnyis snying khongs su zhen cing chags pa'i dbang gis phyis su snying nad 'byung ba dang / des rlung 'khrugs nas mgo 'khor ba dang / sna chu 'dzag pa/ yi ga 'chus pa bcas kyi nad 'byung ba yin pas/ de la ni chang bzang po 'thung ba dang / gnyid khug pa/ yid la 'tshams pa'i gtam snyan po god pa dang bslab bya brgyab pa sogs kyis phan par gyur/ skabs skabs su 'phyen bkag ces rtug dri byung ba phyir ma btang bar shugs kyis bkag pa yin na 'og rlung des yar gyen du log nas long nang du rtug pa zhes bshang ba rlung gis skam po chags nas rdog sdog ril ril du 'dril zhing / de rjes 'phyen dang bshang ba'am gtsog pa mi babs par 'gag pa dang / thur sel gyi rlung log pa las mthar lus po'i nang skran nad dang / khong pa gzer ba/ dbang po mig mi gsal ba'i nad/ de bzhin du lus/ zungs smin nas 'ju bar byed pa'i me drod kyi cha nyams nas lus po'i drod chung du 'gro ba dang / snying gi nad du 'gyur ba bcas so/ /bshang ba bkag pas kha ru mi gtsang 'byung / /klad pa na zhing nya 'gyur cham pas 'debs/ /sngar bshad nad 'gyur gcin 'gag rde'u nad 75

yang mi 'ga' zhig gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba sogs sems nang 'tshor ba ha cang gi sdug bsngal ba byung ba'i tshe rang bzhin nyid du sdug bsngal ba'i mig chu phyir shor ba dag slo bur du nan gyis bkag pa yin na/ rlung sems rgyu ba'i snying gi rtsa phran la gnod nas sdug bsngal ba'i mig chu dang tshor ba gnyis snying khongs su zhen cing chags pa'i dbang gis phyis su snying nad 'byung ba dang / des rlung 'khrugs nas mgo 'khor ba dang / sna chu 'dzag pa/ yi ga 'chus pa bcas kyi nad 'byung ba yin pas/ de la ni chang bzang po 'thung ba dang / gnyid khug pa/ yid la 'tshams pa'i gtam snyan po god pa dang bslab bya brgyab pa sogs kyis phan par gyur/ skabs skabs su 'phyen bkag ces rtug dri byung ba phyir ma btang bar shugs kyis bkag pa yin na 'og rlung des yar gyen du log nas long nang du rtug pa zhes bshang ba rlung gis skam po chags nas rdog sdog ril ril du 'dril zhing / de rjes 'phyen dang bshang ba'am gtsog pa mi babs par 'gag pa dang / thur sel gyi rlung log pa las mthar lus po'i nang skran nad dang / khong pa gzer ba/ dbang po mig mi gsal ba'i nad/ de bzhin du lus/ zungs smin nas 'ju bar byed pa'i me drod kyi cha nyams nas lus po'i drod chung du 'gro ba dang / snying gi nad du 'gyur ba bcas so/ /bshang ba bkag pas kha ru mi gtsang 'byung / /klad pa na zhing nya 'gyur cham pas 'debs/ /sngar bshad nad 'gyur gcin 'gag rde'u nad 75

dang / /chu so pho mtshan dku nad sngar nad 'byung / /de sman rengs bu mas btang lus bcing dang / /bsku byug dugs dang sman mar bsten par bya//khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag pho mtshan na/ /chu 'gag rde'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur/ /mas btang lus bcings bud med spyad par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis bshang ba babs par gyur ba ni/ lus po'i nang du lus zungs mkho 'don gyi dgos mkho med pa'i snyigs ma dag phyir dor ba yin zhing / de shugs kyis tshad las brgal ba bkag par gyur na slar gyen du ldog nas kha nang du mi gtsang ba dngos su 'byung bar gyur ba dang / kha'i nang du dri ma ngan pa byung ba dang / des na bshang ba bkag pa'i dbang gis rlung gyen du log nas klad pa'i nang du tshangs bug byas/ rkyen klad pa na ba dang / nywa sha 'gyur ba dang / cham pas 'debs pa dang sngar gong du bshad pa'i nad/ skran nad dang / khong pa gzer ba/ mig rtu0/ ba/ lus drod chung ba sogs byung ba yin/ yang lus la mi mkho ba'i dri chu'am gcin pa yun ring nan gyis bkag pa yin na/ lgang pa'i nang du rde'u'i nad 'byung bar gyur pa dang / chu so zhes gcin lam gyi kha la tsha shar brgyab pa sogs kyi nad/ pho mtshan gyi nad/ dku zhes lus kyi smad phyogs su gnas pa'i mngal sogs khog pa'i nang du gcin lam gyi bu ga'i nad dang / sngar bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyen dang bcog pa bkag pa'i nad rnams kyang 'byung srid pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rtug dri dang bcog gcin bkag pa'i nyes pa 76

dang / /chu so pho mtshan dku nad sngar nad 'byung / /de sman rengs bu mas btang lus bcing dang / /bsku byug dugs dang sman mar bsten par bya//khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag pho mtshan na/ /chu 'gag rde'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur/ /mas btang lus bcings bud med spyad par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis bshang ba babs par gyur ba ni/ lus po'i nang du lus zungs mkho 'don gyi dgos mkho med pa'i snyigs ma dag phyir dor ba yin zhing / de shugs kyis tshad las brgal ba bkag par gyur na slar gyen du ldog nas kha nang du mi gtsang ba dngos su 'byung bar gyur ba dang / kha'i nang du dri ma ngan pa byung ba dang / des na bshang ba bkag pa'i dbang gis rlung gyen du log nas klad pa'i nang du tshangs bug byas/ rkyen klad pa na ba dang / nywa sha 'gyur ba dang / cham pas 'debs pa dang sngar gong du bshad pa'i nad/ skran nad dang / khong pa gzer ba/ mig rtu0/ ba/ lus drod chung ba sogs byung ba yin/ yang lus la mi mkho ba'i dri chu'am gcin pa yun ring nan gyis bkag pa yin na/ lgang pa'i nang du rde'u'i nad 'byung bar gyur pa dang / chu so zhes gcin lam gyi kha la tsha shar brgyab pa sogs kyi nad/ pho mtshan gyi nad/ dku zhes lus kyi smad phyogs su gnas pa'i mngal sogs khog pa'i nang du gcin lam gyi bu ga'i nad dang / sngar bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyen dang bcog pa bkag pa'i nad rnams kyang 'byung srid pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rtug dri dang bcog gcin bkag pa'i nyes pa 76

ma lus sel ba'i phyir thabs bsten stangs ni/ spo so cha dang / dud pa/lan tsha sbyar ba'i rengs bu dang / mas btang ni 'jam rtsi dang / ni ru ha sogs btang na phan zhing / lus bcing zhes rang byung chu tshan brgal ba dang bdud rtsi lnga lums kyis bcing ba dang / lus smad la snum gyi bsku byug byed pa dang / gcan gzan gyi pags pa dkri ba dang / snum gyi drod dugs rgyag pa dang / 'ba' sam sogs bsten par bya/ yang skabs 'dir skyes pa pho gang zhig gi dbang du byas nas khu ba mang du 'phel nas rang bzhin nyid du dbang po'i nor bu ldang bar gyur ba de'i tshe/ 'dod chags kyi lus sems 'tshims pa'i nyams su ma rol bar da dung shugs kyis bkag par 'gyur ba na rang bzhin dbang gi lus khams la 'os shing 'tshams pa ma yin pas bkag par mi bya ba dang / de dus yun ring po'i bar bkag par gyur na/ khu ba de nyid mar 'dzag cing pho mtshan na ba dang / mtshan mo rmi lam du bud med sogs kyis lus zungs 'byin par byed pa dang / khu ba dang gcin pa rgyu bar byed pa'i rtsa yi bu ga'i lam du rde'u 'phel ba zhes skran sdog rdog lta bu chags nas des rkyen byas nas gcin pa 'gags pa'i nad 'byung ba gyur ba dang / da dung 'dod pa spyod pa'i dbang po ldang bar byed pa'i tshor shes kyi nus pa nyams dmas su btang rkyen/ ma ning du 'gyur zhes 'khrig spyod byed ma thub pa chags pa yin/ de lta bu'i nad byung ba la bcos pa'i thabs ni/ mas btang ba 77

dang / lums kyis lus bcing ba sogs gong gi thabs shes ltar bsnye nadagos la/ da dung khu ba dang gcin pa'i rtsa lam gyi nyes pa dag pa'i phyiradus dus su bud med dang lhan cig tu nyal nas tshad ran pos chags rnga spyod par byas na dmigs bsal gyi phan par 'gyur ba sogs ni 'jisarten spyi yongs kyi cha nas bstan pa yin zhing / 'on kyang tshangs par spyo ngaldan gyi dge slong gi dbang du ni de ltar men pa rtogs dbos la sa gyu te skyes pa dag gis 'khrig spyo da byed pa mang dralas na lus ngal zhing dab pa dang / 'u sa stobs shor ba/ rlung 'phel ba sosas bye nad tshabs che'abyung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de yang 'dod chags sam khu ba ni ba zas bza' btung byas pa 'i bcud kyi nying khu de la dngas ma zer zhing / nge mābu'i dngas ma thigs pa bdun gyis nus pas mi'i lus po'i nang du 'khor rgyubs byed pa'i khras sku thigs pa gcis grub cing / de lta bu'i bras cuthigs pa bdun gyi nus pas lus kyi tha bskyed par byed cing / de lta bu'i sha skyed cing rgyas pa nge'i nus pa bdun gyis lus kyi snum pa'i cha shas tshi lu 'phel bar byed la/ de lta bu'i tshil gyi nus pa bdun gyis lus sra zhing mkhregs pa ra byed pa'i rus pa bskyed par byed/ de lta bu'i rus pa 3 ba can gyi nus pa bdun gyis lus po'i rkang lag nang gi rus pa'i dkyil du yod pa'i rkang mar chags par byed/ de lta bu'i rkang ma/ra nus pa bdun gyis gzhi nas mi'i phyi lus dang nang sems gnyis kyi bkrag mdangs ba'i

dang / dga' bde 'phel bar byed pa'i 'dod chags sam khu ba zhes pa de thigs pa gcig gzhi nas grub pa yin stabs/ de lta bu'i lus zungs kyi zhing khu bcud kyi phyung ba dag gis dbang las bud med la chags pa spyod drags na/ khu ba zad de rdzogs par gyur na lus sems gnyis la ha cang gnod par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir du khu ba gso bar bya ba'i zas bcud che ba'i rigs dper na/ til mar la sogs mar gyi rigs dang / ba dang mdzo la sogs pa'i 'o ma'i rigs/ khyim bya la sogs pa'i bya byi'u'i rigs kyi sha dang / lug sha la sogs pa'i sems can gyi tha rigs/ sha khu bzang po/ nas 'bru las bzos pa'i chang gi rigs bcas bza' btung byas na/ slar yang 'dod chags kyi khu ba dang lus po gso zhing / gzi mdangs rgyas la lus stobs 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de yang bshad rgyud las/ lus zungs khu ba'i mthar phyir mdangs mchog ste //snying la gnas kyang lus kun khyab pa dang / /tshe gnas gzi mdangs bkrag dang ldan par byed/ / ces gsungs pa'o // //79

dang / dga' bde 'phel bar byed pa'i 'dod chags sam khu ba zhes pa de thigs pa gcig gzhi nas grub pa yin stabs/ de lta bu'i lus zungs kyi zhing khu bcud kyi phyung ba dag gis dbang las bud med la chags pa spyod drags na/ khu ba zad de rdzogs par gyur na lus sems gnyis la ha cang gnod par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir du khu ba gso bar bya ba'i zas bcud che ba'i rigs dper na/ til mar la sogs mar gyi rigs dang / ba dang mdzo la sogs pa'i 'o ma'i rigs/ khyim bya la sogs pa'i bya byi'u'i rigs kyi sha dang / lug sha la sogs pa'i sems can gyi tha rigs/ sha khu bzang po/ nas 'bru las bzos pa'i chang gi rigs bcas bza' btung byas na/ slar yang 'dod chags kyi khu ba dang lus po gso zhing / gzi mdangs rgyas la lus stobs 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de yang bshad rgyud las/ lus zungs khu ba'i mthar phyir mdangs mchog ste //snying la gnas kyang lus kun khyab pa dang / /tshe gnas gzi mdangs bkrag dang ldan par byed/ / ces gsungs pa'o // //79

le'u gsum pa/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi skor bshad pa la drugadang po/ gnod byed nyes pa brgya rtsa gcig las rlung nad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi nyes pa bstan pa/bshad rgyud le'u bcu gnyis las/ kun khyab thun mong nad la nyes pa dang / /gco bo gnas dang rigs kyis dbye ba'o/ / yang man rgyud rlung nad kyi le'u las/ /nyes pas dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun gsum/ /rlung gi nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ /rigs kyis dbye na rlung nad nyi shu ste/ /gnas kyis dbye na 'jug sgo rnam pa drug /dbang po lnga la me tog shar dang bdun/ /bye brag srog 'dzin la sogs rnam gyur lnga/ /bad kun mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod/ /dbye ba bzhi cu rtsa gnyis rlung gi nad/ /ces pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i skyes pa dang / bud med dang / byis pa dang / rgan po la sogs 'gro ba mi'i rigs kun la thun mong du khyab pa'i nad rigs mi 'dra ba khag dper na/ gnod byed nyes pa'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig mchog dman gtso po'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig ngo 80

bo regs kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig bcas khyon bsdom sa nad rigs bzhibargya rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ gnod byed nyes pa rlung gi nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis su yod pa ste/ dang po spyi la yang rigs dang gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba rnam pa gnyis yod cing / dang po rigs ni/ gtso bo 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum las dang por rlung 'khrugs de nas rang gi rgyu lam rus pa rna ba reg bya snying srog long bcas las ldog ste/ gzhan mkhris pa dang /bad yin gyi rgyu lam brgyud nas log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yin te/ man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi rlung nad gso ba'i le'u las/ bye brag brtag pa rlung gis sgur por bsdus/ /'khun zhing dran med mig har dbugs 'byin dka'/ /de ming rlung nad a warta nar bshad/ /ces pa snye/ rlung nad a warta zhes thur sel gyi byed las log pa gtso bor ston zhing / gyen rgyu'i las byas pa'i mthus rlung sgur po zhes dpe mda' mo lta bur bzhag cing / don du lus zungs gso skyed kyi stobs nyams pas phyir lus po sgur sgyur chags shing / na zug gi 'khun sgra phug ron gyi skad bzhin shor ba dang / nang du dran shes gsal bar byed pa'i dbang rtsa nyams nas 'dzin pa blo yi dran shes med p+ta dang / mig ce rar har bzhin gdangs 'dzum med par phyir 'byin zhing gro ba'i byed las nyams pa'i rkyen gyis dbugs / phyi nang du 'byin rngub dka' ba yin/ skabs 'dir gzhung 'grel chen mo bai sngon dang / skyems 'grel/ me zhal/ drang srong zhal lung sogs spyi dang 81

lhag par btsan byol bod gzhung dbus sman rtsis khang gi sman dge mkhas dbang bstan pa chos 'phel mchog gis slob 'khrid gnang ba'i skabs su man ngag gi zur rgyan dang nyams mig khag gi nang gsal du ma gus pas zin bris su bkod pa dag phyogs bsdoms kyi tshul du bkral yod/de nyid las/ da rgan phyir dgye brang 'bur gnya' ba bstungs/ /ltag pa dgye la so 'cha' lbu ba skyug /mgo dang 'gram pa rgyab na skad mi 'byin//mig har yal byung rtsib logs gnyis su zug /ces pa ste/ da rgan ni ro stod tshigs pa bcu pa snod mkhris kyi gsang du rlung 'khrugs nas rtsib ma nyer bzhi dang / brang rus gru bzhi'i thad skyon shor nas 'bur du thon zhing / ltag pa'i chu rgyus bsdus pas 'jing pa'i gnya' ba bstungs shing yar dgye ba dang / kha nang gi ya so ma so gnyis bsgrig cing mtshan mo gnyid dus su so sgra 'byin zhing kha nas lbu ba mang po byung la/ lus po'i rgyab phyogs kyi chu rgyus 'dus pa'i dbang gis mgo dang 'gram pa rgyab sogs 'then zhing na ba dang / da dung nad pas skad gsal po ra smra mi thub cing go brda mi 'phrod pa la skad mi 'byin zer zhing / skabs 'dir mig har ba ni mi gzhan gyis skad brda sprad na mig mdangs 'dzum byed thub cing / yang rtsub kyi cha 'phel bas g.ya/la chung chung yang yang byung nas g.yas g.yon gyi rtsib ma'i logs su na zug brgyab nas na ba'o/ /de nyid las/ da rgan nang gug na tshul de 'dra la/ /ske bsnyungs brang 82

du bsdus te ro stod 'bur/ /zhes pa ste/ yang de bzhin du da rgan nang gus/ ni na tshul gong dang mtshungs shing / dmigs bsal du ske bsnyungs zhes brang rus nang du 'dzul zhing lus kyi ro stod phyir 'bur ba yin la mgo ske steng du gug pa 'i nad cig yin no/ /de nyid las/ 'gram pa nyams pa 'thams 'phyang 'byed 'dzum nyams//zhes pa ste/ 'gram pa nyams pa'i rlung nad kyis btab pa'i mi ni/ 'gram pa yas mas gnyis kyi rtsa nyams nas skad cha bshad dus mkhreng zhing / so 'gram gnyis yar mar g.yo 'gul byed pa'i nus mthu zad pa la 'thams 'phyang zhes brjod pa dang / da dung skabs 'gar gad mo dgod cing kha 'byed 'dzum byed pa'i tshe g.yas g.yon so sor kha 'khyog pa bcas kyi nad byung ngo / /— nge nyid las/ snyi ldib bza' btung smra dka' lkugs ldib 'then/ /zhes pa ste/ rlung nad snyi ldib ces pa'i nad kyis mnar na mi de'i don snying dang 'brel ba'i lus kyi rlan gsher gyi cha skam nas zas skom bza' btung byed pa dang / skad cha bshad dus smra ba la dka' tshegs che ba yin/ lkugs ldib 'then zhes pa lce rdog rdog chags pa'i snang bas brjod tshig gi sgra mi gsal ba'i nad cig yin/ /de nyid las/ gzhogs gcig gug pa kha yo mgo bo 'dar/ /tshigs tho gas mig rengs dran nyams gnyid log dngangs/ /zhes pa ste/ gzhogs 83

gcig gug pa'i nad ni khyab byed rlung gis kha sogs phyogs so sor g.yo bar byed cing mgo 'dar sig sig byed pa dang / tshigs thogs zhes skad cha gsal por mi thon par mig gi 'byed 'dzum nyams nas mig zung dang / lus kyi smad rongs shing snying gi rtsa phran g.yo ba dad gzer bas dran shes brtan po med pa chags la/ gal te gnyid du log kyang gnyid mthug po ma khug par sems nang dngangs skrag skyed par byed pa'o/ /de nyid las/ rtsa 'dzin rlung khrag spyi bo'i rtsar zhugs te/ /nad tshabs drag la spyi gtsug sha mdog nag /ces pa ste/ rtsa 'dzin ni spyi bor gnas pa'i 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i rtsa la rlung zhugs nas mgo po'i g.yas su reg bya rtsub la lam seng sman bcos ma byung na/ nad tshabs che bas spyi gtsug gi sha mdog nag la zug gzer che zhing / rlung de srog rtsar zhugs na nad de gso dka' bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid las/ gzhogs phyed skams pa tshor med bya ba nyams/ / zhes pa ste/ gzhogs phyed skams pa ni rlung khrag gi nad stobs rgyas nas lus po'i gzhogs phyed rlung gis bzung nas de gnas pa'i rtsa dang rgyus pa skams par byas nas na zug med pa brkyangs bskums kyi bya ba nyams pa yin/ /de nyid las/ lus kun skams pa thams cad de dang 'dra/ /zhes pa ste/ lus kun skams pa zhes bya ba'i nad ni lus po'i rtsa dang chu ba rgyus 84

gcig gug pa'i nad ni khyab byed rlung gis kha sogs phyogs so sor g.yo bar byed cing mgo 'dar sig sig byed pa dang / tshigs thogs zhes skad cha gsal por mi thon par mig gi 'byed 'dzum nyams nas mig zung dang / lus kyi smad rongs shing snying gi rtsa phran g.yo ba dad gzer bas dran shes brtan po med pa chags la/ gal te gnyid du log kyang gnyid mthug po ma khug par sems nang dngangs skrag skyed par byed pa'o/ /de nyid las/ rtsa 'dzin rlung khrag spyi bo'i rtsar zhugs te/ /nad tshabs drag la spyi gtsug sha mdog nag /ces pa ste/ rtsa 'dzin ni spyi bor gnas pa'i 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i rtsa la rlung zhugs nas mgo po'i g.yas su reg bya rtsub la lam seng sman bcos ma byung na/ nad tshabs che bas spyi gtsug gi sha mdog nag la zug gzer che zhing / rlung de srog rtsar zhugs na nad de gso dka' bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid las/ gzhogs phyed skams pa tshor med bya ba nyams/ / zhes pa ste/ gzhogs phyed skams pa ni rlung khrag gi nad stobs rgyas nas lus po'i gzhogs phyed rlung gis bzung nas de gnas pa'i rtsa dang rgyus pa skams par byas nas na zug med pa brkyangs bskums kyi bya ba nyams pa yin/ /de nyid las/ lus kun skams pa thams cad de dang 'dra/ /zhes pa ste/ lus kun skams pa zhes bya ba'i nad ni lus po'i rtsa dang chu ba rgyus 84

pa sogs kyi byed las kyi nus mthu nyams pa yin la/ de yang dang po yan lag gi sha sgrim nyams pa dang / de nas rim pa bzhin du lus kun skam par 'gyur ba yin yang gzhogs phyed skam pa las nad stobs chung ba'i dbang gis gso sla ba'o/ /de nyid las/ shing rengs dgye dgu mi shes shing ltar rengs / /zhes pa ste/ shing rengs zhes pa'i nad ni ma zhu ba dang bad kun grang bas rgyu byas nas lus po'i steng 'og tu rgyu ba'i rlung gi lam bkag cing / me mnyam dang mchin mcher rtsibs logs kyi rtsa'i nang du nad stobs yongs su rgyas shing / da dung rgyu long dang brang khog nang du shing bcug pa ltar 'dra bar yar mar dgye gug mi shes par lus nyid shing ltar rengs shing mthar rkang pa nang du 'khums shing / bus mo long du 'byar nas rkang pa'i rting pa brla la 'byar bar 'gyu ra ro / /de nyid las/ dpung 'ja' phrag zhugs 'degs sogs bya nyams na// zhes pa ste/ rlung nad dpung 'ja'i nad kyis btab pa na/ dang po nyid du rlung dpung pa'i phrag par zhugs shing / na zug btang ba dang / de nas phrag pa'i rtsa nyams nas phyogs gcig tu 'then zhing / rim/ pas dpung ba'i 'degs 'jog gi bya ba nyams pa'o/ /de nyid las/ bi sha rtse ni lag sor bya ba nyams / /zhes pa ste/ bi sha rtse'i rlung nad kyis btab na lag pa'i mthil rtsa'i rlung gsang gi rtsar rlung 85

zhugs shing / dang po phul mdzub srin lag yang yang ber ba'i mngon rtags sto na zhing / de nas gnas de'i rtsa phran spyi dang bye brag sor mo'i chu rgyus 'khums nas lag pa'i so ra mo'i 'gul bskyod kyi bya ba nyams pa'o/ /de nyid las/ sra 'theng chu ba brla nang la zhugs pa/ /'gro 'daratshigs lhod 'theng zhing rkang pa 'phyes/ /zhes pa ste / rlung nad sra 'theng ni lus po'i chu ba la rlung zhugs nas/ de yang dang ngo rked pa'i phyogs su gnas shing rim pas brla sha'i nang gi chu ba skyon can chags te/ rusatshigs sbyor ba'i chu ba'i byed las zhan par gyur nas tshigs mtsham/sa lhod cing / rkang pa 'gyes zhes rkang pa zha ba rang ma yin par 'gro ba'i tshe rkang pa 'dar zhing 'theng 'theng byed pa la mtshan mo'i gnyid dus su rang 'gul gyi rkang pa 'gul bskyo da byed pa bcas so// / de nyid las/ brla rengs bad kun tshil 'phel brla rus zhen/ /grang zhing tshor med 'degs dka' snyi ba 'ong / /zhes pa ste/ brla rengs kyi rlung nad ni bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos ma/thun pa'i zas skom dang spyod lam/ de bzhin gnas dus sogs 'byar bag kha mngar snyi bsi'/ can gyi rigs bsten drags pa'i mthar 'grangs rjes su nyal ba dang / ha cang dal bar 'dug pas bad kun gyi tshil mang du 'phel nas brla nang gi rus pa'i rtsa phran la zhen cing chags nas/ gnas der rlung zhugs pa'i sged rkyen gyis brla g.yas g.yon du drod mi khug pa dang / skrangs ba/ na 86

zug gtong ba/ 'gro dus dmigs bsal dpyi mig dang / pus mo/ brla sha bcas yar 'degs par dka' zhing lci ba'o/ /de nyid las/ rlung khrag pus mor skrangs pa lce spyang mgo /zhes pa ste/rlung nad ce spyang mgo ni rlung dang khrag chu ser las bskyed pa'i nad rkang pa'i ngar gdung nas bal nag bar gcan gzan ce spyang gi mgo dbyibs ltar skya gsob dmar khra can skrangs shing / gnas der rlung gis g.yos pa las ba spu'i khung bu mngon gsal dod por mthong la/ yang gyen phyogs su 'gro dus mi bde bar brtse ba dang / mar thur du bab dus rkang pa tshugs — mi brtan par na ba bcas byung ngo / / de nyid las/ long mor zhugs pa rlung nad tsher ma ste/ /zhes pa ste/rlung nad tsher ma can ni rkang pa'i long tshigs kyi 'og tu rlung zhugs nas 'gro dus rkang par tsher ma zug pa bzhin na zug gtong zhang / mthar rkang pa ring thung shor ba na gom pa spo dus 'khyog 'khyog byed bzhin yod/ /de nyid las/ rting chur zhugs na byin rengs gzugs 'khums yin//zhes pa ste/ rlung nad gzugs 'khums ni/ rkang pa'i rting par rlung zhugs shing rjes su brla'i nang nas gyen du song ste/ rkang pa'i nywa byin rengs pa la gzugs 'khums zhes brjod do/ / de nyid las/ gzugs 'khums bi sha rtse sdom kha lir bshad/ /ces pa ste/ de ltar bshad ma thag pa 'i gzugs 'khums dang bi sha rtse lag sor 87

gyi bya ba nyams pa gnyis lhan cig tu bsdongs pa'i nad la rlung nad kha lir zhes bya ba la go ba yin/ /de nyid las/ rkang pa brtse ba rkang brtse zhes bya ste/ zhes pa ste/ /rlung nad rkang pa brtse ba ni bad dzin grang ba'i nad stobs rkang pa'i mthe bong dang / sor mor babs shing 'thim pa la rlung zhugs nas rkang pa mi bde bar tsha gces gtses byed cing / rkang pa'i reg bya rtsub pa dang skam pa'i snang tshul ston pa yin/ / de nyid las/ rkang pa tsha ba drod bcas 'gro tshe tsha/ zhes pa ste/ /rlung nad rkang pa tsha ba ni khrag mkhris rlung gis g.yos pas 'gro dus rkang par tsha ba rgyas shing / tsha 'ur dang tsha 'khyug brgyab pa bcas rigs kyi rlung nad nyi shu'o/ / de nyid las / gnas la sbyar na lpags la rlung grams pa/ /gas snyam reg pa rtsub la brtse ba yin/ /shar zhugs spangs tsub mdog 'gyur 'bru ma pa byung / /rtsar zhugs rtsa de stong la sbom por spangs/ /rus zhugs zug che sha skam nyams stobs mdzad/ /ces pa ste/ gnyis pa gnas kyi dbang las rlung nad zhi shu rtsa gnyis yod cing / de dag ni rlung 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum las gtso bo rlung 'phel ba dang zad pa gnyis las byung zhing / gnod bya bcu la gnas pa yin/ de yang dang po/ rlung pags par 'grams pa na pags par ser kha gas pa'i tshor snang byung zhing / lag pas 88

gyi bya ba nyams pa gnyis lhan cig tu bsdongs pa'i nad la rlung nad kha lir zhes bya ba la go ba yin/ /de nyid las/ rkang pa brtse ba rkang brtse zhes bya ste/ zhes pa ste/ /rlung nad rkang pa brtse ba ni bad dzin grang ba'i nad stobs rkang pa'i mthe bong dang / sor mor babs shing 'thim pa la rlung zhugs nas rkang pa mi bde bar tsha gces gtses byed cing / rkang pa'i reg bya rtsub pa dang skam pa'i snang tshul ston pa yin/ / de nyid las/ rkang pa tsha ba drod bcas 'gro tshe tsha/ zhes pa ste/ /rlung nad rkang pa tsha ba ni khrag mkhris rlung gis g.yos pas 'gro dus rkang par tsha ba rgyas shing / tsha 'ur dang tsha 'khyug brgyab pa bcas rigs kyi rlung nad nyi shu'o/ / de nyid las / gnas la sbyar na lpags la rlung grams pa/ /gas snyam reg pa rtsub la brtse ba yin/ /shar zhugs spangs tsub mdog 'gyur 'bru ma pa byung / /rtsar zhugs rtsa de stong la sbom por spangs/ /rus zhugs zug che sha skam nyams stobs mdzad/ /ces pa ste/ gnyis pa gnas kyi dbang las rlung nad zhi shu rtsa gnyis yod cing / de dag ni rlung 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum las gtso bo rlung 'phel ba dang zad pa gnyis las byung zhing / gnod bya bcu la gnas pa yin/ de yang dang po/ rlung pags par 'grams pa na pags par ser kha gas pa'i tshor snang byung zhing / lag pas 88

re ga pa'i tshe pags pa rtsub la mi bde bar ba spur brtse rag langs pa yin/sha la rlung rgyas shing zhusas pa na sha rnams rdog sdog tu skrangs shing / reg bya rtsub la lpags pa'i mdog 'gyur la/ 'brum thor byung / rtsar rlung rgyu zhing na ba'i tshe gang na ba'i rtsa de'i steng du sngo 'khyus ger sbom por skre ngas jipa yin/ rus la rlung zhugs na ha cang gi na zug che zhing rlung rang gi mtshan nyid kyang yang rtsub kyi cha 'phel ba des sha skem zhing lus ngo 'i nyams stobs mar bri ba yin/ / de nyid la sa/ snying zhugs stod gang shus 'debs shes/ pa 'phyo/ /smro ra zhugs byad skrangs mi khogs lbu gso ba lu/ /mchin zhugs bkres dus g.yal mang 'phyongs nas na/ /mcher zhugs lus skrangs/ sbo 'khrog steng du gzer /mkhal zhugs mkhal rked na zhing rna ba 'on/ /zhes pa ste/ don snying la rlung zhugs na lus po'i stod rlung gis gang zhing / zhes 'debs zhes dbugs ring gtong ba dang / shes pa yang yang gnas nges med du 'phyo ba yin/ glo la rlung zhugs na ni gdong gi byad dbyibs sogs skrangs shing / glo 'gog mi thub pa ra gal te gro khogs nas gro lu la lbu ba gsob can byung / de bzhin mchin par rlung zhugs na zas zhu ba'i dus sam bkres pa'i dus der g.yal stong ma nga du rgyag pa dang / mchin pa dpyang thag la dar btags pa lta bur 'phyongs 'phyongs su thur du lhug thig byed snyam pa'i sgo nas na ba dang / de bzhin du mcher par rlung zhugs na pho 89

re ga pa'i tshe pags pa rtsub la mi bde bar ba spur brtse rag langs pa yin/sha la rlung rgyas shing zhusas pa na sha rnams rdog sdog tu skrangs shing / reg bya rtsub la lpags pa'i mdog 'gyur la/ 'brum thor byung / rtsar rlung rgyu zhing na ba'i tshe gang na ba'i rtsa de'i steng du sngo 'khyus ger sbom por skre ngas jipa yin/ rus la rlung zhugs na ha cang gi na zug che zhing rlung rang gi mtshan nyid kyang yang rtsub kyi cha 'phel ba des sha skem zhing lus ngo 'i nyams stobs mar bri ba yin/ / de nyid la sa/ snying zhugs stod gang shus 'debs shes/ pa 'phyo/ /smro ra zhugs byad skrangs mi khogs lbu gso ba lu/ /mchin zhugs bkres dus g.yal mang 'phyongs nas na/ /mcher zhugs lus skrangs/ sbo 'khrog steng du gzer /mkhal zhugs mkhal rked na zhing rna ba 'on/ /zhes pa ste/ don snying la rlung zhugs na lus po'i stod rlung gis gang zhing / zhes 'debs zhes dbugs ring gtong ba dang / shes pa yang yang gnas nges med du 'phyo ba yin/ glo la rlung zhugs na ni gdong gi byad dbyibs sogs skrangs shing / glo 'gog mi thub pa ra gal te gro khogs nas gro lu la lbu ba gsob can byung / de bzhin mchin par rlung zhugs na zas zhu ba'i dus sam bkres pa'i dus der g.yal stong ma nga du rgyag pa dang / mchin pa dpyang thag la dar btags pa lta bur 'phyongs 'phyongs su thur du lhug thig byed snyam pa'i sgo nas na ba dang / de bzhin du mcher par rlung zhugs na pho 89

ba'i stod dang mchu sogs lus skrangs shing dgong mo pho ba dang tsha/nga gi gnas su sbos shing 'khrog 'khrog byed/ da dung mcher pa'i steng du gzer ba yin/ mkhal mar rlung zhugs/ na rtags su mkhal rked kyi 'khor na zhing / rna ba'i nang 'ur sgra byung zhing mthar rna ba 'on par gyur pa yin//de nyid la sa/ zas la rlung zhugs kha zas zos rjes na/ /ma zhu'i gnas zhugs sgrog skyugs yi ga 'gag /sbo 'khrog skom dad che la dbugs mi bde//zhu ba'i gnas zhugs gzer zhing sbo 'khrog byed/ /mkhris zhugs sbo gzer 'ju dka' mis/ sprin ser/ /gcin zhugs lhung pa bsil sbo sri 'am snyi//mkhal zhugs 'bur 'dril mngal khrag sdom mam 'dzag /ces pa ste/ spyir zas skom bza' btung byed pa'i tshe dang po pho ba'i nang du me drod rnam gsum gyis myag zhu dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i byed las kyi brgyud rim/ 'a/ bltos nas ma zhu ba'i gnas pho bar bzhag cing / de'i rjes/ snod kyi mkhris khu dang rgyu ma gnyis byed las lhan cig tu byed cing / zas skom zhu bzhin pa'i dus la 'dres nas rgyu sor bcu gcig dang / rgyu ma zhu bzhin pa'i gnas su 'jog cing mthar zas/ skom zhu tshar nas gnas long du lhung ba'i dus su zhu ba'i gnas long bcas phan tshun bltos sa ltos 'jogs kyis zhu dang ma/ zhu'i gnas su dbye ba phye ba yin te/ de yang ma zhu ba'i gnas pho bar rlung zhugs pa'i skabs su zas sko ma gang ya nga rung ba zhig zos shing tshonathung ma thab/ pho stod zas lam gyi gre ba dang bcas pa'i sa ra kha zas slebs 90

ma thag tu tsha grang gang yin yang na zug btang ba dang / dbugs rgod cing / lto ba la stong sgrog byed cing tsher ma zug pa lta bu'i tsha brab byed pa ma zad ga dus yin kyang zas zos ma thag tu na zhing mi bde ba byung / kha zas zhu bzhin pa'i gnas rgyu mar rlung zhugs na de'i rtags su sgreg pa rgyag pa dang / skyug pa shor ba/ yi ga 'gag pa/ sbo 'khrog byed pa/ da dung rlung khrag bsdongs pa'i mthus skom dad che la dbugs gtong mi bde ba bcas byung / zhu ba'i gnas long du rlung zhugs na khrag long / rtsam long / srin long bcas long ga rnam gsum las dbus rtsam long la zug —gzer ster zhing / sbo 'khrog byed la bshang ba 'gags pa dang / chu sri zhes gcin pa gtong dka' ba/ rked pa dang mjug to ste gzhug chung gi rus pa na ba bcas kyi rtags ston/ snod kyi mkhris par rlung zhugs na mchin mkhris kyi steng du gzer zhing rlung gi 'tshang bud che la/ sdod mkhris ma zhu ba'i gnas su lhung bas zas 'ju dka' la lhag don mchin mkhris kyi ngo bo tsha ba las mig sprin ser mdog tu gyur ba/ gcin la rlung zhugs par gyur na rang bzhin gyis sgang phug la gnod pas/ lhang pa grang zhing bsil la smos pa dang / gcin pa nyung nyung du sri ba'am yang na snyi ba byung / mngal du rlung zhugs par gyur na bud med kyi zla mtshan mngal gyi nang du rlung gi byed pas 'bur zhing 'dril la/ mngal khrag gam yang na zla mtshan dus su ma babs pa'am yang na dus min gang byung du phyir mang 91

po 'dzag pa bcas byung ba yin no/ / de nyid las/ mgor zhugs mgo 'khor bzi 'khyoms gtad mi tshugs //mig zhugs rtsa dmar lug snyam bser bu gnod/ /rna bar zhugs pa 'ur 'khrog stong snyam gzer/ /sna zhugs sna 'gag chu 'dza' dri mi tshor/ /sor zhugs ber ba langs nas na zhing skrangs/ /zhes pa ste/ dbang po lnga la me tog gam nad rtags shar ba'i tshul gyis dper na/ skabs 'dir dbang po mgo la rlung zhugs na/ klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen ngo dang 'brel ba che bas na/ mgo 'khor zhing phyi yul du sa gzhi 'khyoms pa'i snang tshul gyis bzi 'khyom 'khyom byed pa des/ 'gro ba'i skabs su gtad mi tshugs zhes rang tshugs zin mi thub par 'khyor 'gro ba yin la/ de bzhin du mig la rlung zhugs na/ mig gi rgyal mo'i rtsa phran la gnod pas mig rtsa dmar zhing lug pa'i snang ba 'char la/ phyi'i rlung bser bu phog pa tsam gyis gnod pa yin/ rna bar rlung zhugs na/ rna ba'i nang du don med 'ur 'ur gyi sgra sgrog cing stong snyam sems pa dang / snar zhugs na/ sna 'gag pas sna chu yang yang thon zhing dri mi tshor ba yin/ sor rlung zhugs na/ so ber zhing langs la so rnyil dmar po chags shing skrangs pa bcas dang / dbang po lnga ni mi(ga dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus bcas yin kyang 'dir dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna so bcas gcig tu brtsis pa bca sa 'jug sgo drug gi steng du dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba bcas bdun no/ /92

de nyid las/ srog rlung zas rtsub smyung dang drag shul las/ /shugs bkag btsir bas 'khrugs te mgo bo 'khor/ /snying 'phyos dbugs sdud dka' zhing mid mi thub/ / ces pa ste/ bye brag nang tshegs kyis dbye ba'i rlung srog 'dzin rnam par gyur na/ rlung rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i zas skom ro kha ba dang nus pa yang zhing rtsub pa'i rigs yun ring du bsten drags pa'am yang na ma zos par smyung bar gnas pa/ drag shul gyi las ches cher byas pa/ chags pa mang du spyad drags pa/ zungs khrag mang du shor ba/ bshang gci sogs 'byung bzhin du bkag pa dang /mi 'byung bzhin du nan gyis bcir ba sogs kyis nang lus khams kyi rlung 'khrugs te mgo bo 'khor ba dang / snying 'phyos zhes snying g.yug pa dang / dbugs nang du sdud par dka' zhing zas skom mid mi thub pa bcas kyi nad du gyur ba yin/ / de nyid las/ stod rgyu sgreg skyug bkag dang ngu dgod drags/ /khur snyi btegs pas 'khrugs te dig cing lkugs/ /smra dka' stobs chung kha yo dran pa nyams/ /zhes pa sne/ gyen rgyu'i rlung nyid 'khrugs par 'gyur na ni/ rang bzhin nyid du sgreg pa 'byin pa dang / skyug pa 'chor 'byung bzhin du bkag pa dang / sems sdug che cher byas nas ngu drags pa/ yang na ha cang gi gad mo dgod drags pa/ lus po'i gshed stobs dang mi 'tshams pa'i khur ljid po yar btegs pas rlung 'khrugs te/ smra brjod 93

de nyid las/ srog rlung zas rtsub smyung dang drag shul las/ /shugs bkag btsir bas 'khrugs te mgo bo 'khor/ /snying 'phyos dbugs sdud dka' zhing mid mi thub/ / ces pa ste/ bye brag nang tshegs kyis dbye ba'i rlung srog 'dzin rnam par gyur na/ rlung rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i zas skom ro kha ba dang nus pa yang zhing rtsub pa'i rigs yun ring du bsten drags pa'am yang na ma zos par smyung bar gnas pa/ drag shul gyi las ches cher byas pa/ chags pa mang du spyad drags pa/ zungs khrag mang du shor ba/ bshang gci sogs 'byung bzhin du bkag pa dang /mi 'byung bzhin du nan gyis bcir ba sogs kyis nang lus khams kyi rlung 'khrugs te mgo bo 'khor ba dang / snying 'phyos zhes snying g.yug pa dang / dbugs nang du sdud par dka' zhing zas skom mid mi thub pa bcas kyi nad du gyur ba yin/ / de nyid las/ stod rgyu sgreg skyug bkag dang ngu dgod drags/ /khur snyi btegs pas 'khrugs te dig cing lkugs/ /smra dka' stobs chung kha yo dran pa nyams/ /zhes pa sne/ gyen rgyu'i rlung nyid 'khrugs par 'gyur na ni/ rang bzhin nyid du sgreg pa 'byin pa dang / skyug pa 'chor 'byung bzhin du bkag pa dang / sems sdug che cher byas nas ngu drags pa/ yang na ha cang gi gad mo dgod drags pa/ lus po'i gshed stobs dang mi 'tshams pa'i khur ljid po yar btegs pas rlung 'khrugs te/ smra brjod 93

kyi sgra mi gsal zhing dig cing ngag lkugs par gyur ba dang / lus po'i gshed shor nas kha yon por 'khyog cing dran pa 'i dbang po nyams par gyur pa'o/ / de nyid las/ khyab byed 'gro 'dug rtsed mo drags pa dang / /'jigs dang yid mug kha zas rtsub pas 'khrugs/ /snying spyugs brgyal 'bog mang du smra ba dang / /'gro 'dod 'jigs skrag mi snyan tshig gis srong / /zhes pa ste/ khyab byed rlung nad kyi ngo bor gyur na/ dus tshod ring por yar mar ha cang 'gro drags pa dang / rlan gsher che ba'i sa cha bsil/ sar rgyun ring por bsdad drags pa/ bang rtsal 'dzings pa la sogs pa'i rtsed mo'i rigs ha cang rtsed drags pa/ gdon sogs rkyen ngan gang yang rung bas sems kyi brtan pa 'phrog nas 'jigs snang tshad med skyes pa/ pha ma spun gnyen sogs dang kha bral ba'am las don gang zhig la byus nyes tshabs chen byung nas tshor ba sdug bsngal bas yid mug pa'i mya ngan byed drags pa/ de bzhin ra sha dang phag sha ja gar po sogs yang zhing rtsub pa'i kha zas zos drags pa sogs kyis rkyen byas te/ snying spyugs zhes snying phyogs su/ gcus shing dran med du brgyal ba'am yang na sems 'bog pa dang / don med kyi skad cha mang po bshad cing gang sar 'gro 'dod pa/ khyad par du sem sa la 'jigs skrag chen po skyes pa dang / mi snyan pa'i gtam thos pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis khyab byed rlung gi nad srong bar byed/ /94

de nyid las/ mnyam gnas 'jug nga/ku'i zas dang nyin gnyid kyis//'khrugs pas pho ba grang zhing zas mi len/ /skyug cing kha zas mi 'ju gsus khrag 'dres/ /zhes pa ste/ me mnyam rlung 'khrugs te nad du gyur na ni/sngo ngad rul sungs rjen zas snyi bsil can 'ju dka' ba'i zas zos drags pa dang / nyin mor gnyid ha cang nyal drags pa bcas kyis me mnyam rlung gi mthu nyams shing / kha zas g.yos shing 'ju bar byed pa'i gnas pho ba'i drod nyams shing / grang bar gyur pa'i rkyen gyis kha zas yar gyen du skyu ga cing zas za mi 'dod la zos kyang 'ju dka' ba/ gsus khrag 'dres zhes pa pho ba'i rtsa lam nang ngan khrag 'phel zhing me mnyam gyi rlung rgyu ba'i lam bkag par byed/ / de nyid las/ thur sel bshang gci 'phyen dang khu ba yi/ /shubs bkag bcir bas 'khrugs te rus mig khol/ /yan lag 'khrul 'phyes dbugs ngan dri chu sdom/ /zhes pa ste/ thur sel rlung gyi byed las log par gyur pa'i rkyen gyis rgyun du rang bzhin gyis byung ba'i bshang ba dang / gcin pa/ 'phyen nam rtug dri/ de bzhin khu ba sogs btsan shugs kyis yun ring bkag pa'am yang na mi babs bzhin du nan cher btsir ba la sogs pas/ lus kyi smad bshang dang / long ga zhang pa/ gsang gnas / brla sha sogs kyi gnas su rlung tshul bzhin du rgyu ba de 'khrugs nas/ lus smad kyi 'tshang ra'i rus pa dang dpyid mig sogs su khol bur 95

na zhing / de bzhin lus po'i tshigs mtshams ltod por gyur pa'i dbang gis yan lag zha ba'am 'phyes pa dang / rlu nga gi byed las lo ga nas yar gyen du rgyu ba na/ rang bzhin gyis kha nang du dbugs kyi dri ngan pa byung zhing / dus dus su gcin ma babs par sdom pa ra byed pa yin no/ / de nyid las/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i bye brag gi rlung srog 'dzin dang mkhris pa 'dres pa/ gyen rgyu dang mkhris pa 'dres pa/ khyab byed dang mkhris pa 'dres pa/ me mnyam dang mkhris pa 'dres pa/ thur sel dang mkhris pa 'dres pa dang bcas gang yang rung ba zhig byung na/ rlung mkhris gnyis bsdongs pa'i byed las kyi cha nas lus la tsha ba'i rtags thon zhing / mig sprin dang dri chu sod ba bcas byung / yang de bzhin du srog 'dzin dang bad kun 'dres pa/ gyen rgyu dang bad kun 'dres pa/ khyab byed dang bad kun 'dres pa/ me mnyam dang bad kun 'dres pa/ thur sel dang bad kun 'dres pa dang bcas lnga po de dag gang yang rung ba zhig byung na/ bad rlung gnyis bsdongs pa'i byed las kyi cha nas lus po snyi zhing bsil la lhag par shes pa rmongs bag tu gyur pa bcas bad kun dang mkhris par 'dres pa'i nad bcu'o/ /de ltar rigs kyi sgo nas rlung nad gi shu dang / gnas kyi sgo nas 'jug sgo drug dang dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba gcig nang tshigs rlung lnga nad du gyur pa dang / bad dzin dang mkhris par 'dres pa bcu bcas khyon 96

bsdoms pas rlung nad bzhi bcu zhe gnyis yod/ lho 'dzam bu gling pa'i 'gro ba sem sa can rnams skye ba'i dang por nyer len gyi rgyu khu khrag sems gsum la lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i rlung gi nad ba'i bcu rtsa gnyis 'di dag la rlung rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i rkyen dus gdon zas spyod bzhi po gang yang rung ba zhig dang 'phrad par gyur ba'i dus de'i tshe na/thog mar rlung gis nad yongs rdzogs kyi sna 'dren cing bar du lus la mi bzod pa'i zug ju mngon gyur skye bar byed la/ mthar lus can kun 'jig rten 'di'i nang 'khor ba'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la rol bzhin yod kyang lus sems gnyis kha bral te/ tshe srog gi mjug sdud par byed pa'i tshul 'di la yang yang bsams na/ phyi nang gi dngos po'i chos thams cad 'dus byas yin zhing / de yang skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par tshe srog la 'gal rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad pas dus yun skar cha gcig tsam yang mi sdod par rtag par 'gro bzhin yod/ /gnyis pa/ mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug gi nyes pa bstan pa/ji skad du bshad rgyud las/ mkhris pa'i nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis// /rigs kyi dbye ba thang la lhags pa dang / /gnas gyur kha lud rtsa rgyug rnam pa gsum/ /gnas 97

bsdoms pas rlung nad bzhi bcu zhe gnyis yod/ lho 'dzam bu gling pa'i 'gro ba sem sa can rnams skye ba'i dang por nyer len gyi rgyu khu khrag sems gsum la lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i rlung gi nad ba'i bcu rtsa gnyis 'di dag la rlung rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i rkyen dus gdon zas spyod bzhi po gang yang rung ba zhig dang 'phrad par gyur ba'i dus de'i tshe na/thog mar rlung gis nad yongs rdzogs kyi sna 'dren cing bar du lus la mi bzod pa'i zug ju mngon gyur skye bar byed la/ mthar lus can kun 'jig rten 'di'i nang 'khor ba'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la rol bzhin yod kyang lus sems gnyis kha bral te/ tshe srog gi mjug sdud par byed pa'i tshul 'di la yang yang bsams na/ phyi nang gi dngos po'i chos thams cad 'dus byas yin zhing / de yang skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par tshe srog la 'gal rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad pas dus yun skar cha gcig tsam yang mi sdod par rtag par 'gro bzhin yod/ /gnyis pa/ mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug gi nyes pa bstan pa/ji skad du bshad rgyud las/ mkhris pa'i nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis// /rigs kyi dbye ba thang la lhags pa dang / /gnas gyur kha lud rtsa rgyug rnam pa gsum/ /gnas 97

kyis dbye na sgo drug dbang po bdun/ /bye brag 'ju byed la sogs rnam gyur lnga/ /rlung dang bad kun 'dres pa bcu ru 'dod/ /dbye ba nyi shu rtsa drug mkhris pa'i nad/ /ces pa ste/ mkhris pa'i nad kyi dbye ba la spyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas gnyis su dbye zhing / spyi la yang rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis yod cing / dang po 'dir rigs/ kyi sgo nas dbye ba'i dbang du byas na nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa dang / me drod mkhris pa gzhan gyi gnas gyur/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor/ thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba bcas rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po/ nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa zer ba'i don ni/ man rgyud mkhris nad gso ba'i le'u las/ dang po rkyen bzhis mkhris pa 'phel ba ste/ /tshad pa gso ba'i skabs su rgyas par ston/ /zhes pa ste/ rnam par gyur pa'i mkhris tshad la go dgos shing / don du nad gzhi'i mkhris pa mtshan nyid bdun ldan zhes snum bcas rno zhing tsha la yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher ba bcas mtshan nyid kyi zur bdun dang ldan pa'i mkhris pa de rkyen dus gdon zas spyod bzhis bslangs te 'khrugs par gyur ba yin pas na/ tsha la rdo ba'i mkhris pa'i me drod de rnam par ma gyur pa'am nad kyi ngo bor ma gyur pa'i skabs su mkhris pa'i tsha ba rang gnas kyi ri la gnas pa yin zhing / de nyid rnam par gyur pa'am nad kyi ngo bor gyur na mkhris pa gzhan gnas su song ba/ zhes thang la lhags pas gnod bya 98

lus zungs dri ma dang bcas pa tsha bas sreg pa ste/ mkhris pa'i drod tshad kyis bsrul te rul du bcug na myur du srog 'phrog par byed do/ / de nyid las/ gnyis pa rlung dang ma zhu bad kun khrag /'ju byed mkhris pa'i yul du zhugs pa yis/ /mkhris pa'i sgo phrogs phyi ru byer ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ me drod mkhris pa gzhan gyi gnas gyur ba'i nad ni/ rlung dang /ma zhu ba/ bad rka/na/ khrag bcas kyi shugs rkyen gtso bor byas nas de dag gang yang rung ba zhig 'ju byed dam me drod kyi mkhris pa zhes rlung la sogs pa'i nad dang dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs/ bshang ba la sogs pa'i dri ma bcas kun gyi drod tshad kyi gzhi gang yin pa de'i gnas spyi dang khyad par pho long dang rgyu sor bcu gcig gi gnas su zhugs pa'i dbang gis me drod mkhris pa'i go sa'am go yul 'phrog cing sdod sa med pas na/ 'ju byed kyi mkhris pa de nyid lus zungs rgyu ba'i bu ga'i nang lhan cig tu phyi dbang po'i sgo ru byer te mig sogs ser po chags pa'i rtags/ ston pa yin/ / de nyid las/ gsum pa pho mchin skran gyis mkhris pa bcar yang na mkhris pa rang la skran zhugs pas/ /mkhris pa dbang med phyi ru kha lud dam/ /'grams sam rlung gis mkhris kha shor ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor gyi nad ni/ sdor gyi rkyal pa bkal ba dang 'dra ba'i snod mkhris kyi gnas pho mchin dang nye 'brel che ba'i sar pho skran dang 99

mchin skran chags pa'i dbang gis snod kyi mkhris thum btsir ba dang / yang na/ snod mkhris rang la mkhris skran byung ba na/ mkhris khu rang dbang med par rim pas kha nas lud pa yin/ tsha ba 'phel nas lus zungs la 'grams pa dang / yang na rlung gis glo bur du bus pa'i cha/jus mkhris khu phyir btsan thabs kyis shor ba bcas so de nyid las/ bzhi pa snod mkhris 'ju byed gang yang rung / /'grams 'khrugs rims rkyen mkhris pa 'phel ba'am/ /zas spyod rkyen gyis 'phel te rtsar lud pas/ /sha ser mig ser rnam pa gnyis su gyur/ /zhes pa ste/thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba'i nad ni/ nad gzhi'i mkhris pa mtshan zhin bdun ldan dang / me drod mkhris pa/ snod kyi mkhris pa bcas la thun mong zer zhing / de dag 'grams sam 'khrugs pa dang / de bzhin du rims nad gang rung gi rkyen gyis mkhris pa 'phel ba'am/ yang na zas dang spyod lam gyi rkyen gyis mkhris khu 'phel te rtsar lud pas lus kyi sha pags kyi mdog ser ོ/ra gyur bas na/ mkhris pa sha ser gyi nad dang / mig gi sprin pa ser por gyur ba ri bong gi mig ltar ser por gyur ba bcas rnam pa gnyis yod/ /de nyed las/ gnas kyis dbye na pags la 'grams pa dang / /sha la rgyas dang rtsa ru rgyu nga/ dang / /rus la zhen dang don babs snod du lhung //dbang po lnga la me tog shar dang bdun/ /don ni gro snying mcher pa mkhal 100

ma dang / /snod ni pho long rgyu ma lgang nga mngal/ /dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce'o/ /de ltar bcu dgu gnas kyi dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na 'jug sgo drug las dang po/ mkhris pa pags la 'grams pa na za 'phrug byed cing / sha la mkhris pa rgyas pa na gnas der za 'phrug langs nas shu ba chags pa dang / thor pa 'byung ba/ de 'phrug na chu ser dang khrag dang mkhris pa bcas 'dzag pa yin/ rtsa ru mkhris pa rgyu ba na yan lag gi tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi tshigs gzhi dang / nya gzhi/de bzhin dro ba'i gnas mchan khung dang / brla khung bcas kyi nang du za zhing rim pas lus kun la za 'phrug langs pa dang / rtsa mig rnams su — mkhris pa rgyu zhing gang ba na lpags pa dang mig sprin ser po chags pa/ sa/la te gtar brgyab na khrag 'don rgyu med par mkhris pa zad mar te mkhris pa kho na rang thon pa yin/ mkhris pa dus pa la zhen na/ lus kyi tshigs thams cad la zhen cing chas/sa nas lus kyi gnas khol bu khol bur na zhing / sha skam ngo chags nas rus tshigs rnams kyi steng du skrangs pa yi na/ /don snying la mkhris pa babs na/ byang khog stod kyi nang snying dang glo ba'i gnas su mi bde ba chags pa dang / snying gi me tog lce ser zhing gnyid chung la sems nang du zas skom grang mo'i rigs za snying 'dod pa byung / gro ba la mkhris pa zhugs na me tog gi tshul du sna khung nang du snabs lud kyi mdog ser por 'ong la/ mchen par mkhris pa zhugs na lus kyi sha mdog sngo zhing lag 101

ma dang / /snod ni pho long rgyu ma lgang nga mngal/ /dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce'o/ /de ltar bcu dgu gnas kyi dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na 'jug sgo drug las dang po/ mkhris pa pags la 'grams pa na za 'phrug byed cing / sha la mkhris pa rgyas pa na gnas der za 'phrug langs nas shu ba chags pa dang / thor pa 'byung ba/ de 'phrug na chu ser dang khrag dang mkhris pa bcas 'dzag pa yin/ rtsa ru mkhris pa rgyu ba na yan lag gi tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi tshigs gzhi dang / nya gzhi/de bzhin dro ba'i gnas mchan khung dang / brla khung bcas kyi nang du za zhing rim pas lus kun la za 'phrug langs pa dang / rtsa mig rnams su — mkhris pa rgyu zhing gang ba na lpags pa dang mig sprin ser po chags pa/ sa/la te gtar brgyab na khrag 'don rgyu med par mkhris pa zad mar te mkhris pa kho na rang thon pa yin/ mkhris pa dus pa la zhen na/ lus kyi tshigs thams cad la zhen cing chas/sa nas lus kyi gnas khol bu khol bur na zhing / sha skam ngo chags nas rus tshigs rnams kyi steng du skrangs pa yi na/ /don snying la mkhris pa babs na/ byang khog stod kyi nang snying dang glo ba'i gnas su mi bde ba chags pa dang / snying gi me tog lce ser zhing gnyid chung la sems nang du zas skom grang mo'i rigs za snying 'dod pa byung / gro ba la mkhris pa zhugs na me tog gi tshul du sna khung nang du snabs lud kyi mdog ser por 'ong la/ mchen par mkhris pa zhugs na lus kyi sha mdog sngo zhing lag 101

g.yas kyis rna shal bzung nas gru mo'i sar gnas mchin pa khel ba'i steng du na zhing / mgo na ba dang me tog gi tshul du mig nang tsha ba skye zhing / kha nang gi mchil ma ro bska la gcig tu 'dril ba byung / mcher par mkhris pa babs na/ lce dang mchu khra khra chags pa dang khrag rlan pa 'khru ba/ pho ba sbo 'dzing byed cing rkang pa g.yon pa skrangs nas yan lag gi ltu tshigs rnams na ba yin/ ma/khal mar mkhris pa babs na gom pa spo dus rkang pa snyi zhing sgrid pa dang / mkhal ma dang rked pa'i 'khor na ba dang / lhas par du rna ba'i rgyab ser po chags pa bcas so /de nyid las / snod pho bar mkhris pa ltung na thur du 'khru ba'am yar kha nang du mkhris pa skyug sa par byed cing / mkhris pa long dang rgyu mar lhung na mkhris pa mdog ser por bshal ba dang / sgang par thi nga na gcin pa nyung nyung las ma/ babs par sri ba'am rmi nga na dri chu yang yang bro zhing snyi ba'o/ mngal du mkhres pa lhung na mkhris pa mar 'dzag pa yin la/ gal te ma 'dzag na mnga'/ nang du mkhris pa 'dril nas mngal skra na sdog rdog chags par byed/ mdor na/ mkhris pa pags pa la 'grams pa dang / sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ rus la zhen pa/ don lnga la babs pa/ snod drug tu lhung ba bcas sgo drug go/de nyid las/ dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce bcas lnga las/ mgo la mkhris pa zhugs na mtshog ma dang / klad pa na zhing lhag par mgo la me 102

g.yas kyis rna shal bzung nas gru mo'i sar gnas mchin pa khel ba'i steng du na zhing / mgo na ba dang me tog gi tshul du mig nang tsha ba skye zhing / kha nang gi mchil ma ro bska la gcig tu 'dril ba byung / mcher par mkhris pa babs na/ lce dang mchu khra khra chags pa dang khrag rlan pa 'khru ba/ pho ba sbo 'dzing byed cing rkang pa g.yon pa skrangs nas yan lag gi ltu tshigs rnams na ba yin/ ma/khal mar mkhris pa babs na gom pa spo dus rkang pa snyi zhing sgrid pa dang / mkhal ma dang rked pa'i 'khor na ba dang / lhas par du rna ba'i rgyab ser po chags pa bcas so /de nyid las / snod pho bar mkhris pa ltung na thur du 'khru ba'am yar kha nang du mkhris pa skyug sa par byed cing / mkhris pa long dang rgyu mar lhung na mkhris pa mdog ser por bshal ba dang / sgang par thi nga na gcin pa nyung nyung las ma/ babs par sri ba'am rmi nga na dri chu yang yang bro zhing snyi ba'o/ mngal du mkhres pa lhung na mkhris pa mar 'dzag pa yin la/ gal te ma 'dzag na mnga'/ nang du mkhris pa 'dril nas mngal skra na sdog rdog chags par byed/ mdor na/ mkhris pa pags pa la 'grams pa dang / sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ rus la zhen pa/ don lnga la babs pa/ snod drug tu lhung ba bcas sgo drug go/de nyid las/ dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce bcas lnga las/ mgo la mkhris pa zhugs na mtshog ma dang / klad pa na zhing lhag par mgo la me 102

dang gi ma'i drod phog pa dang / zho dang shing tog skyur po'i rigs 'thung ba/ de bzhin mkhris pa ldang ba'i dus bzhi ste ston dpyid dang nyin dgung mtshan dgung bcas su ldang ba yin/ mig la mkhris pa zhugs na mig gi sprin pa ser po chags shing mig tsha ba'i rang bzhin la mkhris pa zhugs pa des tsha ba skye zhing mchi ma mang du byung / rna bar mkhris pa zhugs na na zug che ba ma zad rna ba'i nang du tsha ba skye zhing des chu ser 'dzag pa dang / snar mkhris pa zhugs na snabs lud kyi mdog ser po byung zhing sna'i mtshul pa rang bzhin gyis 'gags pa yin/ yang lce la mkhris pa zhugs na lce mdog ser po chags pa dang kha zas gang zos kyang lce la ro kha tig gi bro ba byung ba bcas so / de zhid las/ bye brag 'ju byed sgrub byed mdangs sgyur dang / /mthong byed mdog gsal rnam lngar gyur ba'o /rlung dang bad kun 'dres pa bcu ru gyur/ /ces pa ste/ bye brag nang tshegs kyi mkhris pa 'ju byed nad du gyur na/ lce ser la yang yang kha skom dad che zhing / kha zas gang zos kyang 'ju bar mi 'gyur la zas kyi dang ga rim bzhin 'gags par gyur/mkhris pa mdangs sgyur rnam par gyur na/ pho ba dang sha pags bar chu ser gyis ltem zhing khong nas pho ba zas snod la phug gi sul bzhi dang 'dra ba'i sha sgrim/ gyi nus pa shor nas pho ba lhug lhug chags shing lus po snyi la shed stobs chung par gyur nga 'o/ / 103

dang gi ma'i drod phog pa dang / zho dang shing tog skyur po'i rigs 'thung ba/ de bzhin mkhris pa ldang ba'i dus bzhi ste ston dpyid dang nyin dgung mtshan dgung bcas su ldang ba yin/ mig la mkhris pa zhugs na mig gi sprin pa ser po chags shing mig tsha ba'i rang bzhin la mkhris pa zhugs pa des tsha ba skye zhing mchi ma mang du byung / rna bar mkhris pa zhugs na na zug che ba ma zad rna ba'i nang du tsha ba skye zhing des chu ser 'dzag pa dang / snar mkhris pa zhugs na snabs lud kyi mdog ser po byung zhing sna'i mtshul pa rang bzhin gyis 'gags pa yin/ yang lce la mkhris pa zhugs na lce mdog ser po chags pa dang kha zas gang zos kyang lce la ro kha tig gi bro ba byung ba bcas so / de zhid las/ bye brag 'ju byed sgrub byed mdangs sgyur dang / /mthong byed mdog gsal rnam lngar gyur ba'o /rlung dang bad kun 'dres pa bcu ru gyur/ /ces pa ste/ bye brag nang tshegs kyi mkhris pa 'ju byed nad du gyur na/ lce ser la yang yang kha skom dad che zhing / kha zas gang zos kyang 'ju bar mi 'gyur la zas kyi dang ga rim bzhin 'gags par gyur/mkhris pa mdangs sgyur rnam par gyur na/ pho ba dang sha pags bar chu ser gyis ltem zhing khong nas pho ba zas snod la phug gi sul bzhi dang 'dra ba'i sha sgrim/ gyi nus pa shor nas pho ba lhug lhug chags shing lus po snyi la shed stobs chung par gyur nga 'o/ / 103

de nyid las/ mkhris pa sgrub byed nad kyi ngo bor gyur na ni/ snying spyugs zhes snying ga g.yugs pa dang / dbugs sna thung zhing rgod pa/ kha skom dad che ba/ zas skom gyi dang ga mi bde bar lus 'dar gsigs brgyab nas spo snying gi gnas su tsha ba che ba'i rtags ston pa yin/ mkhris pa mthong byed nad du gyur pa'i tshe/ mgo na zhing chang dang zho/ shing tog am sogs sgyur po'i rigs bsten na mig la gnod cing / mig sprin ser po'i mdog la mig gis blta ba'i tshe thag nye sar mthong yang rgyun ldan las ldog ste rgyang ring por mi mthong ba yin/ mkhris pa mdog gsal nad du gyur na/ lus po'i phyir sha drod che zhing sha pags kyi mdog sngo nag chags la lag pas reg pa'i tshe tsha ba che zhing reg bya rtsub por gyur ba bcas so//gong du bshad pa'i nang tshegs kyi mkhris pa 'ju byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ mdangs sgyur rlung dang 'dres pa/ sgrub byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ mthong byed rlung dang 'drime pa/ mdog gsal rlung dang 'dres pa dang / de bzhin du mkhris pa 'ju byed bad kun dang 'dres pa/ mdangs sgyur bad kun dang 'dres pa/ sgrub byed bad kun dang 'dres pa/ mthong byed bad kun dang 'dres pa/ mdog gsal bad kun dang 'dres pa bcas rlung dang bad kun gnyis po gang rung dang 'dres na/ rang rang so so'i mtshan nyid kyi chos dang mthun pa'i rtags ston pa bcas/ mdor bsdus na/ gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar rigs kyi sgo nas nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang 04 lhags 104

pa sogs bzhi/ gnas kyi sgo nas mkhris pa pags la 'grams pa sogs 'jug sgo drug dang / dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba gcig bcas bdun/ bye brag nang tshegs kyi sgo nas mkhris pa 'ju byed sogs lnga dang / rlung dang bad kun la 'dres pa lnga lnga bcas khyon bsdoms rnam par gyur pa'i mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug go /gsum pa/ bad yin gyi nad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nyes pa bstan pa/ ji skad du bshad rgyud las/ bad kun nad la rang rgyud gzhan rgyud gnyis/ /rang rgyud can la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /spyi la ri gas dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ /rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na lhen sogs drug /gnas kyi dbye na sgo drug dbang po bdun/ /bye brag rten byed la sogs rnam gyur lnga/ /rlung dang mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod/ /gzhan rgyud can la ser po smuge po gnyis/ /smug po byer rgyas brdol dang 'gyings pa bzhi//dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum bad kun nad/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig nyes pa'i dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun gyi nad la dbye ba phye na rang rgyud can zhes bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid bdun ldan dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rang rgyud can dang / gzhan khrag mkhris dang bsdongs pa'i sgo nas gzhan 105

pa sogs bzhi/ gnas kyi sgo nas mkhris pa pags la 'grams pa sogs 'jug sgo drug dang / dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba gcig bcas bdun/ bye brag nang tshegs kyi sgo nas mkhris pa 'ju byed sogs lnga dang / rlung dang bad kun la 'dres pa lnga lnga bcas khyon bsdoms rnam par gyur pa'i mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug go /gsum pa/ bad yin gyi nad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nyes pa bstan pa/ ji skad du bshad rgyud las/ bad kun nad la rang rgyud gzhan rgyud gnyis/ /rang rgyud can la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /spyi la ri gas dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ /rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na lhen sogs drug /gnas kyi dbye na sgo drug dbang po bdun/ /bye brag rten byed la sogs rnam gyur lnga/ /rlung dang mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod/ /gzhan rgyud can la ser po smuge po gnyis/ /smug po byer rgyas brdol dang 'gyings pa bzhi//dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum bad kun nad/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig nyes pa'i dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun gyi nad la dbye ba phye na rang rgyud can zhes bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid bdun ldan dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rang rgyud can dang / gzhan khrag mkhris dang bsdongs pa'i sgo nas gzhan 105

rgyud can zhes gnyis su dbye yod cing / rang rgyud can la spyi dang bye brag gnyis yod pa las spyi la yang rigs dang gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis yod pa'i nang dang po rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba la drug yod pa ste/ man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ dang po bad kun snyen zhes bya ba ni//rten dang ma goms mi 'phrod ngo bo bzhi'i/ /rkyen gyis ma zhu bad kum be snabs 'phel/ /bo snabs lhen sna'i 'og tu tshogs pa la/ /lhen zhes bya ste nyams la 'dril snyam byed/ /ltong nge na la mnan na 'dril ba med//dang ga mi bde kha zas 'ju ba dka'/ /zos dus na zhing ltogs na bde bar mngon/ zhes pa ste/ dang po bad kun lten ni lus rten grang rlung shas che ba'i mis rgyun du zas skom ma goms pa'am yang na nam phyed mtshan gung sogs dus nges med la zos pa dang / de bzhin du kha zas mi 'phrod pa'i rigs dper na/ sgo nga dang nya sha/ sran ma'i tshod ma dang bu ram zho/ zho ma langs pa dang chang gsar pa/ 'o ma dang shing tog sha mog dang ko ka ko la sogs grang mo'i rdzas rlangs can bcas mnyam du bsres byas nas zos na sbyar dug lta bur gyur nas mi 'phrod nga/ yin/ de bzhin du yang zas kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin/ gtsang 'gram sogs brlan gsher che sar skyes pa'i 'bru rigs gsar pa dang / shing 'bras ma smin pa/ tshal sogs rjen pa lci la bsil ba'i rigs bsten drags pa sogs kyis rkyen byas te —gang zos pa de nyid pho ba 'i nang du ma 'ju bar bad 7/na dang be snabs 'phel 106

nas lhen sna'i rus pa 'khru krung gi rtse mo zur gsum can gyi 'og tu tshogs pa la gnas kyi dbang las bad kun lhen zhes ming btags pa dang / nad pa'i snang ngor skran lta bu'i sdog sdog gcig 'dril snyam byed pa la don du sman pa'i lag pas mar mnan na 'dril ba med cing / na zug chen po med par stong lhang lhang du na ba dang / kha zas kyi dang ga zhan pa/ zas skom gang yang rung ba zos shing btung na 'ju dka' la/ kha zas zos pa dag pho bar spe bas ma thag tu na zhing ltogs na cung zad bde bar mngon pa bcas skus/ /man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ lcags dreg ces bya gong ltar ma zhu bas/ /be snabs 'phel te pho ba'i nang sul la/ /lcags dreg chags pas pho ba'i me drod nyams/ /sgreg 'tshing pho ba thams cad hrem me na/ /dang ga mi bde sha skam sdod snyeng 'dod/ /be snabs bad kun kha zas zos tshad skyug /ces pa ste/ bad kun lcags dreg bya ba'i nad ni gong ltar/ rten grang rlung can/ ma goms pa'i zas/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas spyod/ ngo bo gsar thog ser can bcas mi 'ju ba'i rkyen bzhis byas te/ pho ba'i rdzem gyi nang skul la snod mkhris kyi khu rtsi dang / bad kun gyi be snabs gnyis lhan cig tu 'dres nas dbyar kha lcags/ la rtsa brgyab pa bzhin pho ba'i nang sul gyi ldebs la dreg pa chags pa dang / lcags dreg des pho ba'i nang gi zas skom dang me drod kyi bar la yol ba lta bur 'ju ba'i nus pa bkag pa ma 107

gtogs mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi byed las rang nyams pa ma yin zhing / de'i phyir sgreg pa thengs gsum nas bzhi'i bar nges pa can byung zhing / pho ba 'ching zhes yar brgyangs pa dang pho ba thams cad hrem mer na zhes pho ba'i —'dzul sgo stod nas smad rgyu sor bcu gcig bar cha tshang skrangs nas sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rnam pas na ba yin la/ kha zas kyi dang ga mi bde bar song lus po'i sha sgrim dang / sgal 'dab shul sha nag po/ sha nag yan lag gi nya sha/ grod sha sogs skam pa dang zas kyi bcud smin ma thub na/ gnas gcig tu sdod snying 'dod cing / dus yun zla ba gsum bzhi phyin pa'i rjes su lcags dreg snying pa chags te mdog skya shar chags nas bad dzin gyi be snabs dang kha zas gang zos pa'i rang mdog yar skyug pa bcas so man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ bad kun me nyams grang rlung shas che la/ /kha zas 'ju dka' bsil phyogs tshad las thal/ /gos srab lus grang chu yi las mang byas/ /tshad zhugs bsil thal sbyongs gtar drags pa yis/ /mkhris pa 'ju byed me mnyam rlung mthu nyams/ /lus kyi drod chung kha zas 'jur mi 'dod/ /sbo 'khrog 'dring sgreg kha zas ma smin 'khru/ /stobs chung sha skam mjug tu dmu skran 'gyur/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun me nyams kyi nad ni rten grang rlung shas che ba'i mi yin pa gang zhig la/ kha zas 'ju dka' ba'i rigs dper na/ 'bru rigs gsar pa/ shing tog ma smin pa/ spo sran gsar thog gzha' thag ma chod pa'i rlon pa'i 108

gtogs mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi byed las rang nyams pa ma yin zhing / de'i phyir sgreg pa thengs gsum nas bzhi'i bar nges pa can byung zhing / pho ba 'ching zhes yar brgyangs pa dang pho ba thams cad hrem mer na zhes pho ba'i —'dzul sgo stod nas smad rgyu sor bcu gcig bar cha tshang skrangs nas sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rnam pas na ba yin la/ kha zas kyi dang ga mi bde bar song lus po'i sha sgrim dang / sgal 'dab shul sha nag po/ sha nag yan lag gi nya sha/ grod sha sogs skam pa dang zas kyi bcud smin ma thub na/ gnas gcig tu sdod snying 'dod cing / dus yun zla ba gsum bzhi phyin pa'i rjes su lcags dreg snying pa chags te mdog skya shar chags nas bad dzin gyi be snabs dang kha zas gang zos pa'i rang mdog yar skyug pa bcas so man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ bad kun me nyams grang rlung shas che la/ /kha zas 'ju dka' bsil phyogs tshad las thal/ /gos srab lus grang chu yi las mang byas/ /tshad zhugs bsil thal sbyongs gtar drags pa yis/ /mkhris pa 'ju byed me mnyam rlung mthu nyams/ /lus kyi drod chung kha zas 'jur mi 'dod/ /sbo 'khrog 'dring sgreg kha zas ma smin 'khru/ /stobs chung sha skam mjug tu dmu skran 'gyur/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun me nyams kyi nad ni rten grang rlung shas che ba'i mi yin pa gang zhig la/ kha zas 'ju dka' ba'i rigs dper na/ 'bru rigs gsar pa/ shing tog ma smin pa/ spo sran gsar thog gzha' thag ma chod pa'i rlon pa'i 108

rigs sngo ngad can/ sha phyur rul sung du phyin pa/ sha sogs ma 'tshos pa/bag leb sogs 'tshig drags pa/ snum dang zhag tshi sogs kyis khengs pa/— kha zas snying pa/ dus yun song ba'i mog mog rlangs gsub btang ba sogs dang / de bzhin gangs chu dang / skar chu grang mo sogs 'thung drags pa/ mdor na kha zas bsil ba'i rigs ha cang thal drags pa dang / grang ngar che ba'i dus su gos srab mo gyon pa dang / chu'i nang du las ka mang po byed drags pa/ char dus su sa cha rlan gsher che sar yun ring bsdad drags pa/ rlung bser bu sogs kyis rkyen byas te me drod nyams pa dang / ma zad —sman pas nad pa la brtag dpyad byed dus stong tshad sogs nad la 'khrul gzhi byung nas tshad pa yod pa'i ngos 'dzin nas bsil sman rigs thal che drags pa/ bshal sman btang drags pa/ zas spyod bsil drags pa/ khrag sogs gtar drags pa bcas kyis mkhris pa 'ju byed dang me mnyam rlung gnyis po'i zung 'jug gi byed las nyams pa'i rtags su lus kyi drod chung zhing / kha zas 'ju ma thub par pho ba dang / mcher pa/ rgyu ma bcas kyi gnas su sbo 'khrog byed cing / pho ba brgyangs nas 'ching pa dang / sgreg pa rgyag pa/ de bzhin kha zas gang zos pa dag ma smin par 'khru ba dang /lus po'i sha dang stobs shed nyams nas mthar gcong chen dmu chu dang skran nad kyi nad du 'gyur ba yin/ man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ bad kun mgul 'gag ces 109

pa pho ba dang / /brang dang glo bar bad kun rgyas pa yin/ /bad kun rlangs pa spo lu mid par chags/ /dper na dong pa'i logs la zo chags 'dra//des rkyen mid pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'/ /dbugs rngub mi bde sha skam lus stobs 'chor/ /zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas rub/ /mjug tu mid pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun mgul 'gag ni/ pho ba dang mcher pa'i nang du bad kun be snabs tshi can 'byar bag gi rnam pa 'phel te pho ba'i nang du chags nas bkag de bzhin brang rus gru bzhi'i rus pa 'khru krung bad kun lhen sna'i gnas su be snabs 'phel nas bkag de dag dang 'brel ba'i spo ba dang glo yu rtsa mig dang bcas pa'i gnas su bad kun sa chu'i stobs rgyas nas dbugs rgyu sa'i lam bkag pa yin zhing / lhag par du pho ba dang brang glo ba bcas gsum du bad kun sa chu'i nus pa dang lus kyi me drod gnyis mi mthun par 'thab rtsod byas pa'i rlangs pa dag slo yu zhes ol mkhrang rus pa 'khru krung dang / mid pa ste zas skom mid pa'i sgrol mdud kyi nang du chags/ shing /dper na/ zo ba lta bu dong pa'i logs su zo sha chags pa dang 'dra ba des rkyen byas te/ mid pa 'chus nas zas skom mid dka' ba dang / dbugs lam dkag pas dbugs 'byin rngub mi bde zhing dbugs thag thung thung gtong ba/ lus zungs gso ba'i zas kyi rgyun nyung drags pa na/ lus po'i sha yang rim bzhin skam pa dang lus kyi stobs shor ba yin la/ de ltar 110

pa pho ba dang / /brang dang glo bar bad kun rgyas pa yin/ /bad kun rlangs pa spo lu mid par chags/ /dper na dong pa'i logs la zo chags 'dra//des rkyen mid pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'/ /dbugs rngub mi bde sha skam lus stobs 'chor/ /zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas rub/ /mjug tu mid pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun mgul 'gag ni/ pho ba dang mcher pa'i nang du bad kun be snabs tshi can 'byar bag gi rnam pa 'phel te pho ba'i nang du chags nas bkag de bzhin brang rus gru bzhi'i rus pa 'khru krung bad kun lhen sna'i gnas su be snabs 'phel nas bkag de dag dang 'brel ba'i spo ba dang glo yu rtsa mig dang bcas pa'i gnas su bad kun sa chu'i stobs rgyas nas dbugs rgyu sa'i lam bkag pa yin zhing / lhag par du pho ba dang brang glo ba bcas gsum du bad kun sa chu'i nus pa dang lus kyi me drod gnyis mi mthun par 'thab rtsod byas pa'i rlangs pa dag slo yu zhes ol mkhrang rus pa 'khru krung dang / mid pa ste zas skom mid pa'i sgrol mdud kyi nang du chags/ shing /dper na/ zo ba lta bu dong pa'i logs su zo sha chags pa dang 'dra ba des rkyen byas te/ mid pa 'chus nas zas skom mid dka' ba dang / dbugs lam dkag pas dbugs 'byin rngub mi bde zhing dbugs thag thung thung gtong ba/ lus zungs gso ba'i zas kyi rgyun nyung drags pa na/ lus po'i sha yang rim bzhin skam pa dang lus kyi stobs shor ba yin la/ de ltar 110

lus po 'tsho ba 'i zas skom gyi rgyun med par pho ba g.yos chu byed pa'i nang du tsha shar brgyab nas phyi nang gnyis su rim pas pho ba 'dus shing 'khums sam pho ba cha nas rub cing / mthar mid pa'i nang du ba spu sib sib can skyes nas zas skom mid ma thub par sgre ba 'gag nas 'chi ba la bad kun mgul 'gag gi nad ces zer/man rgyud bad kun gso ba'i le'u las/ bad kun grum po dkar po zhes bya ba /ma zhu rang gnas bad kun 'phel ba yis/ /pho ba mchin pa gang yin cha med na/ /kha zas ci zos mi zhim 'khru skyug byed/ /nya gzhi mig rus na zhing chu tshan 'byung / /mjug tu yan lag la byer grum bur 'gyur//zhes pa ste bad kun grum po dkar po ni/ bad kun gyi nad mthar yan lag gi tshigs la byer nas grum po'i nad du 'gyur bar song / 'byung rim gyi sgo nas bad kun grum po dkar po zhes ming btags pa dang / nad 'di dag la gnyan kha'i rigs kyi tsha ba med cing / grang ba'i khams 'phel nas kha zas gang zos pa'i snyigs ma ma zhu bar dus yun ring po song ba'i skabs su gzhi nas gnas pho ba dang mchin par song nas dus gang yin cha med du na zhing / de yang pho ba rgyu ma long gi gnas su dngas ma len pa'i rtsa lam brgyud nas mchin par song ste mchin pa na ba dang / slar pho bar lhung nas pho ba na ba yang de ltar byung / rim pas myag zhu dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i me drod rnam gsum gyi byed las nyams pa na/ zas skom gang zos kyang 111

tu smin ma thub par 'ju skems chags pa yin/ de gnyis gang yang rung ba zhig gis rkyen byas nas kha zas gang zos kyang 'grangs pa med la lus go zungs su smin ma thub par lus kyi sha sogs skam nas stobs chung ba da nga gsus pa shin tu che ba ste/ zas kyi snyigs ma dag pho long rgyu ma'i gnas su tshad las brgal ba'i 'phon chen po slebs nas lto ba shin tu che ba mngon yang / chu bsags kyi nad pa lta bu'i rtsa ris 'khyug ger mngon pa med la/ rkang pa gnyis kyi sha sgrim dang rtsa rgyus 'degs 'jog byed pa'i nus pa shor ba bzhin lto ba chen po chags nas byin pa yar mi theg par 'dar ba dang / des rkyen byas te phar tshur 'gro snying mi 'dod par sgyid pa skyur ba bcas byung / /man rgyud rang le las/ bad kun lpags 'gram drod bral bas ldags g.yang/ /sha rgyas drod med sbo gsob dreg pa chags/ /gnyid che lus snyi sgyid skyur rmen bu 'ong / /rtsar zhugs rtsa rgyung grang bsil gyong la snyi/ /rus la zhen na rus pa grang zhing na/ /tshigs kha g.yo zhing brkyang bskum 'gro 'dug gyong / / zhes pa ste/ phyi gnas kyi sgo nas bad kun lpags la 'gram par 'gyur tshul ni/ bad kun sa chu'i nus pa pags pa'i phyi nang bar gsum du 'byung ba rlung gi lpags ris dgu po'i nang du grams shing / des na nad pa'i lpags pa'i bar dang nang du drod dang bral nas lus 'khyags pa'i snang ba byung zhing / rgyun ldan pags pa'i nang dang bar du drod tshad 113

skyed par byed pa'i byed las nyams pa de'i rtags su bas ldags zhes dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i pags pa spos pa la bas zer zhing / de'i steng du dreg pa chags pa'i mdog la ldags zhes brjod pas don du lus kyi pags pa mdog nag por spos shing / dus yun ring po phyin nas rnying pa chags pa'i skabs su lpags par lkog shu langs nas g.ya' ba ste za 'phrug langs pa yin/ de brad pa'i shul du chu ser rlan gsher can thon nas g.ya' zhing za 'phrug brgyab pa yin/ sha la bad kun rgyas pa'i skabs su nad pa'i snang tshul du drod mi khug pa'i snang tshul byung yang / sman pas brtag dpyad byed dus sha la drod yod kyang rgyun gtan las ldog ste sha sbos nas gsob gsob chags pa yin/ 'on kyang / skya rbab kyi sha spos pa yin na lag pa'i mdzub mos mar mnan pa'i rjes su stong stong chags nas lam seng yar ma gang bar mdzub mo'i mnan rjes gsal po byung ba'i khyad par yod cing / des na nad pa'i pho ba dang ltag zhabs gnyis kyi gnas su bad kun gyi sha rgyas 4mas de la dreg pa 'od chil chil chags shing / chus bkrus kyang 'dag dka' la lhag don gnyid ha cang che ba dang / bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid snyi ba'i nus pas lus sems snyi zhing 'thibs pas bya ba gang la yang spro ba med par sgyid lug byed pa yin/ dus rgyun men bu thon sa sne sa khul dang / mchan khung sogs gnas dro sar byung yang skabs 'dir lus spyi la gnas nges med du men bu thon pa'i rtags bcas byung ngo / /114

skyed par byed pa'i byed las nyams pa de'i rtags su bas ldags zhes dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i pags pa spos pa la bas zer zhing / de'i steng du dreg pa chags pa'i mdog la ldags zhes brjod pas don du lus kyi pags pa mdog nag por spos shing / dus yun ring po phyin nas rnying pa chags pa'i skabs su lpags par lkog shu langs nas g.ya' ba ste za 'phrug langs pa yin/ de brad pa'i shul du chu ser rlan gsher can thon nas g.ya' zhing za 'phrug brgyab pa yin/ sha la bad kun rgyas pa'i skabs su nad pa'i snang tshul du drod mi khug pa'i snang tshul byung yang / sman pas brtag dpyad byed dus sha la drod yod kyang rgyun gtan las ldog ste sha sbos nas gsob gsob chags pa yin/ 'on kyang / skya rbab kyi sha spos pa yin na lag pa'i mdzub mos mar mnan pa'i rjes su stong stong chags nas lam seng yar ma gang bar mdzub mo'i mnan rjes gsal po byung ba'i khyad par yod cing / des na nad pa'i pho ba dang ltag zhabs gnyis kyi gnas su bad kun gyi sha rgyas 4mas de la dreg pa 'od chil chil chags shing / chus bkrus kyang 'dag dka' la lhag don gnyid ha cang che ba dang / bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid snyi ba'i nus pas lus sems snyi zhing 'thibs pas bya ba gang la yang spro ba med par sgyid lug byed pa yin/ dus rgyun men bu thon sa sne sa khul dang / mchan khung sogs gnas dro sar byung yang skabs 'dir lus spyi la gnas nges med du men bu thon pa'i rtags bcas byung ngo / /114

bad kun rtsar zhugs pa'i rtags su rtsa lam gyi bu ga'i nang du bad kun 'phel nas rlung dang khrag rgyu ba'i bya ba zhan po chags nas rtsa rgyud rang bzhin gyis grang mo chags pa dang / lus po'i reg bya bsil zhing lus kyi drod tshad nyams nas drod mi khug pa/ mdor na/ rtsa rgyud grang ba dang / reg bya bsil ba/ lus drod shor ba bcas kyis lus po gyong zhing mkhrang ba dang / lhag par sman pas rtsa gzigs gnang skabs 'phar rtsa dal zhing bying ba dang rgud pa bcas byung / bad kun rus la zhen na/ dper na / shog bu'i steng du snum gyi thigs pa zag pa bzhin rim pas bad kun snyi bsil gyi nus pa sra zhing mkhrang ba rus la zhen cing chags nas rus pa'i gting du na zug skyo lhang lhang can btang ba dang grang ba'i tshor snang byung bzhin yod/ mthar sgal tshigs dang yan lag khag gi tshigs chen/ gzhug chung bcas kyi tshigs kha la gzer brgyab pa dang / tshigs phran khag la g.yo ba zhes skrangs spos byung la/ bad kun 'byor byed tshigs mig kun la gnas pa'i byed las nyams pa na/ rkang lag yar mar brkyang bskum byed dka' ba dang / phar tshur 'gro ba'am gnas gcig tu 'dug pa bcas kyi skabs su dka' tshigs che zhing gyong ba'o / / man rgyud rang le las/ snying la babs na dran pa rmongs par byed/ /dang ga mi bde stod rgyangs lus sems snyi/ /spo babs stod rgyangs mgo 'khor zas mi 'dod/ /be snabs sngo ljob mang du lu bar byed/ /mchin 115

bad kun rtsar zhugs pa'i rtags su rtsa lam gyi bu ga'i nang du bad kun 'phel nas rlung dang khrag rgyu ba'i bya ba zhan po chags nas rtsa rgyud rang bzhin gyis grang mo chags pa dang / lus po'i reg bya bsil zhing lus kyi drod tshad nyams nas drod mi khug pa/ mdor na/ rtsa rgyud grang ba dang / reg bya bsil ba/ lus drod shor ba bcas kyis lus po gyong zhing mkhrang ba dang / lhag par sman pas rtsa gzigs gnang skabs 'phar rtsa dal zhing bying ba dang rgud pa bcas byung / bad kun rus la zhen na/ dper na / shog bu'i steng du snum gyi thigs pa zag pa bzhin rim pas bad kun snyi bsil gyi nus pa sra zhing mkhrang ba rus la zhen cing chags nas rus pa'i gting du na zug skyo lhang lhang can btang ba dang grang ba'i tshor snang byung bzhin yod/ mthar sgal tshigs dang yan lag khag gi tshigs chen/ gzhug chung bcas kyi tshigs kha la gzer brgyab pa dang / tshigs phran khag la g.yo ba zhes skrangs spos byung la/ bad kun 'byor byed tshigs mig kun la gnas pa'i byed las nyams pa na/ rkang lag yar mar brkyang bskum byed dka' ba dang / phar tshur 'gro ba'am gnas gcig tu 'dug pa bcas kyi skabs su dka' tshigs che zhing gyong ba'o / / man rgyud rang le las/ snying la babs na dran pa rmongs par byed/ /dang ga mi bde stod rgyangs lus sems snyi/ /spo babs stod rgyangs mgo 'khor zas mi 'dod/ /be snabs sngo ljob mang du lu bar byed/ /mchin 115

par babs na zos rjes mchin pa na/ /srin 'bu ldog cing kha nas chu sngon 'dzag /mcher babs gnyid che dbugs rgod khong pa sbo/ /rmya zhing sgyid pa skyur la zas mdog 'khru/ /mkhal babs mkhal rked na zhing dri chu sri//— rna ba 'thib cing rlan grang khyad par gnod/ /ces pa ste/ nang gnas kyi sgo nas don snying rgyal po lta bur bad kun gyi nad babs na snying ni gtso bo sha nag gi grub cha yin la/ rtsa phran gyi byed las dus nyin mtshan kun tu byed bzhin yod cing / rtsa phran 'phar lding gi byed las myur po med par sla ba dang / byed las myur por dka' ba gnyis su phye zhing / snying skegi nang du gnas pa'i 'dzin pa blo'i bya ba nyams nas dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa phran gyi nus pa zhan par gyur nas mongs pa dang / zas kyi dang ga mi bde ba dang sgal tshigs bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i mtshams su smro snying zung 'brel gyi byed las zhan pa na/ stod brgyangs shing bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid snyi bsil yin pa'i dbang gis sems gsal rig gi nus pa nyams nas lus sems gnyis ka snyi ba'o/ / spyir na spo ba bad kun yul yin pas/ /dbyar dus bde la dgun dus na ba dang / /nyin bar bde la mtshan mo na ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar glo ba la bad kun babs na spyir glo ba ni bad kun rang gi yul yin te dgun dus bad kun khog tu gsob pa'i dus su phal che ba na ba yin/ de yaring man rgyud byang khog rma'i 'grel pa rtsa yi gnad lugs las/ glo ba'i 116

par babs na zos rjes mchin pa na/ /srin 'bu ldog cing kha nas chu sngon 'dzag /mcher babs gnyid che dbugs rgod khong pa sbo/ /rmya zhing sgyid pa skyur la zas mdog 'khru/ /mkhal babs mkhal rked na zhing dri chu sri//— rna ba 'thib cing rlan grang khyad par gnod/ /ces pa ste/ nang gnas kyi sgo nas don snying rgyal po lta bur bad kun gyi nad babs na snying ni gtso bo sha nag gi grub cha yin la/ rtsa phran gyi byed las dus nyin mtshan kun tu byed bzhin yod cing / rtsa phran 'phar lding gi byed las myur po med par sla ba dang / byed las myur por dka' ba gnyis su phye zhing / snying skegi nang du gnas pa'i 'dzin pa blo'i bya ba nyams nas dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa phran gyi nus pa zhan par gyur nas mongs pa dang / zas kyi dang ga mi bde ba dang sgal tshigs bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i mtshams su smro snying zung 'brel gyi byed las zhan pa na/ stod brgyangs shing bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid snyi bsil yin pa'i dbang gis sems gsal rig gi nus pa nyams nas lus sems gnyis ka snyi ba'o/ / spyir na spo ba bad kun yul yin pas/ /dbyar dus bde la dgun dus na ba dang / /nyin bar bde la mtshan mo na ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar glo ba la bad kun babs na spyir glo ba ni bad kun rang gi yul yin te dgun dus bad kun khog tu gsob pa'i dus su phal che ba na ba yin/ de yaring man rgyud byang khog rma'i 'grel pa rtsa yi gnad lugs las/ glo ba'i 116

nang rtsa sog phon lpags g.yo gas 'dra/ /gsob pas 'jug sla mang ma nad gdon dka'/ / zhes pa ltar gtso bo sog ma'i phon lcog dang 'dra ba'i rtsa phran dag gis lus po'i rlung khrag gtsang ma bzo ba'i las byed cinge /de'i nang du bad kun snyi bsil gyi nus pa shugs cher babs pa der dbugs kyis brdabs pa na stod rgyangs pa dang / skabs re rlung gtsang ma bzo ma thub pa'i dus su gro bur du mgo 'khor ba byung / de ni rgyun rtags min la me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus pa'i las nyams pa na/kha zas bza' mi 'dod cing dus yun ring po song nas mthar gro ba'i rtsa phran nang du be snabs tshi can gyi rnam pa kha dog sngo la ljob ljob can lu ba yin no/ / mchin par bad kun babs na/ mchin pa ni lus po'i zungs khrag bzo skrun byed pa'i khrag gi rten mtsho yin zhing / pho ba nas dang ma len pa'i rtsa rgu brgyud nas gnas mchin par sa chu'i nus pa 'phel nas der zhen cing chags pa na kha zas zos rjes su mchin nga/ na ba yin la/ srin 'bu ldog ces bad srin gru gu 'dra ba'i srin 'bu dkar po thur du mi 'gro ba ra yar gyen du ldog nas kha nang du skyug cing yod la/ ma zad da dung dper na/ lgang phug nang chu blugs nas bcir ba bzhin mchin pa dang mkhris pa'i gnas su yod pa'i chu skyur gyi rtsi khu dang / bad kun be snabs gnyis tsha grang mi mthun par 'thab rtsod byed cing / glo bur du kha nas bkag ma thub 117
