par chu sngon skyug cing 'dzag pa'o/ / mcher par bad kun babs pa'i rtags su/ mcher pa sa khams kyi rang bzhin mtha' mthug cing dkyil srab pa'i gnas su ngan khrag mang du 'phel nas rgyas pa na/ dper na/ khyi gi ma'i dgung la tsha bas gdungs pa bzhin nad pa de'i dbugs rgod ces dbugs thag ha cang thung thung gtong ba dang chabs cig gnyid ha cang che ba byung la/ mcher par gnas pa'i me mnyam rlung gi byed las nyams zhan du gyur nas lus po'i g.yon phyogs su gnas pa'i mcher pa'i g.yas g.yon la spos shing nyams chung la rmya ba dang / lus po 'gul bskyod byed 'dod med par sgyid pa skyur pa dang / de bzhin du mcher pas zungs khrag dngas snyigs 'byed ma thub pa na gang zos pa de'i rang mdog yar skyug pa'o/ /mkhal mar stod smad bad kun babs pa ni/ mkhal ma ni lus po'i chu khams kyi rten yin cing / khrag gtsang ma bzo ba dang / lus po'i stong zad snyoms sgrig byed pa/ mkhal rtsa rkang 'degs kyi rkang pa yar mar 'degs 'jog byed pa/ lhag par dri chu gtsang ma bzo bar byed cing /mkhal 'bras dang mkhal ma'i rtsa phran sogs la drod tshad srung skyob byed pa'i mkhal tshil gyi nus pa zhan par 'gyur na/ mkhal ma rang dang rked pa na ba yin zhing / mkhal ma'i rtsa phran gyi byed las nyams na dri chu 'tshag rgyag ma thub par gcin pa sri ba yin la/ mkhal ma dang rna ba phan tshun 118

par chu sngon skyug cing 'dzag pa'o/ / mcher par bad kun babs pa'i rtags su/ mcher pa sa khams kyi rang bzhin mtha' mthug cing dkyil srab pa'i gnas su ngan khrag mang du 'phel nas rgyas pa na/ dper na/ khyi gi ma'i dgung la tsha bas gdungs pa bzhin nad pa de'i dbugs rgod ces dbugs thag ha cang thung thung gtong ba dang chabs cig gnyid ha cang che ba byung la/ mcher par gnas pa'i me mnyam rlung gi byed las nyams zhan du gyur nas lus po'i g.yon phyogs su gnas pa'i mcher pa'i g.yas g.yon la spos shing nyams chung la rmya ba dang / lus po 'gul bskyod byed 'dod med par sgyid pa skyur pa dang / de bzhin du mcher pas zungs khrag dngas snyigs 'byed ma thub pa na gang zos pa de'i rang mdog yar skyug pa'o/ /mkhal mar stod smad bad kun babs pa ni/ mkhal ma ni lus po'i chu khams kyi rten yin cing / khrag gtsang ma bzo ba dang / lus po'i stong zad snyoms sgrig byed pa/ mkhal rtsa rkang 'degs kyi rkang pa yar mar 'degs 'jog byed pa/ lhag par dri chu gtsang ma bzo bar byed cing /mkhal 'bras dang mkhal ma'i rtsa phran sogs la drod tshad srung skyob byed pa'i mkhal tshil gyi nus pa zhan par 'gyur na/ mkhal ma rang dang rked pa na ba yin zhing / mkhal ma'i rtsa phran gyi byed las nyams na dri chu 'tshag rgyag ma thub par gcin pa sri ba yin la/ mkhal ma dang rna ba phan tshun 118

'brel sbyor gyi dbang las mkhal ma'i nang du lci bsil gyi nus pa 'phel che na/ rang bzhin gyis gro ga'i 'dzer bu gcus pa 'dra ba'i rna ba sgra len gyi bu ga 'gag pa'i rkyen gyis sgra mi gsal bra yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na mkhal ma'i nad pa yin tshe rgyun du zas skom snyi bsil rigs nges par 'dzems dgos shing / dper na/ zhog khog sto tshal rjen pa/ shing 'bras mngar mo/ sran ma'i rigs/ sa cha rlan gsher can la sdod pa/ lus smad grang ba/ chu ha yang grang mo 'thung ba/ rlung bsil bu'i sar yun ring sdod pa chu grang mos lus 'khru ba bcas kyis mkhal mar gnod par 'gyur ba'o/ / pho bar lhung na pho ba mi bde snyi/ /brang tsha chu tshan byung zhing zas mi 'ju/ /long lhung sbo 'khrog byed cing zos tshe na/ /rgyu mar lhung na be snabs 'khru zhing snyi/ /mkhris par lhung na mig ser 'ju bar dka'/ /lus snyi sgyid pa skyur la gnyid du bying / /sgang par lhung bas bad kun za khur 'gyur/ /mngal lhung smad grang zla mtshan gcin bag 'dzag /ces pa ste /pho bar bad kun be snabs 'phel drags na pho ba rang gi gnas su mi bde ba byung la/ pho ba'i stod smad gnyis su be snabs chags shing zhen na ljid tig tig gi snang ba byung ba des rkyen byas te zhogs pa skya rengs shar ba'i dus su brang khog tsha shar rgyag pa dang / kha zas snum bcud che ba dang zhag dri chocan gyi rigs zos nas brang tsha shar rgyag stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis byung 119

zhing / des na chu tshan zhes kha'i nang nas ro mi gsal ba'i chu mang po skyug cing kha zas mi 'ju ba yin/ long du bad kun lhung na de'i rtags su/ spyir long la khag gsum yod de/ khrag long / rtsam long / srin long bcas las 'dir gtso bo rtsam long gnas sku bad zhan 'phel ches nas na ba yin/ gal te kha zas snum bcud che ba'i rigs bsten na/ long gi g.yas phyogs su na zug rgyag pa dang / kha zas snyi bsil grang mo'i rigs zos na/long gi g.yon phyogs su na zhing / spo 'khrog byed la zos tshe na zhes dbus rtsam long du kha zas 'ju ba'i tshe drod tshad kyis ma 'dang nas na ba yin// rgyu ma'i gnas su lhung na ni/ lte ba'i 'og tu mtshon gang mar bcal ba'i sar rgyu ma g.yu zhag gi nang du bad kun gyi nus pa 'phel ba na/ me drod kyi mthu zhan pa'i dbang gis be snabs tshi can 'khru zhing bad kun gyi ngo bo snyi ba dag las rgyu ma'i gnas su snyi ba byung / /mkhris par bad kun lhung ba'i skabs su/ lus mdog spyi dang / lhag par mig ser po chags shing kha zas 'ju dka' la/ lus po snyi ba na rang bzhin gyi bya ba la sgyid pa skyur ba dang / lus sems gnyis ka snyi ba dang gnyid mang po khug pa yin/ / lgang par bad kun ltung na ni/ zas skom snyi la bsil ba'i rigs dper na/ sngo tshal rjen pa/ shing tog ma smin pa/ ja mngar mo 'o ma ka ra/ zhog khog lan tsha/ brlan gsher sar yun ring bsdad drags pa/120

zhing / des na chu tshan zhes kha'i nang nas ro mi gsal ba'i chu mang po skyug cing kha zas mi 'ju ba yin/ long du bad kun lhung na de'i rtags su/ spyir long la khag gsum yod de/ khrag long / rtsam long / srin long bcas las 'dir gtso bo rtsam long gnas sku bad zhan 'phel ches nas na ba yin/ gal te kha zas snum bcud che ba'i rigs bsten na/ long gi g.yas phyogs su na zug rgyag pa dang / kha zas snyi bsil grang mo'i rigs zos na/long gi g.yon phyogs su na zhing / spo 'khrog byed la zos tshe na zhes dbus rtsam long du kha zas 'ju ba'i tshe drod tshad kyis ma 'dang nas na ba yin// rgyu ma'i gnas su lhung na ni/ lte ba'i 'og tu mtshon gang mar bcal ba'i sar rgyu ma g.yu zhag gi nang du bad kun gyi nus pa 'phel ba na/ me drod kyi mthu zhan pa'i dbang gis be snabs tshi can 'khru zhing bad kun gyi ngo bo snyi ba dag las rgyu ma'i gnas su snyi ba byung / /mkhris par bad kun lhung ba'i skabs su/ lus mdog spyi dang / lhag par mig ser po chags shing kha zas 'ju dka' la/ lus po snyi ba na rang bzhin gyi bya ba la sgyid pa skyur ba dang / lus sems gnyis ka snyi ba dang gnyid mang po khug pa yin/ / lgang par bad kun ltung na ni/ zas skom snyi la bsil ba'i rigs dper na/ sngo tshal rjen pa/ shing tog ma smin pa/ ja mngar mo 'o ma ka ra/ zhog khog lan tsha/ brlan gsher sar yun ring bsdad drags pa/120

kha zas zos ma thag tu gnyid khug pa/ lus smad 'khyags pa sogs kyi rkyen bslangs te bad kun be snabs dri chu gsog sa'i snod lgang par lhung ba'i skabs su gzhi nas bad kun gcin snyi'i za khur gyur ba yin te/ man rgyud gcin snyi'i nad gso'i le'u las/ bad kun za khu chu chang bur shing dang //gar po 'bras phye khu chu bye ma dang / /bsil dang bags chu kha chu bcu ru bshad/ / ces pa ltar bad kun bad kun za khu dngas ma chu 'dra ba/ gar la dngas snyigs chang 'dra ba/ smug po bur shing 'dra ba/ gcin pa zhag lon nas gar po spu rtse can/ 'bras kyi phye ma'i khu ba bzhin skya bo/ skyes pa khyo ga'i sa bon khu chu 'dra ba/ gcin pa'i nang bye ma brtsegs pa 'dra ba/ gcin par drod tshad cung zad las med par reg bya bsil zhing lam seng grang mo chags pa/ gcin pa babs dus ha cang nyung nyung can las ma byung ba kha chu 'dra ba'i tshi can bcas bad kun gcin snyi'i za khu mi 'dra ba khag bcu po gang rung du gyur ba yin/ /mngal du lhung na ni/ dngos bstan bud med la go ba yin yang shugs bstan skyes pa la go dgos shing / lus smad du gos dang sha gnyis phan tshun byer nas grang ba'i snang ba byung zhing / mngal du grang ba ches cher 'phel ba na zla mtshan dus su ma babs pa dang / lhag par du skabs re gcin pa dang mnyam du zla mtshan bag tsam 'dres nas 'dzag pa yin la/ rked pa dang dpyi mig bcas lus kyi smad grang ba yi na/ skyes pa la nad de gcin pa 121

mnyam du khu ba dkar po 'dzag pa bcas so/ / bad kun mgo la zhugs na mgo bo lhi/ /gnyid che dang ga mi bde yi ga 'gag /mig la zhugs na skrangs shing ma/chi ma 'dzag /rna bar zhugs na grang zhing snyi la 'thib/ /sna la zhugs na sna 'gag mtshu'/ pa snyi/ /lce la zhugs na lce gyong ro mi tshor/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun de nyid dbang ngo/ ma/go la zhugs na/ mgo bo —lco zhes gartsa bo bang kun rkyang ma'i rtsa gcig yar gyen du song nas klad pa chags shing / gti mug klad par brten nas gnas pa'i sar bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags su mgo bo khyon yongs lci bas rig pa gsal po med par nyin gung gnyid bkag mi thub par gnyid che zhing /kha zas kyi dang sa/ med par rim pas yi ga 'gag nas zas 'ju mi nus so//bad 7/na mig la zhugs pa'i rtags su/ mig 'bras kyi rtsa phran mang du sa chu'i dus pa shas che ba byung dus mig snyibs chu khams kyi gnas yin pri 'i dbang las yar skra ngas pa dang / dbus chu'i khyim nas mig chu yang /spong thon pa gcig yang phyi'i rlung bser bu phog nas lam seng mig chu don pa gcig byung / lhag par du zhogs pa langs dus mig gi g.yas g.yon du mig skyag skya bo can byung na bad kun mig la zhugs pa'i rtags yin/bad kun rna bar zhugs na/ gtso bo mkhal ma dang rna ba 'brel ba'i dbang gis rna shob/ zhwa yod pa'i rtsa phran nang zhugs pa na/ rna shog gi mdog 122

skya bo chags shing grang ba dang rna ba'i nang du 'ur sgra lha bus gang zhing snyi la 'thibs pas sgra mi sangs ba'o/ / bad kun sna la zhugs pa'i rtags su/ sna dang glo ba 'brel sbyor gyi sgo nas snang khung dang glo ba de bzhin zang dung kha bcas kyi gnas su bad kun zhugs pas sna khug g.yas g.yon 'gag cing / mtshul pa lci la snabs lud lta bus gang ba'i snang tshul byung / /bad kun lce la zhugs pa'i rtags su/ de yang lce chung dang lce 'og gi ra rtsa bcas kyi gnas su bad kun zhugs na lce leb ril ril lta bur gyong la kha zas kyi ro mi tshor ba bcas so/ /bye brag bad kun rten byed nad gyur na/ /dang ga mi bde stod brgyangs mdun rgyab gzer/ /brang tsha chu skyur byung zhing dang ga 'gag /bad kun myag byed 'ju dka' bcud mi len/ /kha zas mi 'ju sgreg cing pho ba gyong / /myong byed kha zas bro med skom dad chung / /lce grang mchu na skad 'dzer zas mi len/ /tshim byed mgo 'khyom mig bzi rna ba 'gag /sbrid pa snabs mang cham 'debs mtshogs ma snyi/ /'byor byed brkyang bskum dka' zhing tshigs mgo sbom/ /rkang lag ltu tshigs na zhing tshigs kha g.yo//rlung dang mkhris pa gang 'dres de rtags ston/ /zhes pa ste/ bye brag bad kun rten byed nad du gyur na/ skabs re kha zas za mi 'dod cing skabs re za 'dod pa byung / rgyun du sog po'i g.yas g.yon dang / tshigs pa bzhi 123

pa lnga pa'i nye 'khor du stod brgyangs pa yin la/ lus po'i mdun brang gzhung dkar nag dang / lus po'i rgyab tshigs pa drug pa srog rtsa'i gsang du gzer brgyab pa yin/ kha zas zhag tshi dang snum bcud che drags nas brang tsha ba byung zhing / sran ma sogs snyi bsil bsten drags na yang brang tsha ba byung la/ chu skyur yang yang skyug ceng za tshad nyung nyung chag nas dang ga 'gag pa'o/ /bad kun myag byed nad du gyur ba ni/ kha zas rjen pa/ ma tshos pa/'tshig drags pa/ khengs po sogs 'ju dka' la zas kyi bcud mi len zhing / rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra ba'i kha nang du mchi ma tshi can mang po 'phel nas skad cha bshad dus phyir por pa dang / kha zas zos pa'i rjes su zas kyi dri ma ltar sgreg pa 'byin pa dang / pho ba sra zhing gang ba'i rnam pas pho ba gyong ba bcas so/ /bad kun myong byed nad kyi ngo bor gyur ba ste/ lces zas skom tsha grang gang yin gsal por mi tshor bas kha skom dad che yang zas skom gyi bro ba gsal po ma tshor bar/ lce'i steng du ga dus yin yang grang ba'i snang ba 'char zhing / ya mchu ma mchu gnyis skrangs pa'i snang tshul gyis na zhing skad cha bshad dus 'dar zhing skad 'dzer la kha zas za mi 'dod pa byung / /bad kun tshim byed rnam par gyur na/ yar mar mo'agro ba dang sdod pa'i skabs su mgo bo'i nang ling ling byed pa'i snang bas phyi yul gyi sa 'khor 124

nas mgo 'khyoms pa dang / mig bzi ste/ mig gis nan tan du bltas kyang ska bas re gsal la skabs re mi gsal bar rab rib byed pa dang / de bzhin rna bar 'ur 'ur lta bus/ 'gag cid / gos srab mo gyon nas lus grang mo chags rkyen sbrid pa dang / snabs lud mang du byung zhing tsha shar brgyab pa'i snang ba byung la/ cham pa 'debs zhes lus po dbyug pas brdung ba bzhin nyam chung la/ kha zase snum bcud can dang / rus khu/ chang sogs kyi rkyen byas te mgo ba'i mtshogs ma snyi ba'o/ /bad kun 'byor byed kyi nad du gyur pa ni/ bad kun 'byor byed ni tshigs mig kun la gnas shing / yan lag tshigs chen rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / nying 'a/ga k+ka tshigs phran bcas su bad kun shas cher 'phel nas tshigs kha sbom zhing rdog rdog chags pas/ rgyun ldan las ldog ste rkang lag brkyang bskum byed par dka' tshegs che zhing / rkang lag gi lhu tshigs dang sgal tshigs nyi shu dang 'brel ba'i bya 'dab bcas su na zhing tshigs kha g.yo ba ste/ gnas gang du na ba'i tshigs kha na zhing yar skrangs sbos byung ba'i rtags bcas ston pa'o/ /gong du bshad ma thag pa'i bad kun gyi nang gses lnga po dag rlung dang mkhris pa so sor gang dang gang 'dres na/ de dang de'i rtags ston pa yin te/ bad kun rten byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ myag byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ myong byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ tshim byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ 'byor 125

nas mgo 'khyoms pa dang / mig bzi ste/ mig gis nan tan du bltas kyang ska bas re gsal la skabs re mi gsal bar rab rib byed pa dang / de bzhin rna bar 'ur 'ur lta bus/ 'gag cid / gos srab mo gyon nas lus grang mo chags rkyen sbrid pa dang / snabs lud mang du byung zhing tsha shar brgyab pa'i snang ba byung la/ cham pa 'debs zhes lus po dbyug pas brdung ba bzhin nyam chung la/ kha zase snum bcud can dang / rus khu/ chang sogs kyi rkyen byas te mgo ba'i mtshogs ma snyi ba'o/ /bad kun 'byor byed kyi nad du gyur pa ni/ bad kun 'byor byed ni tshigs mig kun la gnas shing / yan lag tshigs chen rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / nying 'a/ga k+ka tshigs phran bcas su bad kun shas cher 'phel nas tshigs kha sbom zhing rdog rdog chags pas/ rgyun ldan las ldog ste rkang lag brkyang bskum byed par dka' tshegs che zhing / rkang lag gi lhu tshigs dang sgal tshigs nyi shu dang 'brel ba'i bya 'dab bcas su na zhing tshigs kha g.yo ba ste/ gnas gang du na ba'i tshigs kha na zhing yar skrangs sbos byung ba'i rtags bcas ston pa'o/ /gong du bshad ma thag pa'i bad kun gyi nang gses lnga po dag rlung dang mkhris pa so sor gang dang gang 'dres na/ de dang de'i rtags ston pa yin te/ bad kun rten byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ myag byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ myong byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ tshim byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ 'byor 125

byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ de bzhin du yang / rten byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ myag byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ myong byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ tshim byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ 'byor byed mkhris par 'dres pa bcas bcu'o//bad kun ser po mkhris pa'i kha lud yin/ /rtsa ni stong la dal zhing chu mdog ser/ /pho ba ltem zhing zas la dang ga zhan/ /chang 'thung dro sa tshe mtshogs ma mig rus na/ /brang tsha chu skyur byung zhing mkhris pa skyugs//sa rlan rul skyur zos rjes 'khru yang srid/ /kro yos ra sha mar rnying chang skyur gnod/ /mjug tu smug po'am mkhris pa'i nad du 'gyur/ / ces pa ste/ bad kun dang khrag mkhris 'dres pa'i sgo nas gzhan rgyud can zhes btags pa yin/ de yang bad kun ser po ni/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud dang bad kun gnyis bsdongs zlar gyur pa'i nad cig yin zhing / 'phar rtsa'i 'gul bskyod kyi rang bzhin shugs chung la dal bar 'phar ba dang / mnan na rtsa stong zhing gcin pa'i mdog ser po yin pa gang zhig la lbu ba'i 'od mdangs ser zhing mi g.yo bar brtan par gnas pa dang / pho ba ltem zhes snod kyi mkhris khu pho bar slebs nas pho ba mi bde bar yang yang brgyangs shing zas kyi dang ga zhan par gyur pa dang / chang sogs drod dang snum bcud che ba'i rigs bsten nas lus dros pa'i tshe/mgo'i mtshogs ma lci zhing mig gi phyi rus pa'i khyim na ba dang / pho bar slebs pa'i mkhris khu dang mchin pa'i drod tshad kyis chu skyur po byung zhing 126

byed rlung dang 'dres pa/ de bzhin du yang / rten byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ myag byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ myong byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ tshim byed mkhris par 'dres pa/ 'byor byed mkhris par 'dres pa bcas bcu'o//bad kun ser po mkhris pa'i kha lud yin/ /rtsa ni stong la dal zhing chu mdog ser/ /pho ba ltem zhing zas la dang ga zhan/ /chang 'thung dro sa tshe mtshogs ma mig rus na/ /brang tsha chu skyur byung zhing mkhris pa skyugs//sa rlan rul skyur zos rjes 'khru yang srid/ /kro yos ra sha mar rnying chang skyur gnod/ /mjug tu smug po'am mkhris pa'i nad du 'gyur/ / ces pa ste/ bad kun dang khrag mkhris 'dres pa'i sgo nas gzhan rgyud can zhes btags pa yin/ de yang bad kun ser po ni/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud dang bad kun gnyis bsdongs zlar gyur pa'i nad cig yin zhing / 'phar rtsa'i 'gul bskyod kyi rang bzhin shugs chung la dal bar 'phar ba dang / mnan na rtsa stong zhing gcin pa'i mdog ser po yin pa gang zhig la lbu ba'i 'od mdangs ser zhing mi g.yo bar brtan par gnas pa dang / pho ba ltem zhes snod kyi mkhris khu pho bar slebs nas pho ba mi bde bar yang yang brgyangs shing zas kyi dang ga zhan par gyur pa dang / chang sogs drod dang snum bcud che ba'i rigs bsten nas lus dros pa'i tshe/mgo'i mtshogs ma lci zhing mig gi phyi rus pa'i khyim na ba dang / pho bar slebs pa'i mkhris khu dang mchin pa'i drod tshad kyis chu skyur po byung zhing 126

brang tsha ba dang / da dung mkhris khu ser po bcas yar skyugs pa yin/ yang 'ga' shas sa cha rlan gsher la bsdad drags pa dang / kha zas rul pa dang ha cang skyur po'i rigs zos pa'i rjes su mar thur du 'khru yang srid pa yin/ des na/ nad pa des gro yos dang / ra sha mar rnying pa/ chang skyur po bcas za 'thung byas pa'i tshe nad 'di la lhag par gnod par gyur nas bad kun gyi stobs che na mjug tu smug por 'gro ba dang / mkhris pa'i nad stobs shas che na mkhris pa'i nad du 'gyur ba'o/ /bad kun smug po khrag gi snyigs ma yin/ /pho mchin ro stod na zhing rgya bshal skyug /lus snyi sgyid pa skyur la snying mi dga'/ /'grangs ltogs grang dang dro ba gang yang gnod/ /don med na zhing byas med bde bar mngon/ /zhes pa ste/ spyir bad kun smug po'i nad ni/ rgyu gtso bo nyes pa bad kun dang khrag dang mkhris pa dang rlung dang shugs bstan chu ser dang bcas pa'i rgyu tshogs lnga ldan dag yin zhing / bad kun smug po'i nad de slong ba'i rkyen byed pa la tsha rkyen dang grang rkyen gnyis yod pa las/ dang po tsha rkyen ni/ kha zas ro tsha ba dang / skyur ba/ drod/ snum bcud sha chang sogs de bzhin 'grams khrag lus pa zhes lus zungs rgyu ba'i rtsa lam du khrag tshad rlung gis ded nas drod tshad ha cang rgyas drags pa dang / lus la mtshon cha sogs phog nas gnas der khrag ngan lus pa/ mchin par lhung ba/ yang de bzhin du/tso zas ha cang 'ju dka' zhing bsil la snyi 127

ba'i rigs/ sngo ngad/ rul sungs/ ma tshos pa/ 'tshig drags/ khengs po/ser can/ shing tog ma smin pa/ gangs chu sogs kyi rkyen byas te pho bar me drod gsum ste/ kha zas myag cing ldur bar byed pa'i bad kun myag byed dang / kha zas zhu bar byed pa'i mkhris pa 'ju byed/ kha zas kyi nus mthu dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i me mnyam gyi rlung bcas me drod gsum gyi byed las kyi nus masdi nyams pa'i dbang gis zas skom gang zos shing 'thung ba rnams lus po'i srog 'tsho ba'i zungs su smin ma thub par pho ba nas dang ma len pa'i rtsa dgu brgyud nas mchin pa'i gnas su song nas ngan khrag ca 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su khrag gi nad rtags lta bur mngon zhing /khrag gi snyigs ma de nyid slar pho ba'i nang du lhung ba'i tshe/ bad kun gyi nad rtags lta bur mngon pa dang / yang rgyu mar lhung ba'i tshe mkhris pa'i nad rtags lta bur mngon pa/ de bzhin long du lhung ba'i tshe rlung gi nad rtags lta bur mngon zhing / rlung gi rang mdog sngon po dang mkhris pa'i mdog ser po/ khrag gi mdog dmar po/ bad kun gyi mdog skya bo/ chu ser gyi mdog ser po bcas rgyu tshogs lnga ldan tshogs shing 'dus nas bde ba'i skabs 'phrog pa la 'dus nad smug po gdags par mdzad do/ /de yang pho ba dang mchin pa gnyis su bad kun dang khrag phane tshun mi mthun par 'thab pa las/ lus po'i g.yas phyogs su gnas pa'i mchin pa dang / lhen sna'i 'og tu gnas pa'i pho ba gnyis kyi gnas su ro stod 128

na zhing / rgya bshal zing skya lta gu skyug cing / rtsa lam du ngan khrag rgyu ba'i byed las ngan pas lus snyi zhing bya ba gang la yang sgyid lug cing / phyi bshol byed pa dang lhag par du bad gan smug po'i nad la mi 'gyur ba'i rtags lnga yod pa ste/ dang po lus sems gnyis kyi sgo nas gzhas dang zhabs bro sogs zang zing gi bya ba gang la yang mi spro bar gtam snyan mi snyan bcas la snying mi dga' ba dang / gnyis pa zas skom gyi sgo nas grod khog 'grangs pa'i dus su na ba dang / yang grod pa ltogs pa'i dus su na ba yin/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi sgo nas me dang nyi ma gos sogs kyis lus dros pa'i tshe na ba dang / yang lus 'khyags shing grang ba'i skabs su na ba yin/ bzhi pa nyin gcig la don med gang byung du skabs re na ba dang /skabs re drag tu phyin pa'i mngon rtags ston zhing / lnga pa sman bcos sogs bcos thabs gang yang ma byas kyang na tsha drag tu phyin nas bde bar mngon pa bcas kyi nad rtags 'di'i rigs byung na bad dzin smug po'i nad yin/ /smug po'i nad la byer rgyas 'gying 'dril bzhi/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun smug po'i nad la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ smug po byer ba dang / smug po rgyas pa/ smug po 'gying ba/ smug po 'dril ba bcas bzhi yod la/ de dag la yang nang gses phyi byer nang byer gnyis/ rdol dang ma rdol gnyis /gab dang ma gab gnyis/ gsar dang rnying pa gnyis bcas yod kyang / zhib 129

na zhing / rgya bshal zing skya lta gu skyug cing / rtsa lam du ngan khrag rgyu ba'i byed las ngan pas lus snyi zhing bya ba gang la yang sgyid lug cing / phyi bshol byed pa dang lhag par du bad gan smug po'i nad la mi 'gyur ba'i rtags lnga yod pa ste/ dang po lus sems gnyis kyi sgo nas gzhas dang zhabs bro sogs zang zing gi bya ba gang la yang mi spro bar gtam snyan mi snyan bcas la snying mi dga' ba dang / gnyis pa zas skom gyi sgo nas grod khog 'grangs pa'i dus su na ba dang / yang grod pa ltogs pa'i dus su na ba yin/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi sgo nas me dang nyi ma gos sogs kyis lus dros pa'i tshe na ba dang / yang lus 'khyags shing grang ba'i skabs su na ba yin/ bzhi pa nyin gcig la don med gang byung du skabs re na ba dang /skabs re drag tu phyin pa'i mngon rtags ston zhing / lnga pa sman bcos sogs bcos thabs gang yang ma byas kyang na tsha drag tu phyin nas bde bar mngon pa bcas kyi nad rtags 'di'i rigs byung na bad dzin smug po'i nad yin/ /smug po'i nad la byer rgyas 'gying 'dril bzhi/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun smug po'i nad la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ smug po byer ba dang / smug po rgyas pa/ smug po 'gying ba/ smug po 'dril ba bcas bzhi yod la/ de dag la yang nang gses phyi byer nang byer gnyis/ rdol dang ma rdol gnyis /gab dang ma gab gnyis/ gsar dang rnying pa gnyis bcas yod kyang / zhib 129

phra smug po'i nad kyi skabs su gsal zhing / r+ya dor na dang po rigs kyi sgo nas bad kun lhen dang / lcags dreg me nyams/ mgul 'gag grum po dkar po/ 'ju skem bcas drug dang / gnyis pa gnas kyi sgo nas/ bad — kan pags la 'grams pa/ sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ rus la zhen pa/don la bab pa/ snod la lhung ba bcas 'jug sgo drug dang / dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba gcig bcas bdun/ bye brag gi sgo nas bad gan rten byed/ myag byed/ myong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed bcas lnga de dag rlung dang 'dres pa lnga dang / yang mkhris pa dang 'dres pa lnga bcas bsgril bas bco lngar 'dod la/ gzhan rgyud can la ser po dang smug po gnyis su 'dod cing / smug po der byer rgyal 'gying 'dril bzhi bcas de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum ni/ rnam par gyur ba'i bad dzin grang ba'i nad sha stag yin/ de ltar gong du bshad pa'i rlung nad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug bad gan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nad dag 'tsho byed sman pa rnams kyis bcos dgos kyi nad brgya dang rtsa gcig tu bsdan pa yin/ /bzhi pa/ mchog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigabashad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ kun khyab thun mong nad la 130

phra smug po'i nad kyi skabs su gsal zhing / r+ya dor na dang po rigs kyi sgo nas bad kun lhen dang / lcags dreg me nyams/ mgul 'gag grum po dkar po/ 'ju skem bcas drug dang / gnyis pa gnas kyi sgo nas/ bad — kan pags la 'grams pa/ sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ rus la zhen pa/don la bab pa/ snod la lhung ba bcas 'jug sgo drug dang / dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba gcig bcas bdun/ bye brag gi sgo nas bad gan rten byed/ myag byed/ myong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed bcas lnga de dag rlung dang 'dres pa lnga dang / yang mkhris pa dang 'dres pa lnga bcas bsgril bas bco lngar 'dod la/ gzhan rgyud can la ser po dang smug po gnyis su 'dod cing / smug po der byer rgyal 'gying 'dril bzhi bcas de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum ni/ rnam par gyur ba'i bad dzin grang ba'i nad sha stag yin/ de ltar gong du bshad pa'i rlung nad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug bad gan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nad dag 'tsho byed sman pa rnams kyis bcos dgos kyi nad brgya dang rtsa gcig tu bsdan pa yin/ /bzhi pa/ mchog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigabashad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ kun khyab thun mong nad la 130

nyes pa dang / /gtso bo gnas dang rigs kyi dbye ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i skyes pa dang / bud med/ byis pa/ rgan po la sogs 'gro ba mi'i rigs kun la thun mong du khyab pa'i nad rigs mi 'dra ba khag bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yod de/ gnod byed nyes pa'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigamachog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig yo bo rigs kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcig bcas khyon bsdoms pas nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yod cing / de yang dang po gnod byed — nyes pa rlung gi nad la dbye ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang / mkhris pa'i nad la dbye ba nyi shu rtsa drug dang / bad kun la dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum bcas nyes pa'i sgo nas nad rigs brgya dang rtsa gcig byung ba rnams 'chad zin nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun so so'i nad kyi skabs su bstan cing / gnyis — pa mchog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas brgya dang rtsa gcig bshad par bya ba ni/de nyid las/ gtso bos dbye na rang rgyud gzhan rgyud can/ /rang rgyud can ni rkyang pa rang rtags ston/ /'phel dang rab 'phel mchog 'phel zad par sbyar/ /zhes pa ste/ nyes pa gang yang rung ba zhig la nad kyi bsdong blo gzhan med par/ nad rkyang pa rang gi rtags gsal por ston pa la rang rgyud can zhes brjod cing / de yang rlung 'phel tsam/ rlung rab tu 'phel di ba/ rlung mchog tu 'phel ba/ mkhris pa 'phel tsam/ mkhris pa rab tu 'phel ba/ mkhris pa mchog tu 'phel ba/ bad kun 'phel tsam/ bad kun 131

rab tu 'phel ba/ bad kun mchog tu 'phel ba dang dgu/ yang zad pa la sbyar na/ rlung zad pa tsam dang / rlung rab tu zad pa/ rlung mchog tu zad pa/ gakhris pa zad pa tsam/ mkhris pa rab tu zad pa/ mkhris pa mchog tu zad pa/ bad kun zad pa tsam/ bad kun rab tu zad pa/ bad kun mchog tu zad pa dgu ste bco brgyad do/ /ci de nyid las/ gzhan rgyud can de ldan 'dus bla gnyan gsum/ /ldan pa mnyam gsum gcig rab lhag pa drug /ces pa ste/ nyes pa gzhan gyi bsdong zla dang bcas pa'i nad la gzhan rgyud can zhes zer zhing / ldan pa mnyam gsum zhes rlung mkhris gnyis cha mnyam du 'phel ba/ bad mkhris gnyis cha mnyam du 'phel ba/ bad rlung gnyis cha mnyam du 'phel ba dang gsumadze/ gcig rab lhag pa drug ces rlung rab tu 'phel zhing mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba/ rlung rab tu 'phel zhing bad kun lhag par 'phel ba/ mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba/ mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing bad kun lhag par 'phel ba/ bad kun rab tu 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba/ bad kun rab tu 'phel zhing mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba ste dgu dang / yang de bzhin duzad pa la sbyar na/ rlung mkhris gnyis cha mnyam du zad pa/ bad mkhris gnyis cha mnyam du zad pa/bad rlung gnyis cha mnyam du zad pa dang gsum/ rlung rab tu zad cing mkhris pa lhag par zad pa/ rlung rab tu zad cing bad kun lhag par zad 132

pa/ mkhris pa rab tu zad cing rlung lhag par zad pa/ mkhris pa rab tu zad cing bad kun lhag par zad pa/ bad kun rab tu zad cing rlung lhag par zad pa/ bad kun rab tu zad cing mkhris pa lhag par zad pa dgu bcas bsgril bas 'phel zad bco brgyad do/ /de nyid las / 'dus pa mtshungs gcig rab 'bring gsum sbyar drug/gnyis gcig lhag pa la drug go ldog zad/ /'phel zad 'dres la mnyam 'phel zad sbyar drug /gcig zad gnyis 'phel go ldog bcas pa drug/ —'phel zad dbye ba bdun cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /zhes/ pa ste/ 'dus pa'i 'phel zad kyi dbye ba la 'dus la mtshungs gcig ces rlung mkhris bad kun gsum ga stobs mtshungs par 'phel ba gcig rab 'bring gsum sbyar drug ces rlung rab tu 'phel 'ing mkhris pa 'bring du 'phel la bad gan tha mar 'phel/ rlung rab tu 'phel zhing bad kun 'bring du 'phel la mkhris pa tha ma/ra 'phel/ mkhris nga/ rab tu 'phel zhing rlung 'bring du 'phel la bad kun tha mar 'phel/ mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing bad yin 'bring du 'phel la mkhris pa tha mar 'phel/ bad kun rab tu 'phel zhing rlung 'bring du 'phel la/ mkhris pa tha ma ra 'phel ba/ bad kun rab tu 'phel zhing ma/bris pa 'bring du 'phel la rlung tha mar 'phel ba ste drug dang / yang gnyis gcig lhag pa la drug ces/ rlung 'phel zhing bad mkhri/ sa gnyis lhag par 'phel ba/ mkhris rma 'phel zhing bad rlung gnyis lhag par 'phel ba/ 133

bad kun 'phel zhing rlung mkhris gnyis lhag par 'phel ba gsum dang /rlung mkhris gnyis 'phel zhing bad kun lhag par 'phel ba/ bad mkhris gnyis 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba/ bad rlung gnyis 'phel zhing mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba gsum ste drug ba'u(mas pas 'phel ba bcu gsum byung zhing / go ldog zad ces gong gi 'phel ba bcu gosum la go ldog ste zad par sbyar ba ni/ rlung mkhris bad kun gsum stobs/ mtshungs par zad pa gcig dang / rlung rab tu zad cing mkhris pa 'bring du zad la bad kun tha mar zad pa/ rlung rab tu zad cing bad kun 'bring du zad —la mkhres pa tha mar zad pa mkhris pa rab tu zad cing rlung 'bring du zad la bad kun tha mar zad pa/ mkhris pa rab tu zad cing bad kun 'bring du zad la rlung tha mar zad rma / bad kun rab tu zad cing rlung 'bring du zad la mkhris pa tha mar zad pa/ bad lam rab tu zad cing mkhris/ pa 'bring du zad la rlung tha mar zad pa drug dang / rlung zad cing bad mkhris gnyis lhag par zad pa/ mkhris pa zad cing bad rlung gnyis lhag par zad pa/ bad kun zad cing rlung mkhris gnyis lhag par zad pa gsum dang /rlung mkhris gnyis zad cing bad kun lhag par zad pa/ bad mkhris gnyis zad cing rlung lhag par zad pa/ bad rlung gnyis zad cing mkhris pa lhag par zad pa gsum/ ste drug bcas zad pa bcu gsum dang khyom bsdoms pas 'dus pa'i 'phel zad nyi shu rtsa drug go/134

de nyid las/ 'phel zad 'dres la mnyam 'phel zad sbyar drug /ces pa ste/ rlung cha mnyam zhing mkhris pa 'phel ba/ bad kun zad pa/ rlung cha mnyam zhing bad kun 'phel la mkhris pa zad pa/ mkhris pa cha mnyam zhing rlung 'phel la bad kun zad pa/ mkhris pa cha mnyam zhing bad kun 'phel la rlung zad pa/ bad kun cha mnyam zhing rlung 'phel la mkhris pa zad pa/ bad kun cha mnyam zhing mkhris pa 'phel la rlung zad pa ste drug dang / gcig zad gnyis 'phel zhes rlung zad cing bad mkhris gnyis —'phel ba/ mkhris pa zad cing bad rlung gnyis 'phel ba/ bad kun zad cing rlung mkhris gnyis 'phel ba gsum dang / go ldog bcas pa drug ces gong las ldog ste/ gnyis zad nas gcig 'phel ba yin te/ rlung mkhris gnyis zad cing bad kun 'phel ba/ bad mkhris gnyis zad cing rlung 'phel ba/ bad rlung gnyis zad cing mkhris pa 'phel ba gsum ste drug bsgril bas 'dres pa'i 'phel zad bcu gnyi sa so/ /de ltar gong du bshad ma thag pa bzhin rkyang pa'i 'phel zad bco brgyad/ ldan pa'i 'phel zad bco brgyad/ 'dus pa'i 'phel zad nyer drug 'dres pa'i 'phel zad bcu gnyis bcas bsdoms pas 'phel zad kyi dbye ba bdun cu don bzhi yod do/ /de nyid las/ bla gnyan nad kyi steng du nad gang zhig /byung ba de yang dbye ba gsum 'gyur to/ /zhug sa dang log dang 'doms pa zhes su 135

bshad/ /gcig gi gnas su nad gzhan zhugs pa dang / /rang ma zhi bar gzhan du log pa dang / /nad sna gnyis su 'thab pas dgu tshan gsum//brgya dang rtsa gcig gtso bo'i dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ bla gnyan ni dper na/ sngar mkhris pa'i nad yod pa'i steng du slar yang phyi ma rlung lta bu'i nad gzhan byung ba la zer zhing / de la yang dbye ba rnam pa gsum yod pa ste/ gcig gi gnas su nad gzhan zhugs pa zhes rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa zhugs pa/ bad kun zhugs pa/ nyes pa gsum ga zhugs pa ste gsum/ de bzhin du mkhris pa'i gnas su rlung zhugs pa/ bad gan zhugs pa/ nyes pa gsum ga zhugs pa ste gsum/ yang de bzhin du bad dzin gyi gnas su rlung zhugs pa/ mkhris pa zhugs pa/ nyes pa gsum ga zhugs pa bcas dgu dang / rang ma zhi bar gzhan du log pa zhes rlung gi nad ma zhi bar mkhris par log pa/ bad kun du log pa/ bad mkhris gnyis kur log pa ste gsum dang / de bzhin du mkhris pa'i nad ma zhi bar rlung du log pa/ bad kun du log pa/ bad rlung gnyis gar log pa ste gsum dang / de bzhin du bad kun gyi nad ma zhi bar rlung du log pa/ mkhris par log pa/ rlung mkhris gnyis gar log pa ste gsum bcas dgu dang / nad sna gnyis su 'thab pas zhes rlung gis rang gnas bzung nas bad mkhris gnyis dang 'thab pa/ rlung gi mkhris nad 'phrog naji bad kun dang 'thab pa/ rlung gis bad kun gyi gnas 'phrog nas mkhris pa dang 136

'thabs te gsum dang / de bzhin du mkhris pa sa rang gnas bzung nas bad rlung gnyis dang 'thab pa/ mkhris pas rlung gi gnas 'phrog nas bad kun dang 'thab pa/ mkhris pas bad kun gyi gnas 'phrog nas rlung dang 'thab pa ste gsum/ yang de bzhin du bad kun gyis rang gnas bzung nas rlung mkhris dang 'thab pa/ bad kun gyise rlung gnas 'phrog nas mkhris pa dang 'thab pa/ bad /kun gyis mkhris gnas 'agleg nas rlung la 'thab pa ste gsum bcas bsgril bas dgu tshan gsum zhes bla gnyan gyi nad dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun yod cing / khyon yongs su bsdoms pas mchog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas nad rigs brgya dang rtsa gcig tu 'dod pa'o/ /lnga pa/ rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigabashad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na lus dang sems/ /cisems la gnas pa spyo byed brjed byed gnyis/ /lus la gnas pa stod smad phyi nang bzhi/ /phyi nang kun khyab nad dang rnam pa lnga//lus stod dbang po mgo la gnas pa ni/ /mgo mig rna ba sna dang mchu so lce/ /rkan dad lba ba gre ba nam tshong nad/ /gre bar gnas pa nad dang gag pa dang / /r+ya gul 'gags nad dang skad 'gags rnam pa bzhi/ /nam tshong spyir gnas skom dad skyigs bu dang / /dbugs mi bde dang yid 'chus 137

'thabs te gsum dang / de bzhin du mkhris pa sa rang gnas bzung nas bad rlung gnyis dang 'thab pa/ mkhris pas rlung gi gnas 'phrog nas bad kun dang 'thab pa/ mkhris pas bad kun gyi gnas 'phrog nas rlung dang 'thab pa ste gsum/ yang de bzhin du bad kun gyis rang gnas bzung nas rlung mkhris dang 'thab pa/ bad kun gyise rlung gnas 'phrog nas mkhris pa dang 'thab pa/ bad /kun gyis mkhris gnas 'agleg nas rlung la 'thab pa ste gsum bcas bsgril bas dgu tshan gsum zhes bla gnyan gyi nad dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun yod cing / khyon yongs su bsdoms pas mchog dman gtso bo'i sgo nas nad rigs brgya dang rtsa gcig tu 'dod pa'o/ /lnga pa/ rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigabashad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na lus dang sems/ /cisems la gnas pa spyo byed brjed byed gnyis/ /lus la gnas pa stod smad phyi nang bzhi/ /phyi nang kun khyab nad dang rnam pa lnga//lus stod dbang po mgo la gnas pa ni/ /mgo mig rna ba sna dang mchu so lce/ /rkan dad lba ba gre ba nam tshong nad/ /gre bar gnas pa nad dang gag pa dang / /r+ya gul 'gags nad dang skad 'gags rnam pa bzhi/ /nam tshong spyir gnas skom dad skyigs bu dang / /dbugs mi bde dang yid 'chus 137

cham pa lnga / /spyi ru bsdoms pas dbye ba bco brgyad bshad do/ /ces pa ste/ rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba phye na lus sems gnyis yod pa las/sems la gnas pa'i nad la spyo byed kyi nad dang brjed byed kyi nad gnyis yod pa dang / lus la gnas pa'i nad ni stod dang smad dang phyi dang nang dang phyi nang kun la khyab pa'i nad bcas rnam pa lnga yi sgo nas bstan pa yin/ de yang dbang po lnga dang / mgo spyir gnas pa'i nad dang / de bzhin du mig nad/ rna ba'i nad/ sna nad/ mchu nad/ so nad/ lce nad/rkan nad/ lba ba'i nad bcas dgu dang / yang de bzhin du gre ba spyir gnas pa'i nad dang / gag nad/ mgul 'gags nad/ skad 'gags te bzhi dang / nam tshong nad la skom dad kyi nad/ skyigs bu'i nad/ dbugs mi bde ba'i nad/ yi ga 'chus pa'i nad/ cham pa'i nad lnga bcas spyi ru bsgril bas lus stong gi nad rigs dbye ba bco brgyad du bshad pa yin//don snod nang la gnas pa'i nad bstan pa/ /snying dang glo ba mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / /pho ba mkhris pa rgyu long lgang pa dang / /bsam se'i nad dang rnam pa bcu gcig go /don snod spyir gnas ma zhu glang 'thab skran/ /sur ya tshad 'khru rgyu gzer rnam pa drug /snod spyir gnas pa 'khru skyug rnam pa gnyis/ /spyi ru bsdoms rnga sa nad rigs bcu dgu 'o/ /zhes pa ste/ lus po'i nang don snod la gnas pa'i nad rnams ni/ snying nad dang / glo nad/ mchin nad/ mcher nad/ mkhal nad de lnga dang / pho 138

cham pa lnga / /spyi ru bsdoms pas dbye ba bco brgyad bshad do/ /ces pa ste/ rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba phye na lus sems gnyis yod pa las/sems la gnas pa'i nad la spyo byed kyi nad dang brjed byed kyi nad gnyis yod pa dang / lus la gnas pa'i nad ni stod dang smad dang phyi dang nang dang phyi nang kun la khyab pa'i nad bcas rnam pa lnga yi sgo nas bstan pa yin/ de yang dbang po lnga dang / mgo spyir gnas pa'i nad dang / de bzhin du mig nad/ rna ba'i nad/ sna nad/ mchu nad/ so nad/ lce nad/rkan nad/ lba ba'i nad bcas dgu dang / yang de bzhin du gre ba spyir gnas pa'i nad dang / gag nad/ mgul 'gags nad/ skad 'gags te bzhi dang / nam tshong nad la skom dad kyi nad/ skyigs bu'i nad/ dbugs mi bde ba'i nad/ yi ga 'chus pa'i nad/ cham pa'i nad lnga bcas spyi ru bsgril bas lus stong gi nad rigs dbye ba bco brgyad du bshad pa yin//don snod nang la gnas pa'i nad bstan pa/ /snying dang glo ba mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / /pho ba mkhris pa rgyu long lgang pa dang / /bsam se'i nad dang rnam pa bcu gcig go /don snod spyir gnas ma zhu glang 'thab skran/ /sur ya tshad 'khru rgyu gzer rnam pa drug /snod spyir gnas pa 'khru skyug rnam pa gnyis/ /spyi ru bsdoms rnga sa nad rigs bcu dgu 'o/ /zhes pa ste/ lus po'i nang don snod la gnas pa'i nad rnams ni/ snying nad dang / glo nad/ mchin nad/ mcher nad/ mkhal nad de lnga dang / pho 138

ba'i nad dang / mkhris nad/ rgyu nad/ long nad/ lgang nad/ bsam se'i nad de drug dang / don lnga snod drug spyir gnas pa'i nad de/ ma zhu ba'i nad dang / glang 'thab kyi nad/ skran nad/ skur ya'i nad/ tshad pas 'khru ba'i nad/ rgyu gzer gyi nad bcas drug snod drug spyir gnas pa'i nad de 'khru ba'i nad dang / skyugs pa'i nad de khyon bsdoms pas nang don snod kyi nad rigs bcu dgur bstan pa'o/ / smad gnas gzhang 'brum mtshan bar brdol ba dang / /rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga/ /zhes pa ste/ lus po'i smad la gnas pa'i nad ni/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad dang / mtshan bar brdol ba'i nad/rtag 'gags kyi nad/ gcin 'gags kyi nad/ gcin snyi'i nad de rnam pa lnga'o/ /phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te/ /pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang / /g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang / /reg pa'i dug dang 'dzer pa ngo khab dang / /nad gzhan pags la gram dang bcu ru bshad//sha yi nad la lba ba rmen gu gnyis/ /nad gzhan sha la rgyas dang rnam pa gsum/ rtsa yi nad la rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis/ /nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyu dang rnam pa gsum/ /rus pa'i nad la dreg dang rkang bam gnyis/ /nad gzhan rus la zhen dang rnam pa gsum/ /sha rus kun la gnas pa grum bu'i nad//spyi ru bsdoms pas nyi shu tham pa 'o/ / zhes pa ste/ lus kyi phyi la gnas 139

pa'i nad de pags pa dang / sha dang / rtsa dang / rus pa ste rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bstan cing / de yang dang po pags pa'i nad la sha bkra dang / bas ldags/ g.yan pa/ glang shu/ za rkong / shu ba/ reg pa'i dug mdzer pa/ngo khebs/ nad gzhan pags la 'grams pa sne bcu dang / blo bzhin du sha yi nad la/ lba ba'i nad dang / rmen bu'i nad/ nad gzhan sha la rgyas/ pa snye gsum dang / de bzhin du yang rtsa yi nad la yang rtsa dkar gyi nad dang / rtsa nag gi nad/ nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyu ba ste gsum/ de bzhin du dus pa'i nad la dreg nad dang / rkang bam/ nad gzhan rus la zhen pa ste gsum/ de bzhin sha rus pags/ pa rtsa dang bcas kun la gnas pa'i grum bu'i nad de khyon bsdoms pas nad rigs nyi shu tham pa'o/ /phyi nang kun tu khyab ba 'i nad rigs la/ /mkhris pa smug po dmu 'or skya rbab gcong / /tsha ba sde drug 'grams 'khrugs rims nad dang / /'brum bu ltog pa sbyar dug rdzi zer dug /rlung dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa yi dug/btsan dug khyi dug srin po sgrul gyi dug /'byung po gza' dang mdze 'bras me dbal srin/ /mgo dang byang khog yan lag rke yi rma/ /spyi ru bsdoms pas sum cu rtsa bdun/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig gnas kyi dbye bar 'dod//ces pa ste/ lus kyi stod smad phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad kyi rigs la dbye na 'di lta ste/ mkhris pa'i nad dang / bad kun smub/ po/ dmu chu'i ——nad/ 'or gyi nad/ skya rbab/ gcong chen zad byed kyi nad/ tsha ba ma smin 140

pa/ rgyas tshad/ stong tshad/ gab tshad/ rnying tshad/ rnyogs tshad de tsha ba sde drug dang / 'grams tshad/ 'khrugs tshad/ rims tshad/ 'brum bu/ ltog pa/ sbyar dug rlung gi rdzi dug nyi zer dug rlung dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa'i dug btsan dug khyi dug srin bu'i dug sgrul gyi dug 'byung po'i gdon/ gza'i gdon/ mdze nad/ 'bras nad/ me dbal/ srin nad/mgo bo'i rma/ byang khog gi rma/ yan lag gi rma/ rke'i rma bcas bsdoms nad rigs sum cu rtsa bdun yod cing / de dag yongs su bsgril nang sems la skyo byed dang brjed byed kyi nad gnyis/ lus stod mgo sogs spyir nad rigs bco brgyad/ nang don snod kyi nad rigs bcu dgu lus smad gzhang 'brum sogs nad rigs lnga / phyi gnas pags pa sogs kyi nad rigs gi shu/ phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs sum cu rtsa bdun bcas khyon nad rigs brgya dang rtsa gceg 'byung ba 'di dag rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas dbye bar 'dod pa yin/ /drug pa/ ngo bo rigs kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigaji skad du/ bshad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na khong nad dang / /rma dang tshad pa thor bu'i nad rigs bzhi/ /dang po khong nad sgo nas dbye ba la/ /ma zhu rgyu dang 'bras bu gcong nad gnyis//141

pa/ rgyas tshad/ stong tshad/ gab tshad/ rnying tshad/ rnyogs tshad de tsha ba sde drug dang / 'grams tshad/ 'khrugs tshad/ rims tshad/ 'brum bu/ ltog pa/ sbyar dug rlung gi rdzi dug nyi zer dug rlung dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa'i dug btsan dug khyi dug srin bu'i dug sgrul gyi dug 'byung po'i gdon/ gza'i gdon/ mdze nad/ 'bras nad/ me dbal/ srin nad/mgo bo'i rma/ byang khog gi rma/ yan lag gi rma/ rke'i rma bcas bsdoms nad rigs sum cu rtsa bdun yod cing / de dag yongs su bsgril nang sems la skyo byed dang brjed byed kyi nad gnyis/ lus stod mgo sogs spyir nad rigs bco brgyad/ nang don snod kyi nad rigs bcu dgu lus smad gzhang 'brum sogs nad rigs lnga / phyi gnas pags pa sogs kyi nad rigs gi shu/ phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs sum cu rtsa bdun bcas khyon nad rigs brgya dang rtsa gceg 'byung ba 'di dag rten pa gnas kyi sgo nas dbye bar 'dod pa yin/ /drug pa/ ngo bo rigs kyi sgo nas brgya rtsa gcigaji skad du/ bshad rgyud nad kyi dbye ba'i le'u las/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na khong nad dang / /rma dang tshad pa thor bu'i nad rigs bzhi/ /dang po khong nad sgo nas dbye ba la/ /ma zhu rgyu dang 'bras bu gcong nad gnyis//141

ma zhu ngo bo rigs grogs dus kyi bzhi/ /'bras bu gcong nad dbye ba gsar snying gnyis/ /gsar pa bad kun skya bo smug po dang / /mkhris pa'i nad dang dug gcong rnam pa bzhi/ /skya bo zhen dang lcags dreg me nyams dang / /mgul 'gags grum bu dkar po 'ju skams drug /smug po byer rgyas brdol ral 'gyings dang 'dril/ /gab 'thab 'or lhung grang ba snying chad bcu/ /mkhris pa kha lud rtsa rgyug gnas gyur gsum/ /dug gi gcong la tsha sbyor grang sbyor gnyis/ /rnying pa skran dang dmu 'or skya rbab bzhi//ga cong chen zad byed nad dang rnam pa lnga/ /skran la khrag mkhris lhen dang rdo yi skran/ /rlung srin rtsa chu'i skran dang brgyad du bshad/ /dmu chu byer zags 'khyims chu rdol chu bzhi/ /'or la tsha 'or grang 'or rnam pa gnyis//skya rbab glo snying mchin mcher chu ser lnga / /zad byed rlung mkhris bad kun bla gnyan bzhi/ /khong nad spyi bsdoms bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad do/ / zhes pa ste/ skabs 'dir ngo bo rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba bstan pa ni/ gtso bo khong nad dang / rma dang / tshad pa dang / thor bu'i nad dang bcas rnam pa bzhi yis dbang du byas nas bstan cing / de yang dang po khong nad kyi nad la/ khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba rgyu ma zhu ba las skyed pa'i phyir na/ rgyu de la ngo bos ma zhu ba dang / rigs kyis ma zhu ba/ grogs kyis ma zhu ba/ dus kyis ma zhu ba bcas bzhi yod la/ rgyu de dag las skyed pa'i 'bras bu gcong nad gsar rnying gnyis byung ba las/ gsar pa la nang gses bzhi yod 142

pa'i dang po bad kun skya bo la/ lhen dang / lcags dreg me drod nyams pa/ mgul 'gags/ grum bu dkar po/ 'ju skems ste drug dang / gnyis pa smug po la/ byer ba dang / rgyas pa/ gyen du brdol ba/ thur du ral ba/ 'gyings pa/ skran du 'dril ba/ gab pa/ 'thab pa/ 'or du lhung ba/ tha ma grang ba snying chad pa dang bcu/ gsum pa mkhris pa'i nad la/ snod mkhris kha lud dang / rtsar rgyug gnas gyur ste gsum/ bzhi pa dug gcong la tsha sbyor dang grang sbyor gnyis bsgril bas/ 'bras bu gcong nad gsar pa la nyi shu rtsa gcig byung ba dang / de bzhin du 'bras bu gcong nad rnying pa la nang gses skran nad dang / dmu chu/ 'or nad/ skya rbab bcas bzhi yod pa las/ dang po skran nad la/ khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ lhen skran/rdo skran/ rlung skran/ srin skran/ rtsa skran/ chu skran te brgyad dang / gnyis pa dmu chu la/ byer ba/ zags pa/ 'khyims chu/ rdol chu ste ba'i dang / —gsum pa 'or nad la/ tsha 'or dang / grang 'or gnyis/ bzhi pa skya rbab la/ glo ba skya rbab/ snying skya rbab/ mchin pa skya rbab/ mcher pa'i skya rbab/chu ser skya rbab ste lnga/ yang de bzhin du gcong chen zad byed la/ rlung las rgyur pa'i zad byed/ mkhris pa las gyur ba'i zad byed/ bad kun las gyur pa'i zad byed/ gcong chen gyi bla gnyan te rnam pa bzhi bcas 'bras bu gcong nad rnying pa la nyi shu rtsa gsum byung zhing / mdor bsdus na/ rgyu ma zhu ba bzhi dang / 'bras bu gcong nad gas/ra par nyer gcig143

pa'i dang po bad kun skya bo la/ lhen dang / lcags dreg me drod nyams pa/ mgul 'gags/ grum bu dkar po/ 'ju skems ste drug dang / gnyis pa smug po la/ byer ba dang / rgyas pa/ gyen du brdol ba/ thur du ral ba/ 'gyings pa/ skran du 'dril ba/ gab pa/ 'thab pa/ 'or du lhung ba/ tha ma grang ba snying chad pa dang bcu/ gsum pa mkhris pa'i nad la/ snod mkhris kha lud dang / rtsar rgyug gnas gyur ste gsum/ bzhi pa dug gcong la tsha sbyor dang grang sbyor gnyis bsgril bas/ 'bras bu gcong nad gsar pa la nyi shu rtsa gcig byung ba dang / de bzhin du 'bras bu gcong nad rnying pa la nang gses skran nad dang / dmu chu/ 'or nad/ skya rbab bcas bzhi yod pa las/ dang po skran nad la/ khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ lhen skran/rdo skran/ rlung skran/ srin skran/ rtsa skran/ chu skran te brgyad dang / gnyis pa dmu chu la/ byer ba/ zags pa/ 'khyims chu/ rdol chu ste ba'i dang / —gsum pa 'or nad la/ tsha 'or dang / grang 'or gnyis/ bzhi pa skya rbab la/ glo ba skya rbab/ snying skya rbab/ mchin pa skya rbab/ mcher pa'i skya rbab/chu ser skya rbab ste lnga/ yang de bzhin du gcong chen zad byed la/ rlung las rgyur pa'i zad byed/ mkhris pa las gyur ba'i zad byed/ bad kun las gyur pa'i zad byed/ gcong chen gyi bla gnyan te rnam pa bzhi bcas 'bras bu gcong nad rnying pa la nyi shu rtsa gsum byung zhing / mdor bsdus na/ rgyu ma zhu ba bzhi dang / 'bras bu gcong nad gas/ra par nyer gcig143

snying par nyer gsum ste bsgril bas spyi bsdoms khong nad bzhi cu rtsa brgyad do/ /de nyid las/ rma la lhan cig skyes dang glo bur ba/ /lhan skyes 'bras dang rmen bu skur ya dang / /me dbal gzhang 'brum rkang bam mtshan bar rdol/ /glo bur rma la gnas dang rigs kyis dbye/ /gnas ni mgo ske byang khog yan lag la/ /rma rigs bshus bcad rnam par bcad pa dang //'phyang lhung phug gshags grub pa rnam pa brgyad/ /spyi ru bsdoms pas dbye ba bco lnga'o/ /zhes pa ste/ lus kyi pags pa sha gdan sogs ral nas 'phral du lus nyams shing dma' ba la rma zhes bya ba dang / de yang mda' rdo gri mtshon sogs las byung ba ma yin par lus la lhan cig tu skyes pa'i rma dang / rkyen glo bur las/ byung ba'i rma gnyis su 'dus shing / lhan skyes/ rma la 'bras dang / rmen bu/ sur ya/ me dbal/ gzhang 'brum/ rkang bam/ mtshan bar rdol ba ste rma rigs bdun dang / de bzhin du yang phyi rkyen gro bur ba las byung ba'i rma rigs ni gnas lus po'i mgo dang / ske/byang khog stod smad dang / yan lag bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i sar byung la/ rma la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ pags pa bshus pa'i rma dang / sha phred la bcad pa/ rma gting rus pa la thug pa rnam par bcad pa dang /rus pa bcad nas sha lhub lhub tu 'phyang ba/ sha bcad nas sa la lhung ba/byang khog tu i khung 'jigs pa ste phug pa/ yar mar gyen thur du gshags 144

snying par nyer gsum ste bsgril bas spyi bsdoms khong nad bzhi cu rtsa brgyad do/ /de nyid las/ rma la lhan cig skyes dang glo bur ba/ /lhan skyes 'bras dang rmen bu skur ya dang / /me dbal gzhang 'brum rkang bam mtshan bar rdol/ /glo bur rma la gnas dang rigs kyis dbye/ /gnas ni mgo ske byang khog yan lag la/ /rma rigs bshus bcad rnam par bcad pa dang //'phyang lhung phug gshags grub pa rnam pa brgyad/ /spyi ru bsdoms pas dbye ba bco lnga'o/ /zhes pa ste/ lus kyi pags pa sha gdan sogs ral nas 'phral du lus nyams shing dma' ba la rma zhes bya ba dang / de yang mda' rdo gri mtshon sogs las byung ba ma yin par lus la lhan cig tu skyes pa'i rma dang / rkyen glo bur las/ byung ba'i rma gnyis su 'dus shing / lhan skyes/ rma la 'bras dang / rmen bu/ sur ya/ me dbal/ gzhang 'brum/ rkang bam/ mtshan bar rdol ba ste rma rigs bdun dang / de bzhin du yang phyi rkyen gro bur ba las byung ba'i rma rigs ni gnas lus po'i mgo dang / ske/byang khog stod smad dang / yan lag bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i sar byung la/ rma la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ pags pa bshus pa'i rma dang / sha phred la bcad pa/ rma gting rus pa la thug pa rnam par bcad pa dang /rus pa bcad nas sha lhub lhub tu 'phyang ba/ sha bcad nas sa la lhung ba/byang khog tu i khung 'jigs pa ste phug pa/ yar mar gyen thur du gshags 144

pa/ rus pa chag pa la grub pa zhes brgyad byung la de dag spyi ru bsdoms pas rma rigs grangs bco lngar gyur ba yin/ /de nyid las/ tsha ba ma smin rgyas stongs gab snyings rnyogs/ /'grams 'khrugs rims nad dug tshad rnam pa bzhi/ /'grams la phyi 'grams na nga 'grams rnam pa gnyis/ /'khrugs la rgyas 'khrugs stong 'khrugs 'jam 'khrugs gsum/ /rims la bad nad rgyu gzer 'brum pa dang / /gag ltog cham pa'i nad dang rnam pa lnga/ /dug la sbyar dug gyur dug dngos dug gsum/ /zhes pa ste/ tsha ba'i nad la rigs mi 'dra ba khag bcu dgu yod pa ste/ tsha ba ma smin pa dang / rgyas tshad/ stongs tshad/ gab tshad/ snyings tshad/ rnyogs tshad de drug dang / de bzhin du yang / 'grams tshad la phyi 'grams dang nang 'grams gnyis/ 'khrugs tshad la/ rgyas 'khrugs dang /stong 'khrugs/ 'jam 'khrugs te gsum/ rims tshad la/ bad nad/ rgyu gzer/ 'brum pa/ gag ltog cham pa ste lnga / dug nad la/ sbyar dugadangos dug gyur dug ste gsum bcas khyon yongs su bsgril bas bcu dgu yod/ /de nyid las/ thor bu skad 'gags skyegs bu yi ga 'chus/ /skom dad dbugs mi bde dang glang thabs srin/ /'khru skyug dri ma gcin 'gag gcin snyi dang / /tshad 'khru dreg grum chu ser rtsa dkar dang / /lngags nad phran bu thor bu bcu dgu 'o/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig rigs kyi dbye bar 145

pa/ rus pa chag pa la grub pa zhes brgyad byung la de dag spyi ru bsdoms pas rma rigs grangs bco lngar gyur ba yin/ /de nyid las/ tsha ba ma smin rgyas stongs gab snyings rnyogs/ /'grams 'khrugs rims nad dug tshad rnam pa bzhi/ /'grams la phyi 'grams na nga 'grams rnam pa gnyis/ /'khrugs la rgyas 'khrugs stong 'khrugs 'jam 'khrugs gsum/ /rims la bad nad rgyu gzer 'brum pa dang / /gag ltog cham pa'i nad dang rnam pa lnga/ /dug la sbyar dug gyur dug dngos dug gsum/ /zhes pa ste/ tsha ba'i nad la rigs mi 'dra ba khag bcu dgu yod pa ste/ tsha ba ma smin pa dang / rgyas tshad/ stongs tshad/ gab tshad/ snyings tshad/ rnyogs tshad de drug dang / de bzhin du yang / 'grams tshad la phyi 'grams dang nang 'grams gnyis/ 'khrugs tshad la/ rgyas 'khrugs dang /stong 'khrugs/ 'jam 'khrugs te gsum/ rims tshad la/ bad nad/ rgyu gzer/ 'brum pa/ gag ltog cham pa ste lnga / dug nad la/ sbyar dugadangos dug gyur dug ste gsum bcas khyon yongs su bsgril bas bcu dgu yod/ /de nyid las/ thor bu skad 'gags skyegs bu yi ga 'chus/ /skom dad dbugs mi bde dang glang thabs srin/ /'khru skyug dri ma gcin 'gag gcin snyi dang / /tshad 'khru dreg grum chu ser rtsa dkar dang / /lngags nad phran bu thor bu bcu dgu 'o/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig rigs kyi dbye bar 145

'dod/ /ces pa ste/ nad kyi rnam pa gcig tu ma nges par nad rigs sna tshorges su thor ba dag dbye ba 'byed na 'di ltar yod de/ skad 'gags dang / skyigs bu/ yi ga 'chus pa/ skom dad/ dbugs mi bde/ glang —thabs/ srin nad/ 'khru ba/ skyugs pa/ dri ma 'gags pa/ gcin 'gags/gcin snyi/ tshad 'khru/ dreg nad/ grum bu'i nad/ chu ser nad/ rtsa dkar nad/ lpags nad/ phran bu'i nad bcas bcu dgu dang / de ltar khong nad bzhi cu rtsa brgyad/ rma yi nad bco lnga/ tsha ba'i nad rigs bcu dgu/thor bu'i nad rigs bcu dgu ste khyon yongs su bsgril bas ngo bo rigs kyi sgo nas brgya dang rtsa gcig tu 'dod pa yin/ /— de nyid las/ rnam pa'i sgo nas dpag tu med par dbye/ /nyes pa gnod bya gi shu rtsa lnga la/ /rkyang pa ldan 'dus du ma'i rigs byung bas/ /grangs dang ming gi nges gtan yod ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi ni/ ming gi rnam grangs gsal por bstan cing dbye ba phye ba yin yang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi re re la yang / sngon bsags las ngan tshabs che bsags zin pa'i 'bras bu las byung ba'i gzhan dbang sngon las kyi nad/ kun btags gdon gyi nad/ yongs grub tshe 'di'i nad/ ltar snang 'phral nad bcas bzhi re sbyar bas yang nad stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya bcu drug byung ba yin la/ der ma zad da dung lus sems gnyis la gnod par byed pa'i nyes pa rlung mkhris bad 146

kun gyi nad bco lngas lus kyi gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang / dri ma gsum bcas nyi shu rtsa lnga dag la/ rkyang pa'i nad dang / ldan pa'i nad dang / 'dus pa'i nad/ bla gnyan gyi nad sogs sbyar na/ bdun stong brgyad brgya byung zhing / de la yang 'phel ba dang / rab tu 'phel ba mchog tu 'phel ba sogs 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum la sbyar na yang bdun khri stong med nyis brgya byung zhing / da dung sbyar na/ bye ba sa ya dung phyur sogs nad kyi rnam grangs la ni grangs med cing dpag tu med par 'gyur ba yin gshis/ sus kyang bstan du rung ba yod pa ma yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i nad kyi rnam grangs kyi dbye ba 'di dag la mno bsam zhib mor btang tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams na 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i lus can kun kyang mthar nad kyi rnam grangs 'di dag gang yang rung ba zhig gi 'og tu mi 'dod bzhin du nges par 'chi bar 'gyur ba la ni sus kyang ldog tu med la/ 'das pa'i mi lo stong phrag mang po'i dus su 'jig rten 'di'i steng du 'gro ba sems can mtha' yas grangs kyis yul las 'das pa zhig byung nas de dag 'tsho zhing gnas par gyur kyang / mthar nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i 'og las thar te ma shi bar sdod thub pa ni da bar du gcig kyang byung med 'a / da lta'i dus su yang 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i skye bo grangs kyis mi lang ba zhis/ yod kyang / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i ra ba las thar thub pa ni su gcig 147

kyang med par nges shing / ma 'ongs par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i skye 'gro dpag tu med pa yod srid kyang / mthar yang nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi zug rngu mngon du gyur ba'i 'og tu mi 'dod bzhin du lus sems gnyis kha bral te/ 'jig rten 'di'i pha rol tu 'gro dgos pa sogs 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni/ tshe mi rtag cing mi brtan pa'i chos nyid kyi rang bzhin kho na'i ngang tshul 'di la bkag pa'i thabs/ srung ba'i byus/bros pa'i sa/ gab pa'i gnas/ bzlog pa'i mthu sogs gang yang med pas rgyun du sems bzang po dang gzhan phan gyi bya bar brtson par byed pa ni mi tshe'i snying po zhig tu gyur bar yin// // 148

le'u bzhi pa/las 'bras sam rgyu 'bras kyi skor bshad pa la nyer gcigadang po/ spyi rgyu 'khor ba thun mong gi rgyu ma rig pa/spyir 'khor ba thun mong ba'i rgyu rtsa ba ma rig pa bstan par bya ba ni /bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa las/ nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ /bdag med don ma rtogs pas ma rig ces/ /dper na bya ni mkha' la lding gyur kyang / /rang gi grib ma de dang mi bral zhing / /'gro kun bde bar gnas shing spyod na yang / /ma rig ldan pas nad dang 'bral mi srid//ces pa ste/ 'khor ba'i thun mong gi rgyur gyur ba'i rtsa ba ni ma rig pa zhes pa de yin zhing / de lta bu'i ma rig pa zhes pa'i don ni/ don dam par bdag dang sem sa can dang dngos po dang snang ba thams cad rang ngos nas rang bzhin gyi tshul du grub pa rdul phran phra mo tsam med cing / bdag med pa'i rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das kyang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams kun rdzob tu 'khrul pa'i dri mas sbags pa la brten nas bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gyi don dam dngos po thams cad bdag tu bzung nas dermo'i don ma shes pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs pa dang / log par 149

le'u bzhi pa/las 'bras sam rgyu 'bras kyi skor bshad pa la nyer gcigadang po/ spyi rgyu 'khor ba thun mong gi rgyu ma rig pa/spyir 'khor ba thun mong ba'i rgyu rtsa ba ma rig pa bstan par bya ba ni /bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa las/ nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ /bdag med don ma rtogs pas ma rig ces/ /dper na bya ni mkha' la lding gyur kyang / /rang gi grib ma de dang mi bral zhing / /'gro kun bde bar gnas shing spyod na yang / /ma rig ldan pas nad dang 'bral mi srid//ces pa ste/ 'khor ba'i thun mong gi rgyur gyur ba'i rtsa ba ni ma rig pa zhes pa de yin zhing / de lta bu'i ma rig pa zhes pa'i don ni/ don dam par bdag dang sem sa can dang dngos po dang snang ba thams cad rang ngos nas rang bzhin gyi tshul du grub pa rdul phran phra mo tsam med cing / bdag med pa'i rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das kyang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams kun rdzob tu 'khrul pa'i dri mas sbags pa la brten nas bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gyi don dam dngos po thams cad bdag tu bzung nas dermo'i don ma shes pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs pa dang / log par 149

rtogs pa'i phyin ci log gi blos kun nas bslangs shing bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin dang / gces par 'dzin pa'i gces 'dzin gnyis sems kyi khongs su lhang nger skyes pa'i tshul du yod pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya ba de 'gro ba rigs drug si sems can thams cad kyi rang rang so so'i rgyud la dus thog ma med pa nas bzung ma sgrub lhun 'grub kyi tshul du yongs su grub pa'i 'khor ba'i thun mong ba'i spyi rgyu mi dge ba ma rig pa gcig ngu de nyid nad rnams kun gyi rgyu yin pa tsam ma zad nyon mongs pa'i rigs su gyur pa mtha' dag dang blang dor gyi glo phyin ji log pa thams cad rtsa cob de las skyes shing / 'jig rten nang bya ba yongs rdzogs phungs su bcug nas nyams sam rgud par byed mkhan gyi rgyu'i rtsa ba'am gtso bo yang de kho na nyid yin te/ kun mkhyen myong kha pa chen pos/ /'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/ /de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ma rig pa des 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar byed ce na/ man ngag yon tan rgyud las/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams/ /zhes pa ste/ spyir 'khor ba ni zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po skye ba'i rgyun gyi cha la go dgos shing / rtsa ba ma rig pa de las 'dod chags skyes shing de'i dbang gis las ngan ji snyed cig bsags pa'i sdig pa'i rgyu las 'bras bur 'gro ba rigs drug gi ya gyal du mi yi lus bslangs pa dang / rtsa ba ma rig pa de las zhe snang skyes shing de'i dbang gis sdig pa'i phung po ji snyed cig bsags 150

pa'i mthus rgyu las 'bras bu'i tshul du dmyal bar skye ba dang / rtsa ba rgyu ma rig pa de las gti mug skyes shing de'i dbang gis las ngan ji ltar bsags pa dag las rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba dang / rtsa ba ma rig pa de las yang phrag dog skyes shing de'i dbang gis sdig pa gang bsags pa'i rgyus 'bras bu'i tshul du lha ma yin gyi khongs su skye ba len pa dang / rtsa ba ma rig pa de las yang nga rgyal skyes shing de'i tshodabang gis sdig pa mi dge ba gang bsags pa'i rgyus 'bras bur lha yi gnas su skye ba len pa dang / rtsa ba ma rig pa de las yang ser sna skye zhing de'i dbang gis ser sna'i rgyus sdig pa mi dge ba ji tsam bsags pa las 'bras bur yi dgas kyi lus ngan len zhing / 'gro ba rigs drug gi skye gnas gang du skye ba len na yang rang rang so so'i nyon mongs pa'i rgyu mi dge ba mi 'dra ba dag las 'bras bur lus rten mi 'dra ba'i skye ba blangs nas lus sems gnyis su sdug bsngal yang mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs su myong bar gyur ba ni chos nyid yin zhing / rgyu gang bsags pa las 'bras bu yang de 'dra ba zhig smin pa ni dngos po'i chos thams cad kyi rang gshis yin te/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ 'bras bu de ltar nyid du 'gyur/zhes dang / bod kye gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las kyang / slong ba rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam rnams/ /gang zos gang byas nad kun rtogs par nus//sngakhyad par srong ba'i rkyen gyis shes par bya/ /ci phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 151

'gal mi srid/ /ces sman pas nad pa'i nad brtag thabs su thog mar nad pas rgyu zas skom gang zhig zos zhing 'thung ba dang / spyod lam gang zhig byas pa dris na nad de dang po nyes pa gang zhig gis bskyed pa yin pa rtogs pa ma zad khyad par spong ba'i nad kyi rkyen dngos kyi rang rang gi chos dang mthun pa'i nad kyi zug rngu mngon gyur du ldang bar byed cing /chos de dang mi mthun pa'i nad cig ldang mi srid la/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu med na 'bras bu yong mi srid la/ 'bras bu yod nā rgyu yi rjes su mthun zhing 'gro ba las gzha na pa'i rgyu las go ldog pa'i 'bras bu rtsa ba nas 'gal ba zhig 'byung mi srid de/ rgyu 'bras phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba'i gshis lugs sam rang bzhin gyi chos nyid yin pa de'i phyir 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa de las 'du byed/ rnam shes/ ming gzugs/bskyed mched/ reg pa/ tshor ba/ srid pa/ len pa/ sred pa/ skye ba/ rga shi bcas kyis rkyen byas te rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis 'khor ba'i tshul gyis srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang yang nas yang du 'khor zhing 'khyams pa na rgyud las/ las ngan bag chags rgyun 'khrigs bsags pa yis/ /'khor ba'i khar brgyud lus ngan sna tshogs blangs/ /de'i phyir las dang nyes pa las byung ba'i/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad du grags pa yis/ /bde ba'i bar skabs med par lus sems gdung / /zhes las sam bya ba ngan pa'i bag chags phra mo tshun chad kun 152

gzhi'i sems kyi steng du rgyun ma chad par gcig mjug gcig mthud kyi 'brel ba 'khrigs chags su bsags shing gnas pa des/ shin tu thar bar dka' ba'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi skye gnas so so'i 'khor ba'i khar brgyud nas sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bur lus ngan pa rnam pa sna tshogs su blangs pa de'i phyir/ tshe rabs sngon bsags pa'i las kyi 'bras bu dang / tshe 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun 'phel zad 'khrugs pa dang / mdor na nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad ces mi 'dod pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi zug rngus rab tu gtses shing bde ba'i go skabs 'phrog nas lus sems gnyis lhan cig tu gnod cing gdung ba byed pa yin kyang / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dag rnam par ma gyur ba'i skabs su mi rnams bde ba la longs su spyod cing yod na yang / de ni don dam bde ba ma yin zhing rgyu mi dge ba bsags pa'i 'bras bur sdug bsngal la lo ngas su spyod pa sha stago/ yin te/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi nang tshan khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ngo yag po ma 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis lus can rnams na ba dang tsha ba med pa'i skabs su 'khrul ba'i blos bslad de bde ba yin snyam du sems pa dag sdug bsngal bde bar 'dzin pa'i log shes kho na yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bshad rgyud las/ de nyid mngal du grub pa'i tshul bstan pa/ /skye ba'i dang po khu ba khrag la gnas/ /dper na dug can sdin 'bu dug skyes mtshungs/ /zhes srid pa bar dor 'khyams shing rgyu ba'i 153

rnam shes de ma yi mngal du thogs shing skye ba len pa'i dang po pha yi khu ba dkar po dang ma yi khrag dmar po bcas phan tshun 'dres shing tshogs pa'i dus de nas bzung nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum rang chas su grub ste/ dang po lus ma yi mngal du chags shing skye ba dang / bar du 'phel zhing gnas par byed pa/ mthar lus nyams shing 'jig par byed pa yin te/ dper na/ dug can shing gi sdong po la brten nas skyes pa'i srin po'i lus de dang po rgyu dug can shing gi sdong pos srin po'i lus skye ba dang /bar du dug rang las skyes pa'i srin po'i lus 'tsho bar byed cing / mthar dug de srin po'i srog 'phrog nas 'joms par byed pa'i dpe dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir/ mdor na mkhas dbang skyems pa tshe dbang gi rgyud 'grel las/ chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ bdag dang bdag yir 'dzin pa thams cad med cing nye bar zhi ba'i don de ma shes pas nga'o snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin nam bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid de la/de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya ste/ de ni nyon mongs thams cad kyi rten/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rgyu sdug bsngal thams cad dang mi 'bral pa'i rtsa ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgung sngon gyi mkha' dbyings su phur ba'i bya ni shog rtsal gyis nam mkhar phur lding ji tsam byed par gyur kyang / nam zhig bya de gnas gang du babs kyang de dang lhan cig tu bya rang gi grib ma de dang nam yang mi bral ba'i dpe bzhin du ji 154

srid 'gro ba sems can kun nyon mongs pa'i rtsa bar gyur ba'i rmongs pa'i ma rig pa de dang ma bral ba de srid du nad dang bral ba mi srid de/ bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa las/ dper na bya ni nam mkha' la lding gyur kyang / /rang gi grib ma de dang mi 'bral zhing / /'gro kun bde bar gnas shing spyod na yang / /ma rig ldan pas nad dang 'bral mi srid/ /ces dang / yang / man rgyud tsha ba spyi'i le'ur/ ci'i phyir ma rig med na nyon mongs med/ /nyon mongs med par zhe sdang mi 'byung ste/ /zhe snang med par tsha ba 'byung mi srid/ /ces ma rig pa de med par gyur na/ de las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dug lnga sogs gang yang med par gyur cing /nyon mongs pa'i dug gsum med na 'dod chags las rlung dang / zhe snang las mkhris pa/ gti mug las bad kun skye ba med cing / nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum med na ni nad kyi rigs su gyur ba tha dag med cing de'i phyir 'khor ba'i rtsa ba spyi rgyu ma rig pa ldan pa phyin chad la nad dang nam yang bral mi srid pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ khyad par gyi rgyu 'dod chags skor/bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u las/ khyad par rgyu ni ma rig las byung ba'i/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum las/ /'bras — 155

srid 'gro ba sems can kun nyon mongs pa'i rtsa bar gyur ba'i rmongs pa'i ma rig pa de dang ma bral ba de srid du nad dang bral ba mi srid de/ bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa las/ dper na bya ni nam mkha' la lding gyur kyang / /rang gi grib ma de dang mi 'bral zhing / /'gro kun bde bar gnas shing spyod na yang / /ma rig ldan pas nad dang 'bral mi srid/ /ces dang / yang / man rgyud tsha ba spyi'i le'ur/ ci'i phyir ma rig med na nyon mongs med/ /nyon mongs med par zhe sdang mi 'byung ste/ /zhe snang med par tsha ba 'byung mi srid/ /ces ma rig pa de med par gyur na/ de las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dug lnga sogs gang yang med par gyur cing /nyon mongs pa'i dug gsum med na 'dod chags las rlung dang / zhe snang las mkhris pa/ gti mug las bad kun skye ba med cing / nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum med na ni nad kyi rigs su gyur ba tha dag med cing de'i phyir 'khor ba'i rtsa ba spyi rgyu ma rig pa ldan pa phyin chad la nad dang nam yang bral mi srid pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ khyad par gyi rgyu 'dod chags skor/bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u las/ khyad par rgyu ni ma rig las byung ba'i/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum las/ /'bras — 155

bu rlung mkhris bad kun nyes pa skyed/ ces pa ste/ bdag 'dzin ma rig pa de las 'dod chags skyed cing / de ni yul yid du 'ong ba'am yid la 'thad pa'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad la dmigs pa gtod cing de la chags shing zhen pas zag bcas kyi dngos po dag la glo chags nas shin tu bral dka' ba'i rnam pas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang sred pa'i 'dod chags gnyis kyi zhags pas 'khor ba'i bcon rar lus can rnams dam por bcings nas na rga'i sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa yin pas sems byung de la 'dod chags zer ba yin/ 'dod sred zhags pas 'khor ba'i bcon rar bcing / /las kyi chu bos srid pa'i rgya mtshor khyer/ /zhes bstan pa bzhin/ 'dod chags las tshe 'dir rlung nad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa'i rlung nad ma lus pa mtha' dag skyed par byed cing / tshe rabs phyi ma yang srid pa'i 'dod yon la rab tu chags nas mi yi lus blangs shing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba dka' bar 'gyur ba ste/rje dge 'dun grub pas/ /shin tu brgal dka'i srid pa'i rgyun phyogs khyer//las rlung drag po'i rkyen dang nye ba las/ /rkye rga na 'chi'i rba klong rab 'khrugs pa'i/ /'dod chags chu bo'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lus can skye bo'i tshogs rnams srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu shin tu brgal dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'dod sred gnyis kyis chags pas kun nas bslangs pa'i byed las 156

bu rlung mkhris bad kun nyes pa skyed/ ces pa ste/ bdag 'dzin ma rig pa de las 'dod chags skyed cing / de ni yul yid du 'ong ba'am yid la 'thad pa'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad la dmigs pa gtod cing de la chags shing zhen pas zag bcas kyi dngos po dag la glo chags nas shin tu bral dka' ba'i rnam pas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang sred pa'i 'dod chags gnyis kyi zhags pas 'khor ba'i bcon rar lus can rnams dam por bcings nas na rga'i sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa yin pas sems byung de la 'dod chags zer ba yin/ 'dod sred zhags pas 'khor ba'i bcon rar bcing / /las kyi chu bos srid pa'i rgya mtshor khyer/ /zhes bstan pa bzhin/ 'dod chags las tshe 'dir rlung nad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa'i rlung nad ma lus pa mtha' dag skyed par byed cing / tshe rabs phyi ma yang srid pa'i 'dod yon la rab tu chags nas mi yi lus blangs shing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba dka' bar 'gyur ba ste/rje dge 'dun grub pas/ /shin tu brgal dka'i srid pa'i rgyun phyogs khyer//las rlung drag po'i rkyen dang nye ba las/ /rkye rga na 'chi'i rba klong rab 'khrugs pa'i/ /'dod chags chu bo'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lus can skye bo'i tshogs rnams srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu shin tu brgal dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'dod sred gnyis kyis chags pas kun nas bslangs pa'i byed las 156

kyi sdug bsngal skyed par byed cing / skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong rab tu g.yo shing 'khrugs par byed pa yin/ 'grel pa zla zer las kyang / 'dod pa'i yul rnams la 'dod cing chags pa la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /gsum pa/ khyad par gyi rgyu zhe snang skor/gong smos rtsa ba ma rig pa de las yang zhe snang skyed par byed cing / de ni zag pa data bcas pa'i chos kyi dngos po la dmigs te yul yid du mi 'ong ba la sems khongs zhe thag pa nas 'khon du 'dzin pa'i rnam pas 'gras shing sdang ba'i sems kyis kun nas mnar sems kyi byed las kyis bde ba la mi gnas par sems 'khrugs shing 'bar ba byed pa'i sems byung la zhe snang zer/ de lta gu'i zhe snang gi sgo nas las ngan pa gang bsags pa phyin chad sems can dmyal bar skye bar byed pa ma zad tshe 'dir mngon gyur du zhe snang las mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug la sogs pa'i khrag dang mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i nad ji snyed cig skyed par byed la/ lus sems gnyis bde ba la reg par mi gnas par rgyud rab tu 'khrugs par byed pa'i rgyu rkyen yang gtso bo des byed cing / lus sems gnyis kyi 'phrod bsten la yang shin tu gnod tshabs che ba'i khar sdig pa yang shin tu mi zad 157

pa'i stobs chen po gsog pa yin te/ slob dpon blo ba grags pas/ /zhe snang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis ba sgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang deng gi dus su 'dzam bu gling gi mi dang dud 'gro srog chags tshang ma zhi bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho bar longs su spyod thub dang ma thub yang khong khro'i nyes dmigs la bsams te de'i ldog zlar phan tshun bzod sran dang bzod pa'i nyams len ga tshod byed thub min kho na la rag lus shing / lhag don deng dus bzod par dka' ba'i nad dang mu ge rdul phran mtshon cha'i bskal pa ngan pa dar ba'i dus su rgyal khab dang / mi rigs/ chos lugs sogs mi dang mi phan tshun gyi bar la'ang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam blos zhe snang khong khro'i dbang du song na da lta 'dzam bu gling pa'i rang byung khor yug gi drod skyid ldan pa'i khyim tshang chen po 'di dang de'i nang du gnas shing 'tsho ba'i spun zla'i mi rigs dung phyur mang po dang / snying rje zhing yid du 'ong ba'i srog chags grangs kyis mi langs ba dag la bzod par dka' ba'i dka' tshegs chen po zhig phrad par nges la/khong khros rgyud rab tu 'khrugs pa'i byed las kyis tshe rabs 'bum phrag du ma'i sngon nas bsags zin pa'i rnam dkar legs byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dus cig car nyid du me stag phra mo zhig gis nags tshal chen po zhig bsregs pa'i dpe ltar gcig mtshungs su 'gyur ba yin te/ ston pas /158

pa'i stobs chen po gsog pa yin te/ slob dpon blo ba grags pas/ /zhe snang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis ba sgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang deng gi dus su 'dzam bu gling gi mi dang dud 'gro srog chags tshang ma zhi bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho bar longs su spyod thub dang ma thub yang khong khro'i nyes dmigs la bsams te de'i ldog zlar phan tshun bzod sran dang bzod pa'i nyams len ga tshod byed thub min kho na la rag lus shing / lhag don deng dus bzod par dka' ba'i nad dang mu ge rdul phran mtshon cha'i bskal pa ngan pa dar ba'i dus su rgyal khab dang / mi rigs/ chos lugs sogs mi dang mi phan tshun gyi bar la'ang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam blos zhe snang khong khro'i dbang du song na da lta 'dzam bu gling pa'i rang byung khor yug gi drod skyid ldan pa'i khyim tshang chen po 'di dang de'i nang du gnas shing 'tsho ba'i spun zla'i mi rigs dung phyur mang po dang / snying rje zhing yid du 'ong ba'i srog chags grangs kyis mi langs ba dag la bzod par dka' ba'i dka' tshegs chen po zhig phrad par nges la/khong khros rgyud rab tu 'khrugs pa'i byed las kyis tshe rabs 'bum phrag du ma'i sngon nas bsags zin pa'i rnam dkar legs byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dus cig car nyid du me stag phra mo zhig gis nags tshal chen po zhig bsregs pa'i dpe ltar gcig mtshungs su 'gyur ba yin te/ ston pas /158

bskal pa stong du phyin pa'i tshogs/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs bya gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'jom par byed/ /ces dang / yang / rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pas/ /tshul min yid byed rlung gis bskul pa las/ /nyes spyod dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil na/ /dge ba'i nags tshal sreg pa'i nus pa can/ /zhe snang me yi 'jig pa skyabs tu gsol/ /zhes zhe snang gis nyes pas rang gi dge rtsa thams cad 'jom par byed pa yin/ skyems 'grel las kyang / khro ba ni sems kyi zhe snang gang du'ang chags pa med pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba la zhe 'gras shing snang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa/ khyad par gyi rgyu gti mug skor/bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa las skyed pa'i gti mug ni blang dor gyi gnad lugs ma shes pa dang ma rtogs pa'i blo phyin ci log gis las 'bras spang blang gi gnas la glo rmongs shing snyi ba'i rnam pa can gyi rang mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal yin zhing / 'dod pa bde ba sha stag yin kyang blo rmongs pa des kun nas blangs pa'i byed las kyis tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas su gyar ba byed mkhan de la gti mug ces zer/ khro ru tshe rnam gyi drang srong zhal lung las kyang / gti mug ste lus sems kyi bde ba 159

'brog par byed pa'i dug gsum du grags pa de yin/ zhes gsungs pa ni mkhas pa chen po'i gsung du snang / 'phags yul nā lan+ta'i mkhas pa chen po rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug las/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang re'i skye bo su 'dra zhig yin rung sems kyi nang du gang 'dod pa thams cad bde ba rkyang rkyang yin zhing / sdug bsngal ni khab kyi rtse mo tsam gyi zug ngu yang lus sems la rtsa ba nas mi 'dod pa gcig mtshungs yin mod/ blun zhing rmongs pa'i blo des bya ba gang byed pa thams cad blang dor gyi gnad lugs 'gal 'dzol du song nas bya ba gang bgyis pa thams cad mi dge ba sha stag yin pas na/ sems nang 'bras bu bde ba 'dod kyang rgyu mi dge ba sngon du bsags zin pa phyin chad la phyis su 'bras bu sdug bsngal ba smin pa ni rgyu 'bras kyi chos nyid rang yin gshis/dper na/ zhing pa zhig gis dpyid ka zhing gi nang du 'bras 'bru'i sa bon btab pa las chu lud drod gsher gyi rkyen nam grogs byas nas myu gu rgyas shing ston kha'i dus su 'bras bu yang rgyu yi rjes su 'gro zhing 'bras dang 'bru thon skyed byed pa las gzhan ku shu dang kham bu sogs shing 'bras kyi rigs zhing pa des skye byung na bsams pa'i re 'dod chen po snyam yang nam yang skye ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na man ngag yon tan rgyud las/ gti 160

mug dbang gis skyon yon rgyu ma shes/ /zhes blo rmongs pa'i gti mug gi dbang gis nyes pa thams cad kyi skyon dang / yon tan thams cad kyi rgyu gang yin pa ma shes pa yin/ de lta bu'i gti mug las tshe 'dir bad kun gyi nad sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'i snyi zhing bsil ba'i bad kun gyi chos dang mthun pa'i nad yod do cog skyed par byed cing / lus dang sems pa gnyis sdug la sbyar zhing mthar gti mug gi sgo nas las ngan gang bsags pa de'i 'bras bur phyi ma glo shin tu rmongs pa'i dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba len pa 'gyur ba yin/ nge yang sgrol bstod las/ dran shes lcags kyu rnon pos ma btul zhing / /'dod yon myos chu 'thungs pas 'thoms pa'i mthus/ /log pa'i lam zhugs gnod 'tsho'i mche ba gcigs/ /gti mug glang po'i 'jig pa bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs par yang / skyems 'grel las/ gti mug ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mngon par mi rtogs shing ma shes pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa kho na lags/ /lnga pa/ nye rgyu rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyi skor/bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u las/ nye rgyu rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun gsum/ /rnam par ma gyur nad kyi rgyur 'gyur la/ /rnam gyur ma snyoms nad kyi ngo bo yin/ /lus dang srog la gnod cing gdungs bas 161

mug dbang gis skyon yon rgyu ma shes/ /zhes blo rmongs pa'i gti mug gi dbang gis nyes pa thams cad kyi skyon dang / yon tan thams cad kyi rgyu gang yin pa ma shes pa yin/ de lta bu'i gti mug las tshe 'dir bad kun gyi nad sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'i snyi zhing bsil ba'i bad kun gyi chos dang mthun pa'i nad yod do cog skyed par byed cing / lus dang sems pa gnyis sdug la sbyar zhing mthar gti mug gi sgo nas las ngan gang bsags pa de'i 'bras bur phyi ma glo shin tu rmongs pa'i dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba len pa 'gyur ba yin/ nge yang sgrol bstod las/ dran shes lcags kyu rnon pos ma btul zhing / /'dod yon myos chu 'thungs pas 'thoms pa'i mthus/ /log pa'i lam zhugs gnod 'tsho'i mche ba gcigs/ /gti mug glang po'i 'jig pa bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs par yang / skyems 'grel las/ gti mug ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mngon par mi rtogs shing ma shes pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa kho na lags/ /lnga pa/ nye rgyu rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyi skor/bshad rgyud nad kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u las/ nye rgyu rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun gsum/ /rnam par ma gyur nad kyi rgyur 'gyur la/ /rnam gyur ma snyoms nad kyi ngo bo yin/ /lus dang srog la gnod cing gdungs bas 161

so/ /zhes pa ste/ lus la rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi tshul du gnas pa'i rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po rang rang so so'i gnas zhes nad 'jug tshul gyi gang du brten pa'i zhugs gnas la go zhing / de yang / bshad rgyud le'u bcu par/ zhu ba'i gnas dang dpyi mig rus tshigs dang / /reg bya rna ba rlung gi gnas yin te/ /khyad par zhu gnas long na gnas pa yin/ /zhes rlung gi gnas bstan pa dang / mkhris nad lte ba pho ba khrag dang rngul//dngas ma chu ser mig dang pags pa ste/ /khyad par zhu dang ma zhu'i bar na gnas/ /zhes nyes pa mkhris pa'i gnas dang / bad kun brang nga/nga mgul pa glo ba mgo /dngas ma sha tshil rkang khu bshang gci dang / /sna lce khyad par ma zhu'i gnas la gnas/ /zhes nyes pa bad kun gyi gnas bcas rang rang so so'i rten pa'i gnas bshad pa dang / de bzhin nyes pa rang rang so so'i ldang tshad kyi rang bzhin cha snyoms zhing tha mal du gnas pa'i skabs su nad mngon gyur ba rnams kyi rgyu'i gtso bor gyur ba yin/ de yang / lus kyi gnas lugs skabs su bstan pa ltar/ /dang po rlung gi ldang tshad lgang phug gang / /mkhris pa'i ldang tshad rang gi gsang sgro gang / /bad kun ldang tshad rang gi snyim pa gsum/ /zhes pa ste/ skye bo pho mo'i lus la gnas pa'i nyes pa'am 'du ba rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyi ldang tshad kyi rang bzhin ni/dang po rlung gi ldang tshad ni byis pa dar ma rgan po rang rang so so'i dri chu'i snod sgang bug chu yi rdza ma gang ba 'dra ba de gang yod dgos pa dang /162
