4/ me mnyam rlung gi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ me dang mnyam pa'i rlung ni pho bar gnas/ /nang khrol kun tu rgyu zhing kha zas 'ju/ /dngas snyigs 'byed cing gnod bya smin par byed/ /ces pa ste/ me mnyam rlung zhe sa bya ba 'di ni mi'i lus kyi gnas spyi dang khyad par ma zhu ba'i gnas pho bar gnas shing lus kyi yul rgyu ma long sogs nang khrol kun tu rgyu bar byed cing / byed las ni zas skom rnams 'ju bar byed pa yin/ de yang kha zas 'ju bar byed pa'i las gtso bo ni/ me drod ces bya 'ju ba'i gzhi yin te/ /'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pa de la bshad/ /ces 'ju byed mkhris pa nyid yin kyang / mkhris pa de 'bar zhing drod rgyas par byed pa'i bud byed kyi me mnyam rlung nyid med na/ zas 'ju bar byed mi thub par song rlung des kyang kha zas rab tu 'ju bar) byed pa dang / khyad par zas skom rnams dngas snyigs legs par 'byed de gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang dri ma rnam pa gsum yang dag par tshul bzhin smin par byed pa yin/ /5) thur sel rlung gi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ thur du sel ba'i rlung ni gzhang la gnas/ /long dang lgang pa gsang ba brla nang rgyu/ /khu khrag bsha nga gci mngal nang 'byin sdom byed/ /ces pa ste/ thur sel rlung304

4/ me mnyam rlung gi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ me dang mnyam pa'i rlung ni pho bar gnas/ /nang khrol kun tu rgyu zhing kha zas 'ju/ /dngas snyigs 'byed cing gnod bya smin par byed/ /ces pa ste/ me mnyam rlung zhe sa bya ba 'di ni mi'i lus kyi gnas spyi dang khyad par ma zhu ba'i gnas pho bar gnas shing lus kyi yul rgyu ma long sogs nang khrol kun tu rgyu bar byed cing / byed las ni zas skom rnams 'ju bar byed pa yin/ de yang kha zas 'ju bar byed pa'i las gtso bo ni/ me drod ces bya 'ju ba'i gzhi yin te/ /'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pa de la bshad/ /ces 'ju byed mkhris pa nyid yin kyang / mkhris pa de 'bar zhing drod rgyas par byed pa'i bud byed kyi me mnyam rlung nyid med na/ zas 'ju bar byed mi thub par song rlung des kyang kha zas rab tu 'ju bar) byed pa dang / khyad par zas skom rnams dngas snyigs legs par 'byed de gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang dri ma rnam pa gsum yang dag par tshul bzhin smin par byed pa yin/ /5) thur sel rlung gi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ thur du sel ba'i rlung ni gzhang la gnas/ /long dang lgang pa gsang ba brla nang rgyu/ /khu khrag bsha nga gci mngal nang 'byin sdom byed/ /ces pa ste/ thur sel rlung304

ni skyes bu'i lus kyi smad gzhang la gnas shing / yul long ga rnam gsum dang / lgang pa/ gsang gnas/ brla nang bcas su rgyu bar byed cing byed las ni skyes pa pho'i sa bon khu ba dkar po dang bud med kyi sa bon khrag dmar po gnyis/ de bzhin bshang ba dang gcin pa ma yi mngal na gnas pa'i bu sogs phyir shugs kyis 'byin par byed pa dang / yang nang du sdom par byed pa bcas kyi las byed pa yin/ /bdun pa/ gnod byed nyes pa mkhris pa spyi'i las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mkhris las bkres skom zas len 'ju ba dang / /lus drod mdangs gsal snying dpa' blo ldan byed/ /ces pa ste/ mkhris pa zhes bya ba des las gang zhig byed snyam na ni/ phyi rol rang byung khor yug nang du mi'i lus po 'di nyid gnas thub par byed pa'i bya ba gal che zhig byed pa yin te/ mkhris pa de'i me drod kyi khya da chos sam yon tan gyis nang skyes bu'i lus la dgos gal che ba'i zas skom gang zos shing 'thung ba rnams dus su bzhus te/ slar yang bkres shing skom par byed pa na kha zas kyi dang ga len zhing yid la zas skom 'dod par byed pa dang / gang dag zos shing btung ba dag kyang myur du bzhus shing lus la 'ju bar byed pa dang / des lus po 'di nyid 305

la drod skyed par byed cing / pags pa'i mdangs kyang gsal bar byed pa dang / las la brtson nus pa'i snying dpa' zhing glo zhum pa med pa dang / de ltar bya ba gang brtsam par gyur kyang rig pa gsal zhing blo gros dang ldan par byed pa yin/ / brgyad pa/ bye brag mkhris pa lnga'i gnas dang byed las/1) mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ 'ju byed zhu dang ma zhu'i bar na gnas/ /zas 'ju dngas snyigs 'byed cing lus drod dang / /lhag ma bzhi yi grogs dang stobs skyed byed/ / ces pa ste/ me drod kyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i mkhris pa 'ju byed ces bya ba 'di ni kha zas zhu ba'i gnas long dang / ma zhu ba'i gnas pho ba gnyis kyi bar du gnas zhing / byed las ni kha zas rnams de'i drod kyi nus pas bzhus te 'ju bar byed pa dang / me mnyam rlung gi mkhris pa 'ju byed la grogs byas par brten de gnyis bsdongs pa'i cha nas skabs 'dir dngas snyigs kyang cung zad cig phye ba dang / khyad par mi'i lus kyi drod tshad skyed par byed pa ma zad/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mkhris pa mdangs sgyur sogs lhag pa bzhi po dag gi byed las la'ang phan pa'i grogs byas te lus kyi stobs 306

skyed par byed do/ /2) mkhris pa mdangs sgyur gyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa 'i le'u las/ mkhris pa mdangs sgyur mchin par gnas pa ste/ /dngas ma la sogs kha dog ma lus sgyur/ /zhes pa ste/ mkhris pa mdangs sgyur zhes bya ba 'di ni mi'i lus kyi grub cha'i gnas gtso che ba mchin par gnas shing / mchin pa rang gi ge gnas su yod pa'i me drod rnam pa gsum gyis pho ba rgyu ma sogs 'ju byed ma lag dang bcas pa'i sa nas kha zas kyi snying bcud dam dngas ma rnams grangs kyis mi langs pa'i rtsa lam brgyud nas gnas mchin par slebs pa dag dngas snyigs su legs par phye ba dang / lhan cig tu mdangs sgyur — mkhris pas zungs khrag smin par byas te/ khrag gi mdog dmar la dngas ba nyid du bsgyur bar byed pa ma zad/ mi'i sha dang tshil dang rus dang rkang dang pho mo'i khu ba dkar dmar gyi mdog dang / mkhris khu ser po sogs mdor na mi'i lus po'i skra dang smin ma sogs kyi kha dog gang yin pa thams cad gnod bya rang rang so so'i gnas su mdangs sgyur mkhris pas bsgyur ba byed pa yin/ /307

zha/ mkhris pa sgrub byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi ma tshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mkhris pa sgrub byed snying la gnas pa ste/ /yid gzhungs nga rgyal blo dang 'dod pa sgrub//ces pa ste/ mkhris pa lnga'i nang tshan sgrub byed ces bya ba 'di ni gtso bo mi'i lus kyi snying la gnas shing / skye bo so so'i bya ba'i don yid la gang bsams pa thams cad mi brjed par yid la sems pa'am blo la 'jog ste yid gzhungs pa dang / rang gces par 'dzin pa'i glo rab tu rgyas ste nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal skyed par byed pa dang / glo gros kyi rtsal rab tu che zhing / lhag par du rang nyid kyi yid la gang bsams pa'i 'dod pa sgrub thub par byed pa'i byed las sam khyad chos ldan yod/ /4) mkhris ge mthong byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mthong byed mig la gnas nas gzugs mthong byed/ /ces pa ste/ skabs 'dir mkhrig pa mthong byed ces bya ba 'ji ni mi'i dbang po'i nang nas gal cher brtsi ba'i mig la gnas shing / de yang mig gi rmam par shes pa'i rten zar ma'i 'bras bu 'dra ba'i mig gi dbang po'i yul la gnas te/ mig shes kyi dbang po dang lhan cig tu de'i byed las kyis phyi rol gyi yul phra rags ci rigs pa ma 'dres shing bye brag so sor snang zhing ngos bzung nas ma 308

zha/ mkhris pa sgrub byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi ma tshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mkhris pa sgrub byed snying la gnas pa ste/ /yid gzhungs nga rgyal blo dang 'dod pa sgrub//ces pa ste/ mkhris pa lnga'i nang tshan sgrub byed ces bya ba 'di ni gtso bo mi'i lus kyi snying la gnas shing / skye bo so so'i bya ba'i don yid la gang bsams pa thams cad mi brjed par yid la sems pa'am blo la 'jog ste yid gzhungs pa dang / rang gces par 'dzin pa'i glo rab tu rgyas ste nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal skyed par byed pa dang / glo gros kyi rtsal rab tu che zhing / lhag par du rang nyid kyi yid la gang bsams pa'i 'dod pa sgrub thub par byed pa'i byed las sam khyad chos ldan yod/ /4) mkhris ge mthong byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mthong byed mig la gnas nas gzugs mthong byed/ /ces pa ste/ skabs 'dir mkhrig pa mthong byed ces bya ba 'ji ni mi'i dbang po'i nang nas gal cher brtsi ba'i mig la gnas shing / de yang mig gi rmam par shes pa'i rten zar ma'i 'bras bu 'dra ba'i mig gi dbang po'i yul la gnas te/ mig shes kyi dbang po dang lhan cig tu de'i byed las kyis phyi rol gyi yul phra rags ci rigs pa ma 'dres shing bye brag so sor snang zhing ngos bzung nas ma 308

nor bar gsal por mig gis gzugs gang yin pa dag mthong bar byed pa yin/ / 5) mkhris pa mdog gsal gyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mdog gsal lpags gnas lpags mdog gsal bar byed/ /ces pa ste/ mkhris pa rigs lnga yod pa'i nang tshan mdog gsal ni lus po'i phyi nang bar gsum gyi lpags pa'i rim pa khag la gnas shing / byed las ni phyi nang gi lpags pa'i cha shas yod do cog gi mdog gsal zhing lpags pa'i bkrag mdangs rgyas shing rab tu dngas bar byed pa yin/ skabs 'dir mkhris pa mdog gsal gyi byed las gtso bo ni/ lpags pa 'i phyi nang bar gsum gyi mdog gang yin pa dag rab tu dngas shing gsal ba'am mngon par byed pa kho na yin pa las/ lpags pa'i mdog dkar po dang ser po nag po sogs kyi ngo bo rang bsgyur ba'i don ma yin te/ mkhris pa mdangs sgyur mchin par gnas pa ste/ /dngas ma la sogs kha dog ma lus sgyur/ /zhes dngas ma la sogs pa'i mi'i lus kyi kha dog mi 'dra ba gang yod pa thams cad ma lus pa kun mkhris pa mdangs sgyur gyi byed las kho nas bsgyur ba yin/ des na mdangs sgyur gyis bsgyur zin pa'i lpags pa'i mdog gang yin pa de ni mkhris pa mdog gsal gyis dngas shing phyir gsal bar byed pa yin/ /309

dgu pa gnod byed nyes pa bad kun spyi'i las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun lus dang blo brtan gnyid log cing / /tshigs 'brel bzod cing lus 'jam snum par byed/ /ces pa ste/ nyes pa bad kun des las gang zhig byed dam snyam na ni/ 'di lta ste skyes bu'i 'u sa po 'di nyid dang mi mngon pa'i sems gnyis kyi 'brel ba phan tshun dam por bzung zhing / lus sems gnyis ka rab tu brtan par byed pa dang / lhag don lus sems gnyis dka' thub kyi gnas las grol zhing / ngal gso ba'i ched dus dus su gnyid du log par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus po'i rkang lag gi lhu tshigs rnams phan tshun 'jam por 'brel sbyor thub par byed pa dang /phyi'i rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe dang / nang skyes bu'i lus kyi na tsha/sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs mtha' dag la gdong len dang bzod sran byed thub pa yin la/ khyad par lus kyi phyi sha pags dang / bar rtsa rus/nang don snod sogs lus kun ma lus par 'jam nga/ dang snum par byed pa'i las byed bzhin yod pas/ mdor na nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gang dag la la 'phel ba dang / zad pa/ rab tu 'khrugs pa sogs med pa'i sgo nas phan tshun ya ma bral bar cha snyoms pa'i rang bzhin zhig dgos pa yin/ /310

dgu pa gnod byed nyes pa bad kun spyi'i las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun lus dang blo brtan gnyid log cing / /tshigs 'brel bzod cing lus 'jam snum par byed/ /ces pa ste/ nyes pa bad kun des las gang zhig byed dam snyam na ni/ 'di lta ste skyes bu'i 'u sa po 'di nyid dang mi mngon pa'i sems gnyis kyi 'brel ba phan tshun dam por bzung zhing / lus sems gnyis ka rab tu brtan par byed pa dang / lhag don lus sems gnyis dka' thub kyi gnas las grol zhing / ngal gso ba'i ched dus dus su gnyid du log par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus po'i rkang lag gi lhu tshigs rnams phan tshun 'jam por 'brel sbyor thub par byed pa dang /phyi'i rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe dang / nang skyes bu'i lus kyi na tsha/sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs mtha' dag la gdong len dang bzod sran byed thub pa yin la/ khyad par lus kyi phyi sha pags dang / bar rtsa rus/nang don snod sogs lus kun ma lus par 'jam nga/ dang snum par byed pa'i las byed bzhin yod pas/ mdor na nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gang dag la la 'phel ba dang / zad pa/ rab tu 'khrugs pa sogs med pa'i sgo nas phan tshun ya ma bral bar cha snyoms pa'i rang bzhin zhig dgos pa yin/ /310

bcu pa/ bye brag bad kun lnga'i gnas dang byed las/1) bad dzin rten byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun rten byed brang la gnas pa ste/ /lhag ma bzhi yis rten dang chu las byed/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun rten byed ni byed las dang rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas gnas gtso bo brang la gnas shing / las ni lhag ma bzhi zhes bad kun myag byed dang / myong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed bcas kyi rten byed pa yin/de yang dper na/ me drod rnam pa gsum gyis pho ba'i nang myag zhu dngas snyigs kyi las byed pa'i skabs su bad kun myag byed kyi zas skom rnams zhib cing myags nas 'brul ba'i tshe bad kun rten byed ces bya ba 'dis kyang / pho ba'i nang gi bad yin myag byed kyi rten byas te pho sul gyi ldebs la 'jam pa dang / snum pa dang / mnyen par byed pa sogs kyi rten du gyur bas na pho ba'i nang du yod pa'i kha zas kyi ngo bo rtsub pa dang / tsha ba dang / rno ba sogs kyis kyang skam pa dang / rtsub pa dang / rma chags par byed pa bcas mi 'byung ba'i grogs sam bad kun thams cad kyi rten byed pa dang / bad yin thams cad kyis rlan zhing gsher ba'i chu khams bsil gyi las byed pa yin/ /311

bcu pa/ bye brag bad kun lnga'i gnas dang byed las/1) bad dzin rten byed kyi gnas dang byed las/bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun rten byed brang la gnas pa ste/ /lhag ma bzhi yis rten dang chu las byed/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun rten byed ni byed las dang rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas gnas gtso bo brang la gnas shing / las ni lhag ma bzhi zhes bad kun myag byed dang / myong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed bcas kyi rten byed pa yin/de yang dper na/ me drod rnam pa gsum gyis pho ba'i nang myag zhu dngas snyigs kyi las byed pa'i skabs su bad kun myag byed kyi zas skom rnams zhib cing myags nas 'brul ba'i tshe bad kun rten byed ces bya ba 'dis kyang / pho ba'i nang gi bad yin myag byed kyi rten byas te pho sul gyi ldebs la 'jam pa dang / snum pa dang / mnyen par byed pa sogs kyi rten du gyur bas na pho ba'i nang du yod pa'i kha zas kyi ngo bo rtsub pa dang / tsha ba dang / rno ba sogs kyis kyang skam pa dang / rtsub pa dang / rma chags par byed pa bcas mi 'byung ba'i grogs sam bad kun thams cad kyi rten byed pa dang / bad yin thams cad kyis rlan zhing gsher ba'i chu khams bsil gyi las byed pa yin/ /311

na/ bad kun myag byed kyi gnas dang byed las/de nyid las/ bad kun myag byed ma zhu ba la gnas/ /zas skom phyag cing 'drul bar byed pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun myag byed ni ma zhu ba'i gnas pho ba'i stod kyi cha la gtso bor gnas sheng / byed las ni mi'i lus po 'di nyid 'tsho bar byed pa'i rdzas rgyun ci rigs kyi ngo bo gang yin pa dag pho ba'i gnas su zhib mor bshig ste myags pas na mthar ldur ldur chags nas 'drul bar byed pa yin/ de ltar kha zas bshig cing rab tu myag par byed pa'i sa chu'i rlan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i byed las sam yon tan zhig ldan yod pa des skyes bu'i lus kyi zas skom gang dag 'ju bar byed pa'i gzhi rten du gyur/ bad kun myag byed ces bya ba 'di la me drod rnam pa gsum zhes brjod de me drod kyi khongajig su/ gtogs dgos pa yang gtso bo che shos zas skom myag cing 'brul ba byed pa kho na yin pas so / / / bad kun myong byed kyi gnas dang byed las/de nyid las/ bad kun myong byed lcer gnas ro tshor byed/ /ces pa ste/ bad gam myong byed de dbang po lnga'i ya rgyal du gyur ba'i lce yi dbang po 'a/ gnas shing / byed las ni rags pa'i 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhis grub pa'i ro rnam pa drug po dag so sor tshor zhing nyams su myong 312

bar byed pa yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam bar shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa/ lce rnam par shes pa/lus kyi rnam par shes pa bcas mi'i dbang po lnga'i rnam par shes pa 'di dag ni rags pa'i rnam shes lnga yin cing / de lta bu'i rags pa'i rnam shes rnam sa kyi rang rang so so'i yul 'dod yon lnga zhes mig gis gzugs/ rna ba'i sgra/ sna yi dri/ lce'i yi ro/ lus kyi reg bya bcas yul rags pa so sor longs su spyod par bya ba kho na yin pas/ der brten lce'i rnam par shes pas nyams su myong bar byed pa 'i ro drug kyang 'byung ba rags/ pa bzhis grub pa'i yul de la myong bar byed pa yin/ / 4) bad kun tshim byed kyi gnas dang byed las/de nyid las/ tshim byed mgor gnas dbang po tshim par byed/ /ces pa ste/ bad kun tshim byed ni mi'i klad pa'i nang gi tshor shes dbang ca'am/ dbang po mgor gnas shing / byed las ni gtso bo gong du brjod zin pa'i dbarngo po lnga po dag gis yul so sor longs su spyod ma thag tu dper na/mig lam du gzung/sa mdzes/ mi mdzes/ rna bar sgra snyan mi snyan/ sna dbang du dri zhim mi zhim/ lces ro kha ma kha/ lus kyis reg bya'i tshor ba bde sdug sos/sa gang yin thams cad yid kyi dbang por brda sbyor zhing rab tu tshim par byed pa yin/ /313

5/ bad dzin 'byor byed kyi gnas dang byed las /de nyid 04sa/ bad kun 'byor byed tshigs mig kun la gnas/ /tshigs rnams 'byor zhing brkyang bskum byed pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ bad kun 'byor byed ni mi'i lus po'i yan 'a/ga gi tshigs chen rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ ma na rgyud yan lag 5/'i le'ur/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis dpyi dang dpung pa dang / /bus mo gru mo mkhrig ma long tshigs rnams/ /yar mar so ra bzhi lha bar bcas pa ni/ /tshigs kyi khongs su 'dus te gnyen pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi'i tshigs mig kun la gnas shing / byed las ni tshigs pa phan tshun bar la brlan zhing gsher ba'i rnam pas 'jam pa dang / snum pa dang / mnyen par byas te tshigs rnams yar mar brkyang bskum byed cing tshigs kyi rus pa rnams 'gul bskyo da byed bzhin pa'i skabs su rga/nod pa med cing phan tshun 'brel cing 'byor bar byed rnga/ yin/ de lhar gong du bstan pa'i ces pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyi spyi'i las/ dang khyad par nang gses bye brag bco lnga'i gnas sa dang byed las gtso che ba'i sgo nas bshad pa yin cing / nyes pa de dag lus kyi stod smad bar thams cad la khyab pa tsam ma zad/ phan tshun gcig la gcig ba rten cing gnas te bya ba byed pa las bye brag rang rang so so gcig bus gzhan la ma ltos par rang ngos nas/ grub pa'i bya ba rang skya 'pher ba zhig mi'i lus po'i nang gtan nas yong mi srid pa yin/ / 314

bcu gcig pa/ nyes pa rlung gi mtshan nyid/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ nyes pa'i mtshan nyid rlung mkhris bad kun gsum/ /rlung gi mtshan nyid rtsub cing yang ba dang / grang zhing phra la sra zhing g.yo ba yin/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum las dang po gnod byed nyes pa rlung zhes bya ba ni rnam par ma gyur pa'i skabs su rang gi rtags mtshan de kho na nyid la rlung gi mtshan nyid ces rtsub cing yang ba dang grang zhing phra la sra zhing g.yo ba bcas zur drug po dag ma tshang bar med par cha tshang bar gyur ba de la rlung zhes brjod chog pa yin/ de yang 'grel pa bai sngon las/ rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung gi mtshan nyid ni rang rang ngo bo 'jam pa dang / snyi ba ma yin pa'i rtsub cing yang ba dang / dro ba sbom pa dang / snyi ba dang brtan pa'i ngo bo dang bral bas rang gi rang bzhin grang zhing phra mor gnas/ la sra ba smre mkhregs shing g.yo ba'i ngo bor gnas pa yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ des na rlung rang gi mtshan nyid dam chos nyid kyi gshis lugs ni 'jam po'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par rtsub pa byed pa dang / snyi ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par yang bar byed pa dang / dro ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par grang bar byed pa dang / sngoca/ pa 'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par phra bar byed pa dang / snyi ba'i ngo bo dang 315

mnyam du mi mthun par sra bar byed pa dang / brtan pa'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par g.yo ba byed pa bcas zur drug po 'di dag dang ldan par gyur ba ni rlung rang gi rang bzhin nam thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig yin/ de'i phyir mi'i lus sems gnyis rnam par ma gyur pa'am tha mal nad med kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i skabs su rlung rang gi mtshan nyid kyi zur drug po de dag gi chos dang mthun pa'i byed las tshul bzhin du byed de/ gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang dri ma gsum sogs lus sems gnyis lhan cig tu ha cang 'jam drags pa ma yin par/ rtsub pa'i cha shas skyed par byed nus pa dang / de bzhin du lus dang shes pa gnyis po ha cang snyi drags pa ma yin par yang ba'i cha shas skyed par byed nus pa dang / de bzhin du lus dang shes pa gnyis po ha cang drod drags pa ma yin par rang gi ngo bo grang ba tsam gyi zung 'jug gi tshul du grogs byas te grang ba'i cha shas skyed par byed nus pa dang / lus dang shes pa gnyis po ha cang sbom pa dang snyi drags pa ma yin par phra ba dang sra ba'i cha shas skyed par byed nus pa dang / yang de bzhin du lus sems gnyis po ha cang gcig tu gnas shing brtan drags pa ma yin par g.yo ba'i cha shas skyed par byed nus pa yin/ gal te de las ldog ste rlung 'phel drags pa dang / rlung zad drags nga/ dang / rlung rab tu 'khrugs pa sogs byung na rang gi mtshan nyid dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan las dper na/ lus kyi 316

phyi sha pags da nga snyi sogs ngo bo rtsub par byed pa dang / nang sems kyi shes pa yang zhing 'byo bar byed pa dang / cham tshad dang rims tshad skabs su yang lus brtse zhing grang 'dar byed pa dang / dug nad sogs dngas ma'i rta la bzhon nas rlung nyid shin tu phra bas rtsa sbubs rnams su 'jug nus par byed pa dang / 'bras dang skran la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyang rlung gis bsgongs bur bsgril zhing gcig tu sra bar byed pa dang / 'ju byed kyi cha/khris pa dang nad gzhi'i mkhris pa dang tshad pa sogs kyang rlung gis bus shing lus zungs kyi rdzas rnams bzhus shing bsreg par byed pa sogs rnam gyur nad kyi skabs su'ang rlung rang gi rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo gang yin pa de'i chos dang mthun pa'i nad rtags phyir ston par byed pa yin/ mes po'i zhal lung du/ /dang po rtsub pa ni rang rgyud dug cing rtsub pas nad drags po bzod par dka' ba ste/ dper na/ mi mthun pa bsdebs pa lta bu dang na dus su rtags ji 3 ra 'byung ba ni lce rtsub/ pags pa dang / khrag rtsub/ gos 'jam po gyon yang rtse yer byung ba'o/ yang ba ni rang rgyud yang bar gnas pas gnyen po'i kha na yang ba ste nad rtags ni lus dang shes pa yang / byug bdug tsam gyis zhi nus pa'o/grang ba ni bsil ba tsam ste ngo bo la drod med par gnas so/ de'i nad rtags ni grang shum che/ zas spyod drod la sred pa 'byung ngo / sra ba ni mi 'brul zhing yigs dka' ba ste/ de'i rtags ni skrangs pa rnag tu 'gror 317

phyi sha pags da nga snyi sogs ngo bo rtsub par byed pa dang / nang sems kyi shes pa yang zhing 'byo bar byed pa dang / cham tshad dang rims tshad skabs su yang lus brtse zhing grang 'dar byed pa dang / dug nad sogs dngas ma'i rta la bzhon nas rlung nyid shin tu phra bas rtsa sbubs rnams su 'jug nus par byed pa dang / 'bras dang skran la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyang rlung gis bsgongs bur bsgril zhing gcig tu sra bar byed pa dang / 'ju byed kyi cha/khris pa dang nad gzhi'i mkhris pa dang tshad pa sogs kyang rlung gis bus shing lus zungs kyi rdzas rnams bzhus shing bsreg par byed pa sogs rnam gyur nad kyi skabs su'ang rlung rang gi rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo gang yin pa de'i chos dang mthun pa'i nad rtags phyir ston par byed pa yin/ mes po'i zhal lung du/ /dang po rtsub pa ni rang rgyud dug cing rtsub pas nad drags po bzod par dka' ba ste/ dper na/ mi mthun pa bsdebs pa lta bu dang na dus su rtags ji 3 ra 'byung ba ni lce rtsub/ pags pa dang / khrag rtsub/ gos 'jam po gyon yang rtse yer byung ba'o/ yang ba ni rang rgyud yang bar gnas pas gnyen po'i kha na yang ba ste nad rtags ni lus dang shes pa yang / byug bdug tsam gyis zhi nus pa'o/grang ba ni bsil ba tsam ste ngo bo la drod med par gnas so/ de'i nad rtags ni grang shum che/ zas spyod drod la sred pa 'byung ngo / sra ba ni mi 'brul zhing yigs dka' ba ste/ de'i rtags ni skrangs pa rnag tu 'gror 317

mi 'dod cing tsha ba smin dka'/ lto ba sra bas sbyong mi thebs pa'o/ phra ba ni rdzas su ma grub pas bu ga phra mo kun la 'jug pa lce/ skra dang ba sbru langs shing brtse/ so dang son mo yan chad ber gyis na ba'o/ g.yo ba ni gcig tu mi brtan zhing 'pho 'gyur che ba ste/ de'i nad rtags su sems 'phyo/ 'gro 'dod/ kha lab/ nad 'phel 'bri 'pho 'gyur che ste stong skyugs 'ong rtsa sdod pa dang g.yo ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang / skyems 'grel las/grang ba ni ngo bo drod med pa tsam yin la/ rtags grang shum byed kyang gnyen po dre bas 'joms nus pa la bstos nas grang bar btags par bshad do/phra ba ni 'bum nag tu rdzas su ma grub pas zhes dang zla zer du rtsa sbubs phra mo la 'jug pa dang zhes pas phra mor 'jug nus pas ngo bo phra ba'am/yang na sra ba dang phra ba gnyis ni byed pa la btags so/ yang ba ni bskyod pa dang bsgyur bar sla bas bya spu lta bu ste cung zad tsam gyis phan gnod byed pa'o/ mtshan zhid kyi zhung du/ sa zhing 'thas pa sa'i mtshan nyid /brlan zhing gsher ba chu'i mtshan nyid/ tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i mtshan nyidardzo yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid ces gsungs pa ltar rlung rang gi ngo bo ni phyi rol gyi rags pa'i rdzas su grub nas snyi ba lta bur mi mngon par rang bzhin yang zhing phyogs kun tu bskyod par byed nus pa zhig dang / phra ba yang rtsa phran chung ngu'i bu ga rnams su rlung nyid rgyu bar byed pa kho na tsam ma yin par mi'i lus sems gnyis kha ma bral bar 'tsho zhing gnas par 318

mi 'dod cing tsha ba smin dka'/ lto ba sra bas sbyong mi thebs pa'o/ phra ba ni rdzas su ma grub pas bu ga phra mo kun la 'jug pa lce/ skra dang ba sbru langs shing brtse/ so dang son mo yan chad ber gyis na ba'o/ g.yo ba ni gcig tu mi brtan zhing 'pho 'gyur che ba ste/ de'i nad rtags su sems 'phyo/ 'gro 'dod/ kha lab/ nad 'phel 'bri 'pho 'gyur che ste stong skyugs 'ong rtsa sdod pa dang g.yo ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang / skyems 'grel las/grang ba ni ngo bo drod med pa tsam yin la/ rtags grang shum byed kyang gnyen po dre bas 'joms nus pa la bstos nas grang bar btags par bshad do/phra ba ni 'bum nag tu rdzas su ma grub pas zhes dang zla zer du rtsa sbubs phra mo la 'jug pa dang zhes pas phra mor 'jug nus pas ngo bo phra ba'am/yang na sra ba dang phra ba gnyis ni byed pa la btags so/ yang ba ni bskyod pa dang bsgyur bar sla bas bya spu lta bu ste cung zad tsam gyis phan gnod byed pa'o/ mtshan zhid kyi zhung du/ sa zhing 'thas pa sa'i mtshan nyid /brlan zhing gsher ba chu'i mtshan nyid/ tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i mtshan nyidardzo yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid ces gsungs pa ltar rlung rang gi ngo bo ni phyi rol gyi rags pa'i rdzas su grub nas snyi ba lta bur mi mngon par rang bzhin yang zhing phyogs kun tu bskyod par byed nus pa zhig dang / phra ba yang rtsa phran chung ngu'i bu ga rnams su rlung nyid rgyu bar byed pa kho na tsam ma yin par mi'i lus sems gnyis kha ma bral bar 'tsho zhing gnas par 318

byed pa'i ring du sems 'dzin par byed pa dang / da lta'i mi'i sems kyi rnam shes rags pa de lus kyi rlung rags pa zhig la brten te gnas par byed pa ma zad/ nam zhig lus sems gnyis po so sor kha bral te srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i skabs su yang shin tu phra ba'i sems kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de yang ha cang shin tu phra ba'i las rlung zhig la brten te gnas dbo/sa pa yin pas rlung gi mtshan nyid phra ba nyid du nges pa yin/ de bzhin du mi'i lus po 'di tsam ma zad stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag gi mi langs ba dag kyang / thog mar dma' ba'i sa gzhi'i gnas 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram gcig tu bsgo ngas pas mi g.yo bar brtan par gnas pas 'jig rten gyi khams thog mar chags par byed pa yang rlung gi mtshan nyid sra ba nyid kyis grub cing / bar du de dag gnas par byed pa yang rlung sra ba de la brten dgos shing / mthar mi'i lus po dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rlung gi mtshan nyid g.yo ba'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid kyis byed pas kun tu g.yos te mthar 'jig par byed pa yin pas na rlung gi mtshan nyid g.yo ba nyid du nges pa bcas mdor na rlung gis thog mar sna 'dren cing / bar du 'khrugs par byed pa dang / mtha' ma 'jug sdud par byed pa bcas yin te/ rgyud las/ de la rlung ni nad kun 'khrugs pa'i rgyu/ /sna 'dre na 'jug sdud bsdus dang khyab par byed/ /rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang 319

byed pa'i ring du sems 'dzin par byed pa dang / da lta'i mi'i sems kyi rnam shes rags pa de lus kyi rlung rags pa zhig la brten te gnas par byed pa ma zad/ nam zhig lus sems gnyis po so sor kha bral te srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i skabs su yang shin tu phra ba'i sems kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de yang ha cang shin tu phra ba'i las rlung zhig la brten te gnas dbo/sa pa yin pas rlung gi mtshan nyid phra ba nyid du nges pa yin/ de bzhin du mi'i lus po 'di tsam ma zad stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag gi mi langs ba dag kyang / thog mar dma' ba'i sa gzhi'i gnas 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram gcig tu bsgo ngas pas mi g.yo bar brtan par gnas pas 'jig rten gyi khams thog mar chags par byed pa yang rlung gi mtshan nyid sra ba nyid kyis grub cing / bar du de dag gnas par byed pa yang rlung sra ba de la brten dgos shing / mthar mi'i lus po dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rlung gi mtshan nyid g.yo ba'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid kyis byed pas kun tu g.yos te mthar 'jig par byed pa yin pas na rlung gi mtshan nyid g.yo ba nyid du nges pa bcas mdor na rlung gis thog mar sna 'dren cing / bar du 'khrugs par byed pa dang / mtha' ma 'jug sdud par byed pa bcas yin te/ rgyud las/ de la rlung ni nad kun 'khrugs pa'i rgyu/ /sna 'dre na 'jug sdud bsdus dang khyab par byed/ /rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang 319

rtsub pa'i phyir/ /thog mar rlung gi bcos thabs bshad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don kho na nyid do/ /brtsus pa/ nyes pa mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ mkhris pa'i ma tshan nyid snum bcas rno zhing tsha/ /yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher ba yin/ zhes pa ste/ gnod byed nyes pa mkhris pa ni rang gi rtags mtshan de kho na nyid la mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid ces snum bcas rno zhing tsha la yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher ba bcas zur bdun po rnams ma tshang ba med par cha tshang bar gyur pa de la mkhris pa zhes brjod chog pa yin/ de yang be+e sngon las/ skya ba las cung zad ldog pas snum pa dang bcas pas rtul ba dang bsil ba'i rang bzhin las go ldog pas rno zhing tsha ba dang /snyi ba med pas yang ba'i ngo bor gnas shing dri ma med pa rnams dang skam pa'i las mi ldan pas dri mnam par byed pa dang / sa chu'i rang bzhin gyis zas sma na 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ thur du 'khru zhing gsher ba'i bya ba byed pa yin zhes gsungs/ des na mkhris pa rang gi mtshan nyid dam gshis lugs ni skya ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par cung zad snum par byed pa dang / rtul ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par rno bar 320

byed pa dang / bsil ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par tsha bar byed pa dang / snyi ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par yang bar byed pa dang / dri ma med pa dang skam pa'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi skemathun par dri mi zhim ngan pa mnam par byed pa dang / 'byung ba sa dang chu'i rang bzhin shas cher grub pa'i nus pa snyi ba'i zas sman sogs kyi ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun par mar thur du 'khru bar byed pa dang / skam pa'i ngo bo dang mnyam du mi mthun pur brlan zhing gsher bar byed pa bcas zur bdun po dag dang ldan par gyur pa ni mkhris pa rang gi rang bzhin dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig yin cing / de'i phyir rnam par ma gyur pa'i skabs su mi'i lus kyi mkhris/ pa zungs khrag la brten nas cung zad snum par byed pa dang / nang sem sa kyi rang bzhin yang blo rig bkru zhing rno bar byed pa dang / 'ju byed kyi mkhris pa sogs kyis zas 'ju ba — dang / lus/ tsha zhing drod 'byin par byed pa dang / lus yang zhing bde la rngul dri mnam par byed pa dang / lto ba ha cang gi sra drags pa ma yin par dus dus su khong 'khru zhing gsher ba byed pa bcas kyi tshul dang ldan pa'am tshad ran pa'i sgo nas mi'i lus 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa la phan (sprudogs par byed pa yin/ gal te de las ldog ste rnam gyur mkhris pa'i nad kyi ngo bor gyur tshe rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i rtags mtshan du nad kyi rtags su mkhris pas ngo gdong snum zhing 'tsher pa 321

dang / rang gi nus pa shin tu rno myur dang ldan pa na mkhris pa'i nad rgyas sla zhing phral glo bur srog 'phrog par byed pa dang / de bzhin du dngas ma sha khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs bdun dang / bshang ba la sogs si 'i dri ma bcas gnod bya bcu po tsha byas bsreg ste rul du bcug pa dang / mkhris nad lus kyi bar mchin mkhris sogs su na bar gyur kyang nus pa yang ba'i dbang gis lus po'i stod mgor song nas mi'i mabo na bar byed pa dang / yang de bzhin du mkhris pa'i drod tshad rab tu rgyas par gyur pa'i rkyen gyis gtsog gcin dang rngul sogs la dri mi zhim nga/ra rab tu mnam par byed pa dang / nus pa snyi ba'i zas dang sum sogs cung zad tsam gyis kya/nga lam seng spod khog bshal zhing mthur du 'khru ba dang / gsher pa byed pa sogs kyis/ mtshon rnam par gyur pa'i mkhris pa'i nad kyi skabs su'ang / mkhris pa'i rang zhin nam ngo bo'i chos nyed dang mthun pa'i nad kyi rtags ston par byed pa yin/ trī/skyems 'grel las/ snum pa ni khrag la brten pa'i snum pa dang bcas pa tsam ste nad rtags gdong snum par bshad/ yang ba ni rkyen gyis dbang du 'gro ba ste rtags log kha yang ngo / 'khru ba ni tsha gsher dri mnam pa gsum gyis 'brul zhing smin par byas pas thur du 'gro ba'i cha la 'khru zhes pa ste rtags 'khru ba'o/ gsher ba ni ngo bo sla ba'am rlan pa ste rtags khrag dang lud pa sla ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang / me zhal du/ snum pa ni snum 322

pa rang ma yin par cung zad sdum pa dang bcas pa ste/ de nad du gyur pa'i rtags su gdong snum pa dang ba sbru'i sgo snum par 'gyur ro/ yang ba ni gnyen po'i kha nas yang ba snye/ rtags su tsha ba rkyang pa las ma 'das pa rnams la chu bzhi bsten na phral du bzlog nus pa'o/ 'khru ba ni lto ba snyi bas thur du 'byung ba ste nad rtags su zas spyod mi mthun pa bag tsam re la'ang 'khru ba'o/ gsher ba ni skam po ma yin pa ste ngo bo brlan zhing gsher ba yod pa'o/ de'i rtags su 'khru bar sla/ lud pa sla/ gtar khrag sla ba'o/zhes gsungs pa dang mtshan nyid kyi gzhung las/ tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i mtshan nyid ces bzhed pas don du mkhris pa med na tsha ba 'byung mi srid ces gsungs pa kho na yin la/ des na mkhris pa khrag dang rngul la gnas pa rgyud las gsal por bstan pa ltar khrag nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu rdzas cung zad snum pa dang bcas pa zhig yod par brten mkhris pa gnas shing mkhris pa de las lus kyi drod tshad skyed par byed pa ni don dngos dang ma thun pa yin la/ yang mkhris pa'i skabs su 'khru ba yod na gsher pa yod pas khyab kyang gsher ba yod pa tsam gyis 'khru ba yod pas ma khyab pa yin/ skabs 'dir gsher ba ni ngo bo brlan zhing gsher ba zhes gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de brlan zhing gsher ba ni chu yi mtshan nyid yin pas chu dang me gnyis ni gcig tu gzhi mthun yod pa ma yin te/ de gnyis kyi tsha grang rang bzhin dang ngo bo'i mtshan nyid gtan nas zlog phyogs yin 323

pa rang ma yin par cung zad sdum pa dang bcas pa ste/ de nad du gyur pa'i rtags su gdong snum pa dang ba sbru'i sgo snum par 'gyur ro/ yang ba ni gnyen po'i kha nas yang ba snye/ rtags su tsha ba rkyang pa las ma 'das pa rnams la chu bzhi bsten na phral du bzlog nus pa'o/ 'khru ba ni lto ba snyi bas thur du 'byung ba ste nad rtags su zas spyod mi mthun pa bag tsam re la'ang 'khru ba'o/ gsher ba ni skam po ma yin pa ste ngo bo brlan zhing gsher ba yod pa'o/ de'i rtags su 'khru bar sla/ lud pa sla/ gtar khrag sla ba'o/zhes gsungs pa dang mtshan nyid kyi gzhung las/ tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i mtshan nyid ces bzhed pas don du mkhris pa med na tsha ba 'byung mi srid ces gsungs pa kho na yin la/ des na mkhris pa khrag dang rngul la gnas pa rgyud las gsal por bstan pa ltar khrag nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu rdzas cung zad snum pa dang bcas pa zhig yod par brten mkhris pa gnas shing mkhris pa de las lus kyi drod tshad skyed par byed pa ni don dngos dang ma thun pa yin la/ yang mkhris pa'i skabs su 'khru ba yod na gsher pa yod pas khyab kyang gsher ba yod pa tsam gyis 'khru ba yod pas ma khyab pa yin/ skabs 'dir gsher ba ni ngo bo brlan zhing gsher ba zhes gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de brlan zhing gsher ba ni chu yi mtshan nyid yin pas chu dang me gnyis ni gcig tu gzhi mthun yod pa ma yin te/ de gnyis kyi tsha grang rang bzhin dang ngo bo'i mtshan nyid gtan nas zlog phyogs yin 323

pa'i phyir mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid zur bdun las gsher ba zhes bya ba ni don dam par ngo bo gnyen par byed pa zhig la go dgos pas dper na/bzo pas gser dngul zangs lcags sogs mes bsregs par byas na rang gi ngo bo gang yin pa de sla ba'am gnyen par byed pa ni mthong chos su gyur pa yin pas der brten gnod byed nyes pa mkhris pa zhes bya ba de rnam par gyur pa'i tshe mi'i lus zungs dang dri ma bcas thams cad tsha bas bsreg pa te drod kyi rul du bcug nas ngo bo mnyen par byas te thur du 'a khru zhing sasher bas nya rul ba lta bu'i dre mi zhim pa ngan pa myo nam par byed pa yang byed las kyi sgo nas yin pa ma gtogs tsha la rno zhing snum pa'i mkhris pa rang gi ngo bor med par gsal por shes thub pa yin/ bcu gsum pa/ nyes pa bad yin gyi mtshan nyid/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun mtshan nyid snum zhing bsil ba dang / /snyi rtul 'jam brtan 'byar bag can du gnas/ /zhes pa ste/ rnam par ma gyur ba'i nyes pa bad dzin ni rang gi rtags mtshan de lo na nyid la bad dzin gyi mtshan nyid ces snum zhing bsil la snyi zhing rtul ba'i rnam pas 'jam brtan 'byar bag can du gnas par gyur ba bcas ma tshan nyid kyi zur bdun po gang dag ma tshang 324

ba med par cha tshang ga'i ngo bo gang yin pa de nyid la bad kun zhes brjod chog pa yin/ de yang bai sngon las/ skya ba dang tsha ba las ring du nyams pas snum zhing bsil ba dang / yang rno rtsub g.yo rnams kyi rang bzhin dang bral bas snyi rtul 'jam brtan gyi ngo bor gnas shing / rnam pa 'byar bas shin tu che bas be snabs can gyi tshul du gnas pa yin no/ zhes gsungs/des na bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid dam chos nyid kyi gshis lugs ni skya ba'i ngo bo dang mnyam/ du mi mthun par snum pa ra byed pa dang / tsha ba'i ngo bo dang mi mthun par bsil bar byed pa dang / yang ba'i ngo bo dang mi mthun par snyi bar byed pa dang / rno ba'i ngo bo dang mi mthun par rtul bar byed pa dang / rtsub pa'i ngo bo dang mi mthun nga/ra 'jam par byed pa dang / g.yo ba'i ngo bo dang mi mthun par brtan par byed pa dang / tshigs mig ṭo/gas kha bral ba lta bur ma yin zhing / lhu tshigs phan tshun dam por 'byor zhing rnam pa 'byar bag thin tu che ba'i be snabs kyi tshi can bcas zur bdun po dang ldan par gyur ba ni bad kun rang gi rang bzhin dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos thig yin cing / rgyu mtshan de'i phyi ra rnam par ma gyur ba'i lus tha mal skabs su lus kyi cha shas rnams snum par byed pa dang / bsil drod snyom/sa par byed pa dang / lus sems ha cang yang zhi nga 'phyo ba ma yin par snyi ba dang ldan par gyur la/ las sogs yu na ring zhing rtul ba can dang / lus po'i phyi nang bar gsum dang nang gi shes 325

pa dang mi'i rang bzhin sogs thams cad 'jam par byed pa ma zad ngo bo brtan par gnas thub pa byed la/ rnam pa 'byar bag tshi can gyis las rnams phan tshun 'brel cing 'byor ba byed pa bcas kyi gnas skabs su mi rnams nad med cing bde thang du gnas par byed pa yin/ gal te rnam gyur bad kun nad kyi ngor gyur ba'i tshe bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid kyi chos dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan gyi nad rtags phyir ston par byed nga ste/bad kun gyi nad ni snyi ba sa dang 'dra bas na gnyen po'i khar yang snyi ba yin pas rgyud las kyang / sa 'dra gnyen po'i kha na snyi ba'i phyir/ /lan res mi bsal yun du bsten par gces/ /zhes sman bcos kyang lan re gnyis tsam gyis ma 'grig par yun bsrings nas bcos dgos pa zhig yin/ gal te gnyen po drod kyis bcos ma thub na ma thar grang ba phul du phyin pa zhes rang gi nus pa bsil ba des mthar grang ba gting du mkhar bar byas te lus phyi nang thams cad 'khyags/ ḍā/ nga gang bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus kyi cha rnams snum/ par byed la nad kyi gteng ring lam seng nad rgyas par mi 'gyur bas/ na ha cang sgyu sa rtul zhing nad kyi ga zer zug cher mi mngon par 'jam par byed pa dang / lus dang sems gnyis ka ha cang snyi zhing rmongs bag can du gyur nas brtan nga/ra gyur ba sogs kyi rtags rnams 'byung par byed pa yin/ 'grel pa be+e sngon la sa /snum pa ni shin tu snum pa la so gas pa'i zur bdun dang ldan pa'i mtshan 326

nyid ni bad yin kho na'i khyad par yin/ zhes gsungs pa na mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid snum pa ni zla zer du snum bcas zhes/ cung zad snum pa'i don yin pas de gnyis kyi rang bzhin la shas che chung gi khyad par chen po yod par ma zad/ byed las kyi cha nas dper na mkhris pas thur du 'khru zhing gsher ba'i skabs ngo bo dri che zhing sla ba nyid du 'byung la/ bad gan gyis grang bas 'khru na 'khru ba'i ngo bo der ha cang gi snum mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur ba sogs mdor na gtar khrag dang lud pa 'khru skyugs sogs kun la snum mdangs yod med kyi khyad par chen po byung ba yin/ de bzhin du rlung gi mtshan nyid skabs su rtsub cing yang ba dang / zhes rlung gi mtshan ——nyid ni yang ba dang / mkhris pa'i skabs su yang zhing dri mnams la 'khru zhing gsher ba zhes/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid yang ba de gnyis kyi khyad par ni rlung gi mtshan nyid yang ba ni/ rang gi rang bzhin rdzas su ma grub pas snyi ba ma yin par rlung rang gi ngo bo yang ba yi na mod/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nying yang ba ni byed las kyi cha nas nad dang rtags gnyis bzlog kha sla ba yin te/ bad kun gyi nad ni gong du brjod zin pa bzhin sa dang 'dra bar lci ba yin/ der brten mkhris pa dang bad kun gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ gcig grang ba dang / gcig shos/ tsha ba yin pas de gnyis rtsa ba nas rang bzhin 'gal zla yin par song / mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid yang ba zhes bya ba ni/byed las kyi sgo nas gnyen po'i kha na yang ba kho na yin te/ rje zur ma/khar 327

zhabs kyis/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid skabs su yang ba ni gnyen po'i kha na yang zhing 'phral du bzlog rla 'o/ zhes gsungs pa de ltar yin/ yang de bzhin du rlung i skabs su grang zhing phra la sra zhing g.yo ba yin/ zhes rlung gi mtshan nyid grang ba dang / bad kun skabs su mtshan nyid snum zhing bsil ba dang / zhes bad kun gyi mtshan nyid bsil ba de nyid kyi khyad par ni/ rlung gi mtshan nyid grang ba zhes bya ba ni mkhas dbang skyems pa tshe dbang gis/ grang ba ni rang gi ngo bo drod med pa tsam yin la nad rtags grang shum byed kyang gzhin po dro bas 'joms nus pa la ltos nas grang bar btags par bshad/ ces dang / yang bsil ba ni grang ba phul du phyin pa ste gzhan yang grang bar bsgyur nus pa'o/ zhes gsudas 'dug pas/des na de gnyis po la khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi khyad par chen po zhig yod pa yin te/ bad kun gyi mtshan nyid bsil ba ni 'byung ba sa dang chu yi rang ba zhin las grub pa'i bad kun rang ge rtsa ba'i khyad par gyis gzhi gang yin pa de la ngos 'dzin dgos pas de'i phyir 'byung ba sa chu gnyis kyi ro yang mngar shas che bar gyur ba dang / bad kun rang gi mtshan nyid kyi chos dang mthun pa na ro mngar bas bad kun skyed par byed pa yang rgyu mtshan de rang la thug cing / bad kun gyi mtshan nyid bsil ba de'i nus pas mi'i lus po'i phyi nang gnyis ka rab tu 'khyags shing grang ba gting du mkhar bar byed pa 'i las shig byed thub kyang / rlung gi mtshan nyid grang ba dang 328

ldan pa yod pa tsam gyis de 3 ra gtan nas byed mi thub pas rang gi ngo bor drod med pa'i khyad chos tsam yin/ /de ltar rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po'i mtshan nyid thams cad cha snyoms pa'i rang bzhin du gnas nas 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum med di 'i skabs su mi'i lus po 'di nyid mi na ba bde bar gnas thub byed pa dang / gal te de dag gi mtshan nyid 'ga' shas 'phel drags pa dang /'ga' zhig zad drags pa/ yang 'ga' shas rab tu 'khrugs par gyur na ni 'gro ba mi'i ྅/sa nyid nyams shing nud nas 'jig par byed pa yin/de'i phyir rnam/ pa ra ma gyur ba'i skabs su mi'i lus la nad rigs mi 'dra ba rgyas par dbye na stong dang drug brgya bcu drug dang / 'bring du dbye na nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ mdor bsdu sa na bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcegade yang bsdus na rlung ma khris bad kun gsum gyi nad dang / de gsum po yang bsdus na nad tsha grang gnyis sku bsdus pa yin pas/ rnam/ par ma gyur ba'i skabs su mi'i lus nyid 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa dang / 'du ba 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur ba na mi'i lus nyid 'joms par byed pa yin te/ bshad rgyud las/ rnam par ma gyur nad kyi rgyur 'gyur la//rnam gyur ma snyoms nad kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ / 329

bcu bzhi pa/ 'gro ba'i lus kyi mtshan nyid las nad zungs dri ma gsu/ma 'phel/ zad 'khrugs gsum bstan pa/ ji skad du/ bshad rgyud nad kyi mtshan nyid bsnya na pa'i le'u las/ nyes pa'i mtshan nyid 'phel zad 'khrugs pa gsu ma/ /'phel zad nad zungs dre ma rnam gsum ste/ /de la rgyu dang mtshan ma rtags bstan pa'o/ /da nga po nyes pa 'phel dang zad pa'i rgyu/ /zas spyod mi 'dod slong dang mi 'phrod 'phrod/ /spang byin de dang de 'phel zad zhwa ra 'gyur/ /gnyis/ pa lus kyi me drod rang gnas 'dug /cha shas lus zungs kun la gnas pa ste/ /bri dang 'bar bas 'phel dang zad par 'gyur/ /dri ma thogs dang shin tu 'byung las shes/ /zhes pa ste/ nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum rnam par gyur nas lus la nad kyi sun 'byin par gyur pa'i mtshan nyid ni rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa gsum dang / dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs bdun/ bshang ba sogs pa'i dri ma gsum bcas rang rang so so'i ldang tshad kyi rang bzhin 'akyis brgal nas la la mang du 'phel drags pa dang / la la nyung du phyin nas zad drags pa/ yang 'ag spru zhig phan tshun 'khrugs par 'gyur ba bcas 'phel zad 'khrugs/ gsum gyi sgo nas shes/ par bya ba yin la/ de yang nad zungs dri ma gsu ma 'phel zad kyi rgyu re re dang / rgyu de las byung ba'i mtshan rtags bstan pa gnyis kyi dbang las gsal por 330

bstan pa ste/ de yang dang po nyes pa mkhris pa 'phel ba dang zad pa'i rgyu ni/ dper na/ ro skyur ba dang nus pa tsha la rno ba'i zas skom dang / spyod lam tshad gung nyin gnyid dang drag shul rigs kyi mkhris pa'i nad skyed par byed pa na mkhris pa'i nad la zas spyod de'i rigs mi 'dod cing mi 'phrod la/ da dung de rnams gzhan gyis 'byin drags na mkhris pa'i nad 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / yang na rang gis spang drags na mkhris pa'i nad zad par 'gyur ba yin/ de bzhin du yang dper na/ ro tsha ba dang nus pa dro la rtsub pa'i rigs dang / spyod lam rtsol bcag byed pa sogs kyis bad kun gyi nad sel bar byed pa na/ bad kun gyi nad la 'dod cing slong ba de 'phrod la/ gzhan gyis de 'byin drags na bad kun zad par 'gyur zhing / rang gis spang drags na bad kun 'phel ba byed pa yin/mdor na/ mi gang zhig nyes pa rlung mkhris bad dzin gsum 'phel ba dang zad pa la mngon du phyogs pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ zas dang spyod lam gnyis ka yid la mi 'dod pa de mi 'brod la/ de 'byin drags na nad 'phel ba da nga / de spang drags na nad zad par 'gyur zhing / zas dang spyod lam gnyis ka yid la 'dod cing gzhan la slong ba de 'phrod la/ de byin drags na zad par 'gyur la spang drags na nad 'phel bar byed pa'i don yin pas rlung la yang sbyar chog de bzhin du dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs bdun po rnams kyang 'phel ba dang zad par byed pa 'i rgyu'i 331

gtso bo ni/ ma zhu ba'i gnas pho ba na bad kund myag byed dang / zhu ba'i gnas long sogs nang khrol kun tu rgyu ba'i tre+e mnyam rlung dang / khyad par zhu dang ma zhu de gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa'i me drod mkhris pa 'ju byed bcas rang rang so so'i gnas na 'dug pa gtso bo dang / sgos su de'i cha shas lus zungs ma lus pa kun la gnas shing yod pa de'i stobs ha cang gi bri drags pa dang / ches cher 'bar drags pa na lus zungs rnams kyi nyes pa dag kyang 'phel ba dang zad par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na/ma zhu ba'i gnas su pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs nyams shing mar bri bar gyur na ni pho bar dngas ma ma zhu ba zhes bya ba'i nyes pa rab tu 'phel ba na/mchin pa'i gnas su khra dang sha la sogs rnams kyang rang rang gi me drod kyis ma rgyen pas na/ lus zungs phyi ma phyi ma rnams kyi nyes pa yang ches 4 cher 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ yang na de las ldog ste pho ba'i me drod sogs kyi stobs ha cang ches cher 'bar drags par gyur na ni/ kha zas/ kyi dngas ma rnams rang bzhin nyid du tshigs te skam par gyur bas na des lus zungs phyi ma khrag dang sha tshil sogs kun kyang 'phel bar byed ba'i rgyu med par brten rang bzhin du lus zungs phyi ma/ phyi ma rnams kyi nyes pa zad par 'gyur ba yin la/ de'i rtags kyang ston par 'gyur ba yin/de bzhin du yang dri ma bshang gci rngul gsum yang 'phel zad du 'gyur bar byed pa ni gtso bo nad dang lus zungs gnyis 'phel zad gre/nga rung 332

du gyur ba na nyes pa de gnyis kyis dbang las dri ma rnams la'ang rang bzhin gyis gnod pa 'gyur ba yin te/ de ltar phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i tshul/ /nyes pa 'khrugs pa sa lus zungs/ nyen byas te/ /gnyis gas dri ma ni gre/nod par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bshang ba la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams kyang dus dus su phyir mi 'byung bar thogs pas khong du gsog cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / yang na/ shim tu mang ba phyir byung nas bong nang du dri ma zad pa gyur nas bshang gcis lus po rten 'brul byed mi thub pa'i nyes pa 'phel zad byung ba bcas rang rang so so'i nad rtags rnams kyang phyir ston pa yin no/ /bco lnga pa/ nyes pa rlung 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum bstan pa/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ de rtags/ rlung 'phel spem nag drod la dga'/ /lu/sa 'dar lto ba sbo zhing bshang ba sri/ /smra mang maco/ 'khor stobs gnyid dbang po nyams/ /rlung zad rtsol chung smra nyung lus mi bde/ /dran pa mi gsal bad kun 'phel rtags 'byung / /'khrugs rtags rlung gi rtsa ni stong la rkyal/ /chu ni chu 'dra dngas la log rjes sla/ /'gro 'dod shus 'debs shes pa yang la 'phyo/ /mgo bo zi 'khor rna ba 'ur la 'khrog /lce skam dmar rtsub kha ro bska ba bro//333

gzer 'pho grang 'dar 'gul khyab zug dang snyom/ / rongs 'khums bye chag 'byin dang dkris snyam byed/ /'gul na zug che spu brtse phrum ser khyer//gnyid med g.yal 'dar rkyong 'dod tshigs pa za/ /dpyi rked rus tshigs dzem lus bdungs snyam byed/ /ltag pa brang dang mur 'gram zug cing gzer//rlung gsang rnams ni kha bye mnan na na/ /stong skyugs byed cing tho rengs lbu gsob lu/ /sbo 'khrog dgong dang tho rengs zhu rjes na/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang nyes pa rlung rnam par gyur nas 'phel ba'i rtags su rlung gi mtshan nyid rtsub pa dang phra bas dngas ma dang / zungs khrag la/ gnod pas lus kyi cha rnam sa skam zhing rlung gi mdog bzhin lus nag po dang / rlung rang gi ngo bor drod med pas gnyen po dro bas 'jom sa par byed pa na/ drod kyi bag tsam yod pa la dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang zhing g.yo las grang bas na lus rang bzhin gyis 'dar nas lto ba sbos shing / rlung sra ba'i mtshan nyid kyis bshang ba'am bcog pa sri ba ste skam po chags pa dang /gyen rgyu'i rlung 'phel bas smra ba shin tu mang ba dang / khyab byed kyi rlung las mgo bo 'khor ba dang / rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung rnams kyi bya ba log pa byas par brten nas mi'i lus kyi stobs nyams shing / mtshan du shes pa 5 nga bas gnyid mi khug pa dang / de bzhin du dbang po mig la sogs pa rnams kyang nyams sam rgyun ldan las ldog ste bya ba nyams zhan du gyur ba yin/ mdor na/ lus skam pa dang / mdog nag po/ drod la 334

dga' ba/ lus 'dar ba/ lto ba sbos pa/ bshang ba sri ba/ skad cha mang ba/ mgo 'khor ba/ stobs nyams pa/ gnyid chung ba/ rna bar 'ur sgra byung ba sogs dbang po'i byed las kyi nus pa'am mthu chung ba bcas kyi rtags 'di dag byung na rlung 'phel bar gyur ba gsal por shes thub pa yin/ yang na rlung 'phel ba las go ldog ste rlung bri zhing zad par gyur ba na de'i rtags su lus 'gul bskyod byed pa'i bya ba nyams nas rang bzhin gyis 'bad rtsol chung ba dang / smra ba'i spro ba zhan par gyur te skad cha shod mi 'dod pa dang / lus po'i rlung gi nus pa ha cang bri bas lus po spyi yongs su mi bde ba'i tshor snang dang / lhag par gyen rgyu'i rlung gi mthu zad pa gyur nas lus kyi 'bad rtsol dang dran pa nyams dmas su phyin/lus snyi zhing 'gul bskyod byed mi 'dod pa dang dran pa mi gsal bar bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags lta bur ston pa yin/ yang mi'i lus po'i rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur ba na de'i rtags su/ rlung gi 'phar rtsa ni grogs khrag shed bri bas mar mnan na mi bzod pa stong par gyur la/ cung grod na rlung yang g.yo'i nus pas rtsa'i steng du gang zhing kha la rkyal ba dang / rlung gi dri chu ni lu ma'i chu dang 'dra bar sngo zhing lbu ba mdzo mig ltar che la/ ngo bo mi brtan par dngas la log pa'i rjes su yang sla bar byung / me mnya ma rlung gi dri chu dngas snyigs legs par phye nas rang gi nus pa grang ba dang sra bas lus thams cad du khyab nas bad kun sgong zhing khrag mkhris kyi nus 335

dga' ba/ lus 'dar ba/ lto ba sbos pa/ bshang ba sri ba/ skad cha mang ba/ mgo 'khor ba/ stobs nyams pa/ gnyid chung ba/ rna bar 'ur sgra byung ba sogs dbang po'i byed las kyi nus pa'am mthu chung ba bcas kyi rtags 'di dag byung na rlung 'phel bar gyur ba gsal por shes thub pa yin/ yang na rlung 'phel ba las go ldog ste rlung bri zhing zad par gyur ba na de'i rtags su lus 'gul bskyod byed pa'i bya ba nyams nas rang bzhin gyis 'bad rtsol chung ba dang / smra ba'i spro ba zhan par gyur te skad cha shod mi 'dod pa dang / lus po'i rlung gi nus pa ha cang bri bas lus po spyi yongs su mi bde ba'i tshor snang dang / lhag par gyen rgyu'i rlung gi mthu zad pa gyur nas lus kyi 'bad rtsol dang dran pa nyams dmas su phyin/lus snyi zhing 'gul bskyod byed mi 'dod pa dang dran pa mi gsal bar bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags lta bur ston pa yin/ yang mi'i lus po'i rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur ba na de'i rtags su/ rlung gi 'phar rtsa ni grogs khrag shed bri bas mar mnan na mi bzod pa stong par gyur la/ cung grod na rlung yang g.yo'i nus pas rtsa'i steng du gang zhing kha la rkyal ba dang / rlung gi dri chu ni lu ma'i chu dang 'dra bar sngo zhing lbu ba mdzo mig ltar che la/ ngo bo mi brtan par dngas la log pa'i rjes su yang sla bar byung / me mnya ma rlung gi dri chu dngas snyigs legs par phye nas rang gi nus pa grang ba dang sra bas lus thams cad du khyab nas bad kun sgong zhing khrag mkhris kyi nus 335

pa bcom pa'i rtags dang / rlung yang g.yo ba'i cha nas gnas gcig rang du bsdad mi 'dod par phar tshur yang yang 'gro 'dod pa dang / thang chad pa ltar dbugs phyir phul bas shus 'debs pa yin la/ rlung gis shes pa mi brtan par yang bar byas te sems gang byung ma byung du 'phyo ba dang / rlung mgor zhugs pa'i stobs kyis mgo bzi 'thom 'thom gyi phyi yul 'khyoms shing 'gyel bub byed pa ma zad rna ba yang 'ur la 'khrog pa dang / nus pa rtsub pa dang grang ba'i cha nas lce skam zhing rtsub po chags pa dang mdog dmar shas byung / ci yang ma zos kyang kha la ro bska ba bro ba dang / lce rkan 'byar ba lta bu'i ljin ljin gyi tshor snang byung / rlung yang zhing g.yo ba'i rnam pas gzer gcig tu mi brtan par phar tshur 'pho zhing / lus grang la brtse ba dang 'dar sig byed pa yin/ lus po'i sha sna rnams 'gul zhing 'phrig 'phrig byed cing lus kun la khyab pa'i rnam pa'am/ yang na gnas gcig tu ko ler zug pa lta bu byung / des rkyen pas rang bzhin gyis lus snyom pa ste skabs der sgyid lug pa dang / lus kyi yan lag sogs shing ltar rengs ba dang / yang na brkyang bskum mi shes spro sa 'khums pa dang / sha dang lpags pa kha bye ba dang / rus pa chag pa snyam du sem sa shing / mig phyir 'byin par byed snyam pa dang / lus yongs su gzhan gyis dkris pa lta bur byed cing 'gro zhing 'gul ba'i tshe/ lhag par du na zug che la ba spu rnams brtse zhing phrum ser khyer zhes grang shum 336

byed pa yin/ ma/tshan mo gnyid g.yer zhing g.yal stong yang yang brgyab pa dang 'dar zhing rkang lag rnams phar tshur rkyong 'dod pa dang / don med du rlu nga lang zhing tsheg pa za sla ba dang / khyad par lus kyi smad phyogs su dpyi mgo dang / rked pa 'khor/ rus tshigs ma lus pa rdo dang dbyugs pa sogs kyis brdung bzhin snyam pa byed pa dang / lngu/sa kyi ltag pa dang /brang dang / mur 'gram rnams su zug cing gzer brgyab pa dang / rlung gsang zhes spyi gtsug dang / yon stong ste ske stong dang / tshigs pa drug bdun/ brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams solas rang gis nus pa yang g.yo phra bas rlung gsang rnams kha bye ba yin/ der brten gnas de dag mar mdzub mos mnan na reg par mi bzod par shin tu na ba yin/ rlung gi stobs ha cang 'khrugs pas stong skyugs byed cing tho rengs kyi dus su lbu ba gsob gsob lu ba dang / grod khog sbo sa shing khong du khrog khrog byung ba ma zad nad de rnams lha ga par du dgong mo dang tho rengs kyi dus su na zug ldang che bar mngon la/ kha zas zhu ba'i rjes zhes grod pa ltogs pa'i dus su pho ba na ba bcas kyi rtags 'di dag byung na rlung 'khrugs pa'i rtags nyid du shes par bya ba'i gnad gcig yin no/ /337

bcu drug pa/ mkhris pa 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum bstan pa/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ ma/khris pa 'phel bas bshang gci lpags mig ser/ /bkres sko ma lus tsha gnyid chung 'khru bar byed/ /mkhris zad drod mdog nyams pas grang dang nag /mkhris pa 'khrugs rtags rtsa rgyas phra grims mgyogs/ /chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che/ /mgo na sha tsha kha ro skyur la kha/ /lce steng bad kun lce la sna sgo skam/ /mig sprin dmar ser gzer ba gcig tu 'dril/ /nub gnyid chung la nyin par gnyid mi thub / /lud pa dmar ser tsha bro gom dad che/ /khrag mkhris/ 'khru skyugs rngul che dri ma mnam/ /kha dog dmar ser smin cing 'drul bar byed/ /nyin gung mtshan gung nyu ba'i dus na na/ /zhes nga pa ste/ de yang nyes pa mkhris pa rnam par gyur nas de 'phel ba'i rtags su/ snod kyi mkhris pa'i nang du yod pa'i mkhris khu yar lud pa dang des rkyen pas bshang ba dang / gcin pa dang / pag sa pa dang / mi sprin sogs kyi mdog ser po chags par byed pa yin/ mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi stobs 'phel bas yang yang bkres par gyur ba dang / kha yang yang lkom pa ra gyur ba dang / de bzhin du lus phyi nang kun tu tsha drod shin tu che bar gyur ba ma zad/ mkhris pa'i byed las yang ba yin pas lus stod kyis dbang po 338

bcu drug pa/ mkhris pa 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum bstan pa/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ ma/khris pa 'phel bas bshang gci lpags mig ser/ /bkres sko ma lus tsha gnyid chung 'khru bar byed/ /mkhris zad drod mdog nyams pas grang dang nag /mkhris pa 'khrugs rtags rtsa rgyas phra grims mgyogs/ /chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che/ /mgo na sha tsha kha ro skyur la kha/ /lce steng bad kun lce la sna sgo skam/ /mig sprin dmar ser gzer ba gcig tu 'dril/ /nub gnyid chung la nyin par gnyid mi thub / /lud pa dmar ser tsha bro gom dad che/ /khrag mkhris/ 'khru skyugs rngul che dri ma mnam/ /kha dog dmar ser smin cing 'drul bar byed/ /nyin gung mtshan gung nyu ba'i dus na na/ /zhes nga pa ste/ de yang nyes pa mkhris pa rnam par gyur nas de 'phel ba'i rtags su/ snod kyi mkhris pa'i nang du yod pa'i mkhris khu yar lud pa dang des rkyen pas bshang ba dang / gcin pa dang / pag sa pa dang / mi sprin sogs kyi mdog ser po chags par byed pa yin/ mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi stobs 'phel bas yang yang bkres par gyur ba dang / kha yang yang lkom pa ra gyur ba dang / de bzhin du lus phyi nang kun tu tsha drod shin tu che bar gyur ba ma zad/ mkhris pa'i byed las yang ba yin pas lus stod kyis dbang po 338

mgor mkhris pa'i tsha rlangs phyin pas mgo bo na ba dang mtshog ma'i rus pa na zhing snyi ba'i snang tshul dang / gnyid g.yer ba/ skra dkar mang du thon pa bcas byung / rang gi mtshan nyid 'khru zhing gsher bas thur du 'khru ba 'gyur ba bcas byung na mkhris pa 'phel ba'i rtags su shes par bya ba dang / gal te mkhris pa zad par gyur na ni de'i rtags su/ 'ju byed mkhris pa so/gas kyi me drod kyi byed las nyams pa na/ me'i rang bzhin gyi drod tshad zhan par song ba'i dbang gis lus kyi drod nyams pa ma zad /lpags par gnas pa'i mkhris pa mdog gsal gyi nus pa nyams par brten — thigs mdog kyang nyams shing lus kyi reg bya grang ba dang kha dog kyang nag por 'gyur ba yin// skabs 'dir mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags su 'phar rtsa'i khong stong par ma yin par khrag dang mkhris pas sha khar rgyas shing / rta'i rnga ma bsgril ba ltar phra la grims par 'phar ba dang / grangs kyang mgyogs par 'phar ba yin/ chu mdog dmar ser zhes mdog ser shas can la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa snang ba ma zad/ lbu ba khra sig sig mang po mngon zhing myur du sang skyen pa dang / mkhris/ pa'i mtshan nyid dri mnam pa dang — tsha ba des gcin gyi dri ma ha cang ngan cing dugs pa ma zad rlangs pa shin tu 'tshub pa dang che ba byung / mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid kyi byed las yang ba de mkhris tshad smad na gnas kyang stod du de'i drod tshad 'bar bar byed 339

mgor mkhris pa'i tsha rlangs phyin pas mgo bo na ba dang mtshog ma'i rus pa na zhing snyi ba'i snang tshul dang / gnyid g.yer ba/ skra dkar mang du thon pa bcas byung / rang gi mtshan nyid 'khru zhing gsher bas thur du 'khru ba 'gyur ba bcas byung na mkhris pa 'phel ba'i rtags su shes par bya ba dang / gal te mkhris pa zad par gyur na ni de'i rtags su/ 'ju byed mkhris pa so/gas kyi me drod kyi byed las nyams pa na/ me'i rang bzhin gyi drod tshad zhan par song ba'i dbang gis lus kyi drod nyams pa ma zad /lpags par gnas pa'i mkhris pa mdog gsal gyi nus pa nyams par brten — thigs mdog kyang nyams shing lus kyi reg bya grang ba dang kha dog kyang nag por 'gyur ba yin// skabs 'dir mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags su 'phar rtsa'i khong stong par ma yin par khrag dang mkhris pas sha khar rgyas shing / rta'i rnga ma bsgril ba ltar phra la grims par 'phar ba dang / grangs kyang mgyogs par 'phar ba yin/ chu mdog dmar ser zhes mdog ser shas can la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa snang ba ma zad/ lbu ba khra sig sig mang po mngon zhing myur du sang skyen pa dang / mkhris/ pa'i mtshan nyid dri mnam pa dang — tsha ba des gcin gyi dri ma ha cang ngan cing dugs pa ma zad rlangs pa shin tu 'tshub pa dang che ba byung / mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid kyi byed las yang ba de mkhris tshad smad na gnas kyang stod du de'i drod tshad 'bar bar byed 339

pas na mgo bo na zhing lus kyi sha drod tsha ba dang / kha la ro skyur po dang kha tig byung / lce'i steng du bad kun gyi rnam pa can zhig la legs par brtags na/ gzhung las/ lce steng bad kun skya ser mthug pos g.yogs//zhes skya ser mthug po can mang du chags pa dang / sna'i sgo skam pa dang / — mchin par khrag mkhris rgyas pas mig gi sprin pa dmar ser can byung la/gang na ba'i gnas su gzer gcig tu 'dril ba dang / mtshan mo zla ba bsil ba'i stobs kyi cha 'phel bas phyi'i rang byung khams kyi nus pa bsil ba dang / nang skyes bu'i kham/sa kyi khrag mkhris kyi nus pa gnyis gcig tu bsdongs pa las/ gnyid chung ba dang nam langs nas tsha ba gi ma'i stobs kyi cha 'phel bas phyi'i rang byung lams kyi nus pa tsha drod can du gyur ma thag nang skyes bu'i khrag mkhris gnyis kyi nus pa gcig tu bsdongs pa las mkhris tshad kyi stobs ha cang rgyas par gyur bas nyin par gnyid bkag mi thub nga/ra gyur ba ma zad/ mkhris tshad kyi dbang las skad cha gang byung du smra zhing 'tshal/ bar gyur ba yin/ khrag ca/khris/ 'dres pas lud pa dmar ser can lu ba dang / lud pa de'i bro ba ya nga lan tsha bro zhing / khong du chu khams rlan gsher gyi cha bri bas tshad pa rgyas nas kha lce skams nas skom ma btung na sran mi bzod pa lta bur kha skom dad shin tu che ba dang / khrag dang mkhris pa lta bu'i mdog dmar ser can bshal ba'amyo/ yang na khar skyugs pa dang / ma/bris pa khrag dang rngul la brten pa'i sgo nas lus dang 340

rkang pa'i rngul dri shin tu che bar mnam par byed pa dang / lus po'i sha mdog dang bzhin ras sogs kun mdog dmar ser nyid du chas/sa pa dang / 'u sa kyi cha shas kun khrag mkhris tsha ba'i drod kyis rnag sogs gnod bya bcu po sogs gang na ba'i gnas su yongs su smin cing mthar drod kyi dul du bcug ste 'brul bar byed pa yin/ lhag par du mkhris pa'i nad kyi mnar ba'i mi gang dag zhin gung dang mtshan gung gi dus su phyi rol rang byung khams kyi drod tshad dang / nang skyes bu'i khams nyid kyi drod tshad phyogs gceg tu bsdo ngas pa'i mthu las/ nad ldang che ba dang kha zas zos nas zhu ba'i dus su nad ba bcas byung na/ mkhris pa/ 'khrugs pa'i rtags su shes pa ra bya ba'i gnad cig yin/ /bcu bdun pa/ bad kun 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum bsta na pa/bshad rgyud nyeji/ pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u las/ bad kun 'phel bas drod nyam /sa zas mi 'ju/ /lus snyi mdog dkar khong snyom yan lag lhod/ /mchil ma lud mang gnyid che dbugs mi bde/ /bad kun zad pas rang gi gnas stong zhing / /mgo 'khor snying 'dar tshigs mtshams lhod par 'gyur/ /bad kun 'khrugs rtags rtsa ni bying rgud dal/ /chu ni mdog 341

dkar dri dang rlangs pa chung / /kha mngal lce snyel skya la mig dkar skrangs//snabs lud mang zhing che/go 'thom lus sems snyi/ /dang ga mi bde drod med 'ju sto bas chung / /mkhal rked na zhing lus sbom lba ba sgye/ /la zas bad kun skyug cing 'khru ba dang / /dran pa mi gas/la gnying che sgyid pa skyur//g.ya 'a mkhrang tshigs dam tha rgyas las mtha' ring / /nam zhod srod dang snga dro zos thog ldang / /zhes pa ste/ nyes pa bad kun zhes bya ba 'di rnam par gyur pa na de 'phel ba'i rtags su bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi snyi bsil 'phel bas mi'i lus kyi drod tshad nyams shing rang gi nus pa bsil ba dang / rtul bas zas gang zos shing 'thung ba rnams mi 'ju bar/ /nus pa lci brtan gyi cha nas lus snyi ba'am ljid khog ljid ngo chags par byed la /bad kun gyi rad ma/dos ltar 'u sa kyi sha mdog dkar po dang / bad kun gyi mtshan nyid (k+tan pa dang 'jam nga des nad kyi ngo bo zug chung zhing /'jam la lus dang shes pa snyi ba'i rnam pas khong snyom zhes bya ba gang la'ang spro ba chung bar sgyid 'u ga pa dang / bad kun 'byor byed kyi cha mang du 'phel drags nas lus dang nga/na lag yi sha tshil rnams 'phel ba'am rgyas par gyur nas tshigs mi mngon pa na tshigs mtshams/ lhod pa dang / me drod kyi cha shas zhan par gyur nas pho bar zas skom tshul bzhin du ma smin pa'i rkyen gyis mchil ma dang lud pa 'byar bag tshi can gyi rnam pa can mang du thon par byed la/ bad kun rang gi rma tshan nyid kyi chos dang mthun 342

dkar dri dang rlangs pa chung / /kha mngal lce snyel skya la mig dkar skrangs//snabs lud mang zhing che/go 'thom lus sems snyi/ /dang ga mi bde drod med 'ju sto bas chung / /mkhal rked na zhing lus sbom lba ba sgye/ /la zas bad kun skyug cing 'khru ba dang / /dran pa mi gas/la gnying che sgyid pa skyur//g.ya 'a mkhrang tshigs dam tha rgyas las mtha' ring / /nam zhod srod dang snga dro zos thog ldang / /zhes pa ste/ nyes pa bad kun zhes bya ba 'di rnam par gyur pa na de 'phel ba'i rtags su bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi snyi bsil 'phel bas mi'i lus kyi drod tshad nyams shing rang gi nus pa bsil ba dang / rtul bas zas gang zos shing 'thung ba rnams mi 'ju bar/ /nus pa lci brtan gyi cha nas lus snyi ba'am ljid khog ljid ngo chags par byed la /bad kun gyi rad ma/dos ltar 'u sa kyi sha mdog dkar po dang / bad kun gyi mtshan nyid (k+tan pa dang 'jam nga des nad kyi ngo bo zug chung zhing /'jam la lus dang shes pa snyi ba'i rnam pas khong snyom zhes bya ba gang la'ang spro ba chung bar sgyid 'u ga pa dang / bad kun 'byor byed kyi cha mang du 'phel drags nas lus dang nga/na lag yi sha tshil rnams 'phel ba'am rgyas par gyur nas tshigs mi mngon pa na tshigs mtshams/ lhod pa dang / me drod kyi cha shas zhan par gyur nas pho bar zas skom tshul bzhin du ma smin pa'i rkyen gyis mchil ma dang lud pa 'byar bag tshi can gyi rnam pa can mang du thon par byed la/ bad kun rang gi rma tshan nyid kyi chos dang mthun 342

par lus sems snyi zhing 'thibs pa'i dbang gis gnyid shin tu che ba dang / mi'i glo ba ni bad kun rang gi yul yin par brten gnas der bad dzin mang du 'phel bas brang dang mgul bar bad kun 'byar bag gi rnam pa mang du chags pas rang bzhin gyis dbugs gtong len mi bde ba bcas kyi nad rtags 'di dag byung na bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags su shes par bya ba dang / yang de las ldog ste bad kun zad pa'i rtags su skyems 'grel las/ bad kun zad pas rang gi gnas brang dang / mgul pa dang /glo ba dang / mgo bo sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong par snang / zhes dang / mi dbang sde srid kyi 'grel/ pa be+e sngon dang mkhas dbang khro ru tshe rnam gyi drang srong zhal lung du/ bad kun zad pas rang gi gnas dngas ma dang sha la sogs stongs/ zhes gsungs 'dug kyang / don dam du rgyud kyi spe'u bcu pa nad 'jug tshul skabs su/ bad kun brang dang mgu'/ pa glo ba mgo/ /dngas ma sha tshil tshigs rkang khu ba dang / /sna lce khyad par ma zhu'i bar na gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gnas 'di dag du bad dzin nyung du bri zhing zad par song / stongs par snang ba ma zad/ bad kun zad pa dang / gnas der rlung 'phel ba'i rkyen gyis klad pa'i cha la'ang gnod par byed pa na mgo bo 'khor ba dang / snying du bad kun snyi ba dang brtan pa'i cha shas nyung du phyin pas khyab byed rlung nyid 'phel bar gyur nas des shes pa yang zhing 'phyo la/ snying 'dar bar byed pa yin la 'byor byed zad 343

pas tshigs ma tshams bar stong zhing lhod par gyur ba bcas ni bad kun zad pa'i rtags su bshad pa yin/ gong du bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags su yan lag wod/ ces dang / 'dir bad kun zad pa'i rtags su tshigs mtshams lhod/ ces gsungs pa gnyis kyi thad la gnyis ka yan lag gi tshegs mtshams lhod pa'i don gcig mtshungs su go na mi 'grig ste/ gcig bad kun 'phel bas lus dang yan lag gi tha dang tshil rgyas par gyur nas tshegs mtshams 'bur 'bur lta bur phyir mi mngon par gcig tu ltod par gyur ba'i don dang / gcig bad kun zad pas 'byor byed tshigs mig kun la gnas pa'i nus pa nyams zhan du gyur nas tshigs mtshams rnams stong zhing / tshigs mig bar rlung 'phel bas tshigs mtshams lhod par gyur ba'i don du go dgos pa yin snyam/ skabs 'dir bad kun 'khrugs par gyur ba'i rtags su/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba ni/ rtsa gteng du bying zhing 'phar shugs kyang gud la grangs nyung bar 'phar ba yin/ bad kun gyi rang mdog bzhin dri chu'i mdog kyang dkar ba dang / bsil ba'i nus stobs che bas gcin pa'i dri ma dang rlangs pa chu nga la/ lbu ba kha nang gi mchil ma lta bur sib sib chung chung mang ngo 'dril zhing sang bul ba yin/ kha mngal ba ste lce la ro gang ya nga mi gsal zhing / khrag bri bas lce dang so rnyil/ gyi mdog skya la mig sprin yang dkar po chags pa dang / chu khams kyi stobs rgyas pas 'u sa spyi dang gdong gi byad bzhin skrangs nas sbos par ma zad/ snabs 344

pas tshigs ma tshams bar stong zhing lhod par gyur ba bcas ni bad kun zad pa'i rtags su bshad pa yin/ gong du bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags su yan lag wod/ ces dang / 'dir bad kun zad pa'i rtags su tshigs mtshams lhod/ ces gsungs pa gnyis kyi thad la gnyis ka yan lag gi tshegs mtshams lhod pa'i don gcig mtshungs su go na mi 'grig ste/ gcig bad kun 'phel bas lus dang yan lag gi tha dang tshil rgyas par gyur nas tshegs mtshams 'bur 'bur lta bur phyir mi mngon par gcig tu ltod par gyur ba'i don dang / gcig bad kun zad pas 'byor byed tshigs mig kun la gnas pa'i nus pa nyams zhan du gyur nas tshigs mtshams rnams stong zhing / tshigs mig bar rlung 'phel bas tshigs mtshams lhod par gyur ba'i don du go dgos pa yin snyam/ skabs 'dir bad kun 'khrugs par gyur ba'i rtags su/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba ni/ rtsa gteng du bying zhing 'phar shugs kyang gud la grangs nyung bar 'phar ba yin/ bad kun gyi rang mdog bzhin dri chu'i mdog kyang dkar ba dang / bsil ba'i nus stobs che bas gcin pa'i dri ma dang rlangs pa chu nga la/ lbu ba kha nang gi mchil ma lta bur sib sib chung chung mang ngo 'dril zhing sang bul ba yin/ kha mngal ba ste lce la ro gang ya nga mi gsal zhing / khrag bri bas lce dang so rnyil/ gyi mdog skya la mig sprin yang dkar po chags pa dang / chu khams kyi stobs rgyas pas 'u sa spyi dang gdong gi byad bzhin skrangs nas sbos par ma zad/ snabs 344

dang lu/da pa mang du 'phel ba/ mgo bo 'thom 'thom pa'i snang ba dang / snyi ba dang brtan pas lus sems gnyis ka snyi zhing bskyod dka' ba dang / me zod kyi stobs zhan par gyur bas kha zas kyi dang ga mi bde zhing / chu khams bsil ba'i cha rgyas par song / lus phyi nang kun tu drod tshad ha cang chung la gang zos shing btung ba rnams kyi 'ju stobs chung ba yin/ mkhal ma ni chu khams kyi gnas yin pas mkhal ma dang rked pa na zhing lus sbom par 'gyu ra ba yin/ 'grel pa gzhan dag tu/ lus spo ba dang / zhes sbos par bkral 'dug kyang / skyems pa tshe dbang gis lus sbom pa/ zhes gsungs 'dug pas don du lus dang gdong gi byad gong du skrangs pa bstan zin pas zlos/ skyon du 'gro bas 'u/sa sbom par 'gyur ba nyid yin pa 'thad par sem/sa/ de bzhin du lba ba skye ba dang zas skom gang zos kyang 'ju ba'i stobs zhan pas legs par smin ma thub pas zas kyi rang mdog bzhin yar skyugs pa 'am yang thur du 'khru ba dang / snying gi rtsa sbubs su bad kun gyi rgyu 'phel drags pas sems rmongs par gyur nas dran pa mi gsal ba dang / gnyid che ba dang / lus sems snyi bas bya ba'am las ka gang la'ang sgyid lug pas phyi bshol gyis ring du skyur ba dang / pags pa rnam sa g.ya' zhing / sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi nus pa sra ba dang mtshungs ldan yin pas yan lag dang / zhing lag ces rkang lag dang mdzub mo rnams nesra zhing mkhrang ba dang / bad kun rang gi nus pa 'byar bag shin tu che bas 345

dang lu/da pa mang du 'phel ba/ mgo bo 'thom 'thom pa'i snang ba dang / snyi ba dang brtan pas lus sems gnyis ka snyi zhing bskyod dka' ba dang / me zod kyi stobs zhan par gyur bas kha zas kyi dang ga mi bde zhing / chu khams bsil ba'i cha rgyas par song / lus phyi nang kun tu drod tshad ha cang chung la gang zos shing btung ba rnams kyi 'ju stobs chung ba yin/ mkhal ma ni chu khams kyi gnas yin pas mkhal ma dang rked pa na zhing lus sbom par 'gyu ra ba yin/ 'grel pa gzhan dag tu/ lus spo ba dang / zhes sbos par bkral 'dug kyang / skyems pa tshe dbang gis lus sbom pa/ zhes gsungs 'dug pas don du lus dang gdong gi byad gong du skrangs pa bstan zin pas zlos/ skyon du 'gro bas 'u/sa sbom par 'gyur ba nyid yin pa 'thad par sem/sa/ de bzhin du lba ba skye ba dang zas skom gang zos kyang 'ju ba'i stobs zhan pas legs par smin ma thub pas zas kyi rang mdog bzhin yar skyugs pa 'am yang thur du 'khru ba dang / snying gi rtsa sbubs su bad kun gyi rgyu 'phel drags pas sems rmongs par gyur nas dran pa mi gsal ba dang / gnyid che ba dang / lus sems snyi bas bya ba'am las ka gang la'ang sgyid lug pas phyi bshol gyis ring du skyur ba dang / pags pa rnam sa g.ya' zhing / sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi nus pa sra ba dang mtshungs ldan yin pas yan lag dang / zhing lag ces rkang lag dang mdzub mo rnams nesra zhing mkhrang ba dang / bad kun rang gi nus pa 'byar bag shin tu che bas 345

tshigs mtshams rnams daX zhing brkyang bsku ma byed dka' la/ lus kyi tha rgyas nas rang gi mtshan nyid snyi brtan rtul ba'i rang bzhin gyis bad kun gyi nad kyang dang po nad lkog gyur du gsog par byed pa dang / bar du nad mngon gyur ldang bar byed pa dang / mthar nad zhi bar byed pa sogs gang la'ang yu na ring du 'gor ba yin pas na las mtha' ring ba dang /lhag par du rlan gsher che ba'i nam zla dbyar dus char zhod che ba'i dus dang / srod dang snga dro'i dus dang kha zas zos ma thag tu bad kun gyi nad ldang zhing mngon che ba byed pa bcas kyi rtags 'di dag ston na bad kun 'khrugs par gyur ba'i go/nad gcig yin/ /bco brgyad pa/ lus zungs 'phel zad gnyis bstan pa/bshad rgyud nyes pa'i mtshan nyed bstan pa'i le'u las/ dngas ma 'phel bas bad kun dang 'dra la/ /dngas ma zad pas sha skam zas mi dka'/ /lpags rtsub sgra cher mi bzod na bar 'gyur/ /khrag 'phel mi dbal khong 'bras mcher pa'i nad/ /mdze skran khrag mkhris nad dang mig ser dang / /snyil nad bskyod dka' mig dang gcin lngags dmar/ /khrag zad rtsa lhod lngags rtsub bsil skyur dad/ /sha 'phel lba ba min bu sha rgyas 'gyur/ /sha zad lhu tshigs na zhing rus lngags 'byar/ /tshil 'phel ngal 346

dang nu ma gsus tshil skye/ /tshil zad gnyid chung sha skam sngo skyar 'gyur// rus pa 'phel bas rus/ lhag so lhag byung / /rus pa zad pas skra byi so sen phyung / /rkang 'phel lus snyi mig g.yung tshigs kha sbom/ /rkang zad sbubs stongs mgo 'khor mig 'grib 'gyur/ /khu 'phel khu ba'i rde 'gyur bud med dad/ /khu ba zad pas khrag 'byung 'tshig gam snyam/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang lus zungs 'phel zad gnyis gcig tu bstan pa las lus zungs rnarmas kyi dang po dngas ma'i nyes pa 'phel ba'i rtags su lus kyi me drod nyam sa te zas mi 'ju ba sogs gong du bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags rnams ston par byed pa dang / dngas ma de nyid zad pa'i rtags su greng byung snyam na ni/ 'di lta ste/ lus kyi me drod che drags nas dngas ma bri zhing zad pas lus/ po'i zungs khrag gi lda nga tshad rang bzhin zhung du song nas sha 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu med pas lus skam/ pa dang / stobs shor nas kha zas mid dka' ba dang / rlung yang rtsub kyi cha 'phel bas lngags pa rtsub po chags pa dang / dngas ma len pa'i rtsa phran rnams su stong pa'i cha 'phel bas phyi nas sgra skad chen po bsgrags par gyur na mi bzod cing lus kun na bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus zungs gnyis pa khrag 'phel ba'i rtags su me dba'/ zhes gdong pa dang mjing pa sha lpags sogs/ su mes 'tshig nga/ kyi lha bu'i 'brum pa dmar po ko per thon zhing drod tshad kyis/ za 'phrug langs pa'i skabs su 'phrug na chu ser thon pa dang / khong du 'bras nad 347

dang nu ma gsus tshil skye/ /tshil zad gnyid chung sha skam sngo skyar 'gyur// rus pa 'phel bas rus/ lhag so lhag byung / /rus pa zad pas skra byi so sen phyung / /rkang 'phel lus snyi mig g.yung tshigs kha sbom/ /rkang zad sbubs stongs mgo 'khor mig 'grib 'gyur/ /khu 'phel khu ba'i rde 'gyur bud med dad/ /khu ba zad pas khrag 'byung 'tshig gam snyam/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang lus zungs 'phel zad gnyis gcig tu bstan pa las lus zungs rnarmas kyi dang po dngas ma'i nyes pa 'phel ba'i rtags su lus kyi me drod nyam sa te zas mi 'ju ba sogs gong du bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags rnams ston par byed pa dang / dngas ma de nyid zad pa'i rtags su greng byung snyam na ni/ 'di lta ste/ lus kyi me drod che drags nas dngas ma bri zhing zad pas lus/ po'i zungs khrag gi lda nga tshad rang bzhin zhung du song nas sha 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu med pas lus skam/ pa dang / stobs shor nas kha zas mid dka' ba dang / rlung yang rtsub kyi cha 'phel bas lngags pa rtsub po chags pa dang / dngas ma len pa'i rtsa phran rnams su stong pa'i cha 'phel bas phyi nas sgra skad chen po bsgrags par gyur na mi bzod cing lus kun na bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus zungs gnyis pa khrag 'phel ba'i rtags su me dba'/ zhes gdong pa dang mjing pa sha lpags sogs/ su mes 'tshig nga/ kyi lha bu'i 'brum pa dmar po ko per thon zhing drod tshad kyis/ za 'phrug langs pa'i skabs su 'phrug na chu ser thon pa dang / khong du 'bras nad 347

chags pa dang / mcher pa'i nad kyang skyed cing / khrag gi snyigs ma snod kyi mkhris pa'i nang du gsog cing / mkhris pa'i snyigs/ ma lus kyi chu ser gyi rgyu nyid du 'gyur bar byed pa'i cha nas mdze nad bco brgyad kyi nang du yang 'gyur ba yin la/ de bzhin khrag skran nad dang / khrag nad spyi dang /mkhris pa'i nad/ khrag gi snyigs ma 'phel nas snod mkhris rgyas pa'i myo/khris pa rtsa ru lus te mig ser gyi nad byung ba dang / so rnyil skra ngas pa dang dul ba sogs kyi nad 'byung bar byed la/ lus po 'gul bskyod byed par dka' tshegs che ba dang / mig dang / gcin pa dang / lpags pa so gas kyi mdog kyang dmar por 'gyur ba bcas kyi nad 'byung bar byed pa yin/'on te mi'i khrag zad par gyur na ni de'i rtags su mi'i khrag rgyu bar byed pa'i rtsa lam gyi gu ga rnams stong pa dang rtsa ltod par 'gyur ba dang /zungs khrag zhan pa'i rkyen gyis lpags pa rnams rtsub po chags par byed la /rlung tshad 'khrugs pas reg bya bsil ba la dga' zhing / lhag par du khrag 'phel bar byed pa'i zas skom ro skyur po'i rigs rnams bza' 'dod cing dad par 'gyur ba yin/ lus zungs gsum pa sha 'phel ba'i rtags su/ sha lhag lba ba skye ba dang / lus kyi ska dang mjing pa mchan khung sogs su rmen bu'i rigs rnams rgyas par byed la/ lus po spyi yongs dang / brang sha/ nu tha/ brla sha/ nywa sha sogs rgyas nas ha cang sbom por 'gyur ba yin/de las ldog ste sha zad par gyur na ni/ tshigs kyi lhu tshigs rnams gzhigs 348

te na ba dang / lus kyi sha ha cang skem pas lpags pa rus pa la 'byar nas lus skrag cing na bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus zungs bzhi pa tshil 'phel pa'i rtags su yar mar lus 'gul bskyod byed par dka' zhing / lam seng ngal ba ste dka' las kha ba dang / brang gi ngos su nu ma'i sha dang / gsus pa ste grod khog gi gnas su tshil shin tu 'phel bas mar lug cing rgyas par byed pa'i mngon rtags byung ba dang / yang tshil bri nas nyung du phyin pa na de'i rtags su tshil lu ni bad kun gyi rten yin zhing / de zad par gyur na gnas der rlung gi cha 'phel bar gyur pas/ yang rtsub kyis nus pas gnyid ha cang gi chung ba 'gyur la/ lus kyi sha skams nas phyi'i mdog sngo skyar 'gyur ba byed pa yin/ lus zungs lnga pa rus pa 'phel ba'i rtags su ni/ dper na kha'i nang so rnyil ldebs su so thol pa skyes nas mche ba thon pa dang / de bzhin du gzhug chung gi rus pa skye ba ma zad rus tshigs sbom por 'gyur bar byed pa sogs mdor na rus lhag dang so lhag rigs skye bar byed pa yin/ gal te mi'i rus pa'i nus pa zad par gyur na ni rtags su/ rus pa'i snyigs ma'i rten med pas mgo bo'i skra rang bzhin bud de byi 'gro ba dang / de bzhin du kha'i nang gi so dang rkang lag gi mdzub mo'i sen mo rnams phyung ste don med du rang bzhin gyis bud 'gro ba'i rtags ston par byed do/ lus zungs drug pa mi'i rkang mar 'phel ba'i rtags su/ rkang ni bcud kyi rang bzhin can zhig dang lhag par bad 349
